  23072     int title_len = 0;
  23073     nk_hash tree_hash = 0;
  23074     nk_uint *state = 0;
  23075 
  23076     /* retrieve tree state from internal widget state tables */
  23077     if (!hash) {
  23078         title_len = (int)nk_strlen(title);
  23079         tree_hash = nk_murmur_hash(title, (int)title_len, (nk_hash)line);
  23080     } else tree_hash = nk_murmur_hash(hash, len, (nk_hash)line);
  23081     state = nk_find_value(win, tree_hash);
  23082     if (!state) {

  23112 /* ===============================================================
  23113  *
  23114  *                          GROUP
  23115  *
  23116  * ===============================================================*/
  23117 NK_API nk_bool
  23118 nk_group_scrolled_offset_begin(struct nk_context *ctx,
  23119     nk_uint *x_offset, nk_uint *y_offset, const char *title, nk_flags flags)
  23120 {
  23121     struct nk_rect bounds;
  23122     struct nk_window panel;
  23123     struct nk_window *win;
  23124 
  23125     win = ctx->current;
  23126     nk_panel_alloc_space(&bounds, ctx);
  23127     {const struct nk_rect *c = &win->layout->clip;
  23128     if (!NK_INTERSECT(c->x, c->y, c->w, c->h, bounds.x, bounds.y, bounds.w, bounds.h) &&
  23129         !(flags & NK_WINDOW_MOVABLE)) {
  23130         return 0;
  23131     }}
  23132     if (win->flags & NK_WINDOW_ROM)
  23133         flags |= NK_WINDOW_ROM;
  23134 
  23135     /* initialize a fake window to create the panel from */
  23136     nk_zero(&panel, sizeof(panel));
  23137     panel.bounds = bounds;
  23138     panel.flags = flags;
  23139     panel.scrollbar.x = *x_offset;
  23140     panel.scrollbar.y = *y_offset;
  23141     panel.buffer = win->buffer;
  23142     panel.layout = (struct nk_panel*)nk_create_panel(ctx);
  23143     ctx->current = &panel;
  23144     nk_panel_begin(ctx, (flags & NK_WINDOW_TITLE) ? title: 0, NK_PANEL_GROUP);
  23145 
  23146     win->buffer = panel.buffer;
  23147     win->buffer.clip = panel.layout->clip;
  23148     panel.layout->offset_x = x_offset;
  23149     panel.layout->offset_y = y_offset;
  23150     panel.layout->parent = win->layout;
  23151     win->layout = panel.layout;
  23152 
  23153     ctx->current = win;
  23154     if ((panel.layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_CLOSED) ||
  23155         (panel.layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_MINIMIZED))
  23156     {
  23157         nk_flags f = panel.layout->flags;
  23158         nk_group_scrolled_end(ctx);
  23159         if (f & NK_WINDOW_CLOSED)
  23160             return NK_WINDOW_CLOSED;
  23161         if (f & NK_WINDOW_MINIMIZED)
  23162             return NK_WINDOW_MINIMIZED;
  23163     }
  23164     return 1;
  23165 }
  23166 NK_API void
  23167 nk_group_scrolled_end(struct nk_context *ctx)
  23168 {
  23169     struct nk_window *win;
  23170     struct nk_panel *parent;
  23171     struct nk_panel *g;
  23172 
  23173     struct nk_rect clip;
  23174     struct nk_window pan;
  23175     struct nk_vec2 panel_padding;
  23176 
  23177     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  23178     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  23179     if (!ctx || !ctx->current)
  23180         return;
  23181 
  23182     /* make sure nk_group_begin was called correctly */
  23183     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  23184     win = ctx->current;
  23185     NK_ASSERT(win->layout);
  23186     g = win->layout;
  23187     NK_ASSERT(g->parent);
  23188     parent = g->parent;
  23189 
  23190     /* dummy window */
  23191     nk_zero_struct(pan);
  23192     panel_padding = nk_panel_get_padding(&ctx->style, NK_PANEL_GROUP);
  23193     pan.bounds.y = g->bounds.y - (g->header_height + g->menu.h);
  23194     pan.bounds.x = g->bounds.x - panel_padding.x;
  23195     pan.bounds.w = g->bounds.w + 2 * panel_padding.x;
  23196     pan.bounds.h = g->bounds.h + g->header_height + g->menu.h;
  23197     if (g->flags & NK_WINDOW_BORDER) {
  23198         pan.bounds.x -= g->border;
  23199         pan.bounds.y -= g->border;
  23200         pan.bounds.w += 2*g->border;
  23201         pan.bounds.h += 2*g->border;
  23202     }
  23203     if (!(g->flags & NK_WINDOW_NO_SCROLLBAR)) {
  23204         pan.bounds.w += ctx->style.window.scrollbar_size.x;
  23205         pan.bounds.h += ctx->style.window.scrollbar_size.y;
  23206     }
  23207     pan.scrollbar.x = *g->offset_x;
  23208     pan.scrollbar.y = *g->offset_y;
  23209     pan.flags = g->flags;
  23210     pan.buffer = win->buffer;
  23211     pan.layout = g;
  23212     pan.parent = win;
  23213     ctx->current = &pan;
  23214 
  23215     /* make sure group has correct clipping rectangle */
  23216     nk_unify(&clip, &parent->clip, pan.bounds.x, pan.bounds.y,
  23217         pan.bounds.x + pan.bounds.w, pan.bounds.y + pan.bounds.h + panel_padding.x);
  23218     nk_push_scissor(&pan.buffer, clip);
  23219     nk_end(ctx);
  23220 
  23221     win->buffer = pan.buffer;
  23222     nk_push_scissor(&win->buffer, parent->clip);
  23223     ctx->current = win;
  23224     win->layout = parent;
  23225     g->bounds = pan.bounds;
  23226     return;
  23227 }
  23228 NK_API nk_bool
  23229 nk_group_scrolled_begin(struct nk_context *ctx,
  23230     struct nk_scroll *scroll, const char *title, nk_flags flags)
  23231 {
  23232     return nk_group_scrolled_offset_begin(ctx, &scroll->x, &scroll->y, title, flags);
  23233 }
  23234 NK_API nk_bool
  23235 nk_group_begin_titled(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *id,
  23236     const char *title, nk_flags flags)
  23237 {
  23238     int id_len;
  23239     nk_hash id_hash;
  23240     struct nk_window *win;
  23241     nk_uint *x_offset;
  23242     nk_uint *y_offset;
  23243 
  23244     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  23245     NK_ASSERT(id);
  23246     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  23247     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  23248     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout || !id)
  23249         return 0;
  23250 
  23251     /* find persistent group scrollbar value */
  23252     win = ctx->current;
  23253     id_len = (int)nk_strlen(id);
  23254     id_hash = nk_murmur_hash(id, (int)id_len, NK_PANEL_GROUP);
  23255     x_offset = nk_find_value(win, id_hash);
  23256     if (!x_offset) {
  23257         x_offset = nk_add_value(ctx, win, id_hash, 0);
  23258         y_offset = nk_add_value(ctx, win, id_hash+1, 0);
  23259 
  23260         NK_ASSERT(x_offset);
  23261         NK_ASSERT(y_offset);
  23262         if (!x_offset || !y_offset) return 0;
  23263         *x_offset = *y_offset = 0;
  23264     } else y_offset = nk_find_value(win, id_hash+1);
  23265     return nk_group_scrolled_offset_begin(ctx, x_offset, y_offset, title, flags);
  23266 }

  23277 NK_API void
  23278 nk_group_get_scroll(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *id, nk_uint *x_offset, nk_uint *y_offset)
  23279 {

  23294     win = ctx->current;

  23296     id_hash = nk_murmur_hash(id, (int)id_len, NK_PANEL_GROUP);

  23307     if (x_offset)
  23308       *x_offset = *x_offset_ptr;
  23309     if (y_offset)
  23310       *y_offset = *y_offset_ptr;

  23349 /* ===============================================================
  23350  *
  23351  *                          LIST VIEW
  23352  *
  23353  * ===============================================================*/
  23354 NK_API nk_bool
  23355 nk_list_view_begin(struct nk_context *ctx, struct nk_list_view *view,
  23356     const char *title, nk_flags flags, int row_height, int row_count)
  23357 {
  23358     int title_len;
  23359     nk_hash title_hash;
  23360     nk_uint *x_offset;
  23361     nk_uint *y_offset;
  23362 
  23363     int result;
  23364     struct nk_window *win;
  23365     struct nk_panel *layout;
  23366     const struct nk_style *style;
  23367     struct nk_vec2 item_spacing;
  23368 
  23369     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  23370     NK_ASSERT(view);
  23371     NK_ASSERT(title);
  23372     if (!ctx || !view || !title) return 0;
  23373 
  23374     win = ctx->current;
  23375     style = &ctx->style;
  23376     item_spacing = style->window.spacing;
  23377     row_height += NK_MAX(0, (int)item_spacing.y);
  23378 
  23379     /* find persistent list view scrollbar offset */
  23380     title_len = (int)nk_strlen(title);
  23381     title_hash = nk_murmur_hash(title, (int)title_len, NK_PANEL_GROUP);
  23382     x_offset = nk_find_value(win, title_hash);
  23383     if (!x_offset) {
  23384         x_offset = nk_add_value(ctx, win, title_hash, 0);
  23385         y_offset = nk_add_value(ctx, win, title_hash+1, 0);
  23386 
  23387         NK_ASSERT(x_offset);
  23388         NK_ASSERT(y_offset);
  23389         if (!x_offset || !y_offset) return 0;
  23390         *x_offset = *y_offset = 0;
  23391     } else y_offset = nk_find_value(win, title_hash+1);
  23392     view->scroll_value = *y_offset;
  23393     view->scroll_pointer = y_offset;
  23394 
  23395     *y_offset = 0;
  23396     result = nk_group_scrolled_offset_begin(ctx, x_offset, y_offset, title, flags);
  23397     win = ctx->current;
  23398     layout = win->layout;
  23399 
  23400     view->total_height = row_height * NK_MAX(row_count,1);
  23401     view->begin = (int)NK_MAX(((float)view->scroll_value / (float)row_height), 0.0f);
  23402     view->count = (int)NK_MAX(nk_iceilf((layout->clip.h)/(float)row_height),0);
  23403     view->count = NK_MIN(view->count, row_count - view->begin);
  23404     view->end = view->begin + view->count;
  23405     view->ctx = ctx;
  23406     return result;
  23407 }
  23408 NK_API void
  23409 nk_list_view_end(struct nk_list_view *view)
  23410 {
  23411     struct nk_context *ctx;
  23412     struct nk_window *win;
  23413     struct nk_panel *layout;
  23414 
  23415     NK_ASSERT(view);
  23416     NK_ASSERT(view->ctx);
  23417     NK_ASSERT(view->scroll_pointer);
  23418     if (!view || !view->ctx) return;
  23419 
  23420     ctx = view->ctx;
  23421     win = ctx->current;
  23422     layout = win->layout;
  23423     layout->at_y = layout->bounds.y + (float)view->total_height;
  23424     *view->scroll_pointer = *view->scroll_pointer + view->scroll_value;
  23425     nk_group_end(view->ctx);
  23426 }

  23496 NK_API nk_bool
  23497 nk_widget_is_hovered(const struct nk_context *ctx)
  23498 {
  23499     struct nk_rect c, v;
  23500     struct nk_rect bounds;
  23501     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  23502     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  23503     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  23504     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout || (ctx->active != ctx->current && !((int)ctx->current->layout->type & (int)NK_PANEL_SET_POPUP)))
  23505         return 0;
  23506 
  23507     c = ctx->current->layout->clip;
  23508     c.x = (float)((int)c.x);
  23509     c.y = (float)((int)c.y);
  23510     c.w = (float)((int)c.w);
  23511     c.h = (float)((int)c.h);
  23512 
  23513     nk_layout_peek(&bounds, ctx);
  23514     nk_unify(&v, &c, bounds.x, bounds.y, bounds.x + bounds.w, bounds.y + bounds.h);
  23515     if (!NK_INTERSECT(c.x, c.y, c.w, c.h, bounds.x, bounds.y, bounds.w, bounds.h))
  23516         return 0;
  23517     return nk_input_is_mouse_hovering_rect(&ctx->input, bounds);
  23518 }

  23565 NK_API enum nk_widget_layout_states
  23566 nk_widget(struct nk_rect *bounds, const struct nk_context *ctx)
  23567 {
  23568     struct nk_rect c, v;
  23569     struct nk_window *win;
  23570     struct nk_panel *layout;
  23571     const struct nk_input *in;
  23572 
  23573     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  23574     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  23575     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  23576     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout)
  23577         return NK_WIDGET_INVALID;
  23578 
  23579     /* allocate space and check if the widget needs to be updated and drawn */
  23580     nk_panel_alloc_space(bounds, ctx);
  23581     win = ctx->current;
  23582     layout = win->layout;
  23583     in = &ctx->input;
  23584     c = layout->clip;
  23585 
  23586     /*  if one of these triggers you forgot to add an `if` condition around either
  23587         a window, group, popup, combobox or contextual menu `begin` and `end` block.
  23588         Example:
  23589             if (nk_begin(...) {...} nk_end(...); or
  23590             if (nk_group_begin(...) { nk_group_end(...);} */
  23591     NK_ASSERT(!(layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_MINIMIZED));
  23592     NK_ASSERT(!(layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_HIDDEN));
  23593     NK_ASSERT(!(layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_CLOSED));
  23594 
  23595     /* need to convert to int here to remove floating point errors */
  23596     bounds->x = (float)((int)bounds->x);
  23597     bounds->y = (float)((int)bounds->y);
  23598     bounds->w = (float)((int)bounds->w);
  23599     bounds->h = (float)((int)bounds->h);
  23600 
  23601     c.x = (float)((int)c.x);
  23602     c.y = (float)((int)c.y);
  23603     c.w = (float)((int)c.w);
  23604     c.h = (float)((int)c.h);
  23605 
  23606     nk_unify(&v, &c, bounds->x, bounds->y, bounds->x + bounds->w, bounds->y + bounds->h);
  23607     if (!NK_INTERSECT(c.x, c.y, c.w, c.h, bounds->x, bounds->y, bounds->w, bounds->h))
  23608         return NK_WIDGET_INVALID;
  23609     if (win->widgets_disabled)
  23610         return NK_WIDGET_DISABLED;
  23611     if (!NK_INBOX(in->mouse.pos.x, in->mouse.pos.y, v.x, v.y, v.w, v.h))
  23612         return NK_WIDGET_ROM;
  23613     return NK_WIDGET_VALID;
  23614 }
  23615 NK_API enum nk_widget_layout_states
  23616 nk_widget_fitting(struct nk_rect *bounds, const struct nk_context *ctx,
  23617     struct nk_vec2 item_padding)
  23618 {
  23619     /* update the bounds to stand without padding  */
  23620     enum nk_widget_layout_states state;
  23621     NK_UNUSED(item_padding);
  23622 
  23623     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  23624     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  23625     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  23626     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout)
  23627         return NK_WIDGET_INVALID;
  23628 
  23629     state = nk_widget(bounds, ctx);
  23630     return state;
  23631 }
  23632 NK_API void
  23633 nk_spacing(struct nk_context *ctx, int cols)
  23634 {
  23635     struct nk_window *win;
  23636     struct nk_panel *layout;
  23637     struct nk_rect none;
  23638     int i, index, rows;
  23639 
  23640     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  23641     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  23642     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  23643     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout)
  23644         return;
  23645 
  23646     /* spacing over row boundaries */
  23647     win = ctx->current;
  23648     layout = win->layout;
  23649     index = (layout->row.index + cols) % layout->row.columns;
  23650     rows = (layout->row.index + cols) / layout->row.columns;
  23651     if (rows) {
  23652         for (i = 0; i < rows; ++i)
  23653             nk_panel_alloc_row(ctx, win);
  23654         cols = index;
  23655     }
  23656     /* non table layout need to allocate space */
  23657     if (layout->row.type != NK_LAYOUT_DYNAMIC_FIXED &&
  23658         layout->row.type != NK_LAYOUT_STATIC_FIXED) {
  23659         for (i = 0; i < cols; ++i)
  23660             nk_panel_alloc_space(&none, ctx);
  23661     } layout->row.index = index;
  23662 }

  23726 NK_API void
  23727 nk_widget_disable_end(struct nk_context* ctx)
  23728 {

  23730     struct nk_style* style;
  23731 
  23732     NK_ASSERT(ctx);

  23793 /* ===============================================================
  23794  *
  23795  *                              TEXT
  23796  *
  23797  * ===============================================================*/
  23798 NK_LIB void
  23799 nk_widget_text(struct nk_command_buffer *o, struct nk_rect b,
  23800     const char *string, int len, const struct nk_text *t,
  23801     nk_flags a, const struct nk_user_font *f)
  23802 {
  23803     struct nk_rect label;
  23804     float text_width;
  23805 
  23806     NK_ASSERT(o);
  23807     NK_ASSERT(t);
  23808     if (!o || !t) return;
  23809 
  23810     b.h = NK_MAX(b.h, 2 * t->padding.y);
  23811 
  23812     text_width = f->width(f->userdata, f->height, (const char*)string, len);
  23813     text_width += (2.0f * t->padding.x);
  23814 
  23815     /* use top-left alignment by default */
  23816     if (!(a & (NK_TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT | NK_TEXT_ALIGN_CENTERED | NK_TEXT_ALIGN_RIGHT)))
  23817         a |= NK_TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT;
  23818     if (!(a & (NK_TEXT_ALIGN_TOP | NK_TEXT_ALIGN_MIDDLE | NK_TEXT_ALIGN_BOTTOM)))
  23819         a |= NK_TEXT_ALIGN_TOP;
  23820 
  23821     /* align in x-axis */
  23822     if (a & NK_TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT) {
  23823         label.x = b.x + t->padding.x;
  23824         label.w = NK_MAX(0, b.w - 2 * t->padding.x);
  23825     } else if (a & NK_TEXT_ALIGN_CENTERED) {
  23826         label.w = NK_MAX(1, 2 * t->padding.x + (float)text_width);
  23827         label.x = (b.x + t->padding.x + ((b.w - 2 * t->padding.x) - label.w) / 2);
  23828         label.x = NK_MAX(b.x + t->padding.x, label.x);
  23829         label.w = NK_MIN(b.x + b.w, label.x + label.w);
  23830         if (label.w >= label.x) label.w -= label.x;
  23831     } else if (a & NK_TEXT_ALIGN_RIGHT) {
  23832         label.x = NK_MAX(b.x + t->padding.x, (b.x + b.w) - (2 * t->padding.x + (float)text_width));
  23833         label.w = (float)text_width + 2 * t->padding.x;
  23834     }
  23835 
  23836     /* align in y-axis */
  23837     if (a & NK_TEXT_ALIGN_TOP) {
  23838         label.y = b.y + t->padding.y;
  23839         label.h = NK_MIN(f->height, b.h - 2 * t->padding.y);
  23840     } else if (a & NK_TEXT_ALIGN_MIDDLE) {
  23841         label.y = b.y + b.h/2.0f - (float)f->height/2.0f;
  23842         label.h = NK_MAX(b.h/2.0f, b.h - (b.h/2.0f + f->height/2.0f));
  23843     } else if (a & NK_TEXT_ALIGN_BOTTOM) {
  23844         label.y = b.y + b.h - f->height;
  23845         label.h = f->height;
  23846     }
  23847 
  23848     nk_draw_text(o, label, (const char*)string, len, f, t->background, t->text);
  23849 }
  23850 NK_LIB void
  23851 nk_widget_text_wrap(struct nk_command_buffer *o, struct nk_rect b,
  23852     const char *string, int len, const struct nk_text *t,
  23853     const struct nk_user_font *f)
  23854 {
  23855     float width;
  23856     int glyphs = 0;
  23857     int fitting = 0;
  23858     int done = 0;
  23859     struct nk_rect line;
  23860     struct nk_text text;
  23861     NK_INTERN nk_rune seperator[] = {' '};
  23862 
  23863     NK_ASSERT(o);
  23864     NK_ASSERT(t);
  23865     if (!o || !t) return;
  23866 
  23867     text.padding = nk_vec2(0,0);
  23868     text.background = t->background;
  23869     text.text = t->text;
  23870 
  23871     b.w = NK_MAX(b.w, 2 * t->padding.x);
  23872     b.h = NK_MAX(b.h, 2 * t->padding.y);
  23873     b.h = b.h - 2 * t->padding.y;
  23874 
  23875     line.x = b.x + t->padding.x;
  23876     line.y = b.y + t->padding.y;
  23877     line.w = b.w - 2 * t->padding.x;
  23878     line.h = 2 * t->padding.y + f->height;
  23879 
  23880     fitting = nk_text_clamp(f, string, len, line.w, &glyphs, &width, seperator,NK_LEN(seperator));
  23881     while (done < len) {
  23882         if (!fitting || line.y + line.h >= (b.y + b.h)) break;
  23883         nk_widget_text(o, line, &string[done], fitting, &text, NK_TEXT_LEFT, f);
  23884         done += fitting;
  23885         line.y += f->height + 2 * t->padding.y;
  23886         fitting = nk_text_clamp(f, &string[done], len - done, line.w, &glyphs, &width, seperator,NK_LEN(seperator));
  23887     }
  23888 }
  23889 NK_API void
  23890 nk_text_colored(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *str, int len,
  23891     nk_flags alignment, struct nk_color color)
  23892 {
  23893     struct nk_window *win;
  23894     const struct nk_style *style;
  23895 
  23896     struct nk_vec2 item_padding;
  23897     struct nk_rect bounds;
  23898     struct nk_text text;
  23899 
  23900     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  23901     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  23902     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  23903     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout) return;
  23904 
  23905     win = ctx->current;
  23906     style = &ctx->style;
  23907     nk_panel_alloc_space(&bounds, ctx);
  23908     item_padding = style->text.padding;
  23909 
  23910     text.padding.x = item_padding.x;
  23911     text.padding.y = item_padding.y;
  23912     text.background = style->window.background;
  23913     text.text = nk_rgb_factor(color, style->text.color_factor);
  23914     nk_widget_text(&win->buffer, bounds, str, len, &text, alignment, style->font);
  23915 }

  24340 /* ==============================================================
  24341  *
  24342  *                          BUTTON
  24343  *
  24344  * ===============================================================*/
  24345 NK_LIB void
  24346 nk_draw_symbol(struct nk_command_buffer *out, enum nk_symbol_type type,
  24347     struct nk_rect content, struct nk_color background, struct nk_color foreground,
  24348     float border_width, const struct nk_user_font *font)
  24349 {
  24350     switch (type) {
  24351     case NK_SYMBOL_X:
  24352     case NK_SYMBOL_UNDERSCORE:
  24353     case NK_SYMBOL_PLUS:
  24354     case NK_SYMBOL_MINUS: {
  24355         /* single character text symbol */
  24356         const char *X = (type == NK_SYMBOL_X) ? "x":
  24357             (type == NK_SYMBOL_UNDERSCORE) ? "_":
  24358             (type == NK_SYMBOL_PLUS) ? "+": "-";
  24359         struct nk_text text;
  24360         text.padding = nk_vec2(0,0);
  24361         text.background = background;
  24362         text.text = foreground;
  24363         nk_widget_text(out, content, X, 1, &text, NK_TEXT_CENTERED, font);
  24364     } break;
  24365     case NK_SYMBOL_CIRCLE_SOLID:
  24366     case NK_SYMBOL_CIRCLE_OUTLINE:
  24367     case NK_SYMBOL_RECT_SOLID:
  24368     case NK_SYMBOL_RECT_OUTLINE: {
  24369         /* simple empty/filled shapes */
  24370         if (type == NK_SYMBOL_RECT_SOLID || type == NK_SYMBOL_RECT_OUTLINE) {
  24371             nk_fill_rect(out, content,  0, foreground);
  24372             if (type == NK_SYMBOL_RECT_OUTLINE)
  24373                 nk_fill_rect(out, nk_shrink_rect(content, border_width), 0, background);
  24374         } else {
  24375             nk_fill_circle(out, content, foreground);
  24376             if (type == NK_SYMBOL_CIRCLE_OUTLINE)
  24377                 nk_fill_circle(out, nk_shrink_rect(content, 1), background);
  24378         }
  24379     } break;
  24380     case NK_SYMBOL_TRIANGLE_UP:
  24381     case NK_SYMBOL_TRIANGLE_DOWN:
  24382     case NK_SYMBOL_TRIANGLE_LEFT:
  24383     case NK_SYMBOL_TRIANGLE_RIGHT: {
  24384         enum nk_heading heading;
  24385         struct nk_vec2 points[3];
  24386         heading = (type == NK_SYMBOL_TRIANGLE_RIGHT) ? NK_RIGHT :
  24387             (type == NK_SYMBOL_TRIANGLE_LEFT) ? NK_LEFT:
  24388             (type == NK_SYMBOL_TRIANGLE_UP) ? NK_UP: NK_DOWN;
  24389         nk_triangle_from_direction(points, content, 0, 0, heading);
  24390         nk_fill_triangle(out, points[0].x, points[0].y, points[1].x, points[1].y,
  24391             points[2].x, points[2].y, foreground);
  24392     } break;
  24393     case NK_SYMBOL_TRIANGLE_UP_OUTLINE:
  24394     case NK_SYMBOL_TRIANGLE_DOWN_OUTLINE:
  24395     case NK_SYMBOL_TRIANGLE_LEFT_OUTLINE:
  24396     case NK_SYMBOL_TRIANGLE_RIGHT_OUTLINE: {
  24397         enum nk_heading heading;
  24398         struct nk_vec2 points[3];
  24399         heading = (type == NK_SYMBOL_TRIANGLE_RIGHT_OUTLINE) ? NK_RIGHT :
  24400             (type == NK_SYMBOL_TRIANGLE_LEFT_OUTLINE) ? NK_LEFT:
  24401             (type == NK_SYMBOL_TRIANGLE_UP_OUTLINE) ? NK_UP: NK_DOWN;
  24402         nk_triangle_from_direction(points, content, 0, 0, heading);
  24403         nk_stroke_triangle(out, points[0].x, points[0].y, points[1].x, points[1].y,
  24404             points[2].x, points[2].y, border_width, foreground);
  24405     } break;
  24406     default:
  24407     case NK_SYMBOL_NONE:
  24408     case NK_SYMBOL_MAX: break;
  24409     }
  24410 }
  24411 NK_LIB nk_bool
  24412 nk_button_behavior(nk_flags *state, struct nk_rect r,
  24413     const struct nk_input *i, enum nk_button_behavior behavior)
  24414 {
  24415     int ret = 0;
  24416     nk_widget_state_reset(state);
  24417     if (!i) return 0;
  24418     if (nk_input_is_mouse_hovering_rect(i, r)) {
  24419         *state = NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVERED;
  24420         if (nk_input_is_mouse_down(i, NK_BUTTON_LEFT))
  24421             *state = NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVE;
  24422         if (nk_input_has_mouse_click_in_button_rect(i, NK_BUTTON_LEFT, r)) {
  24423             ret = (behavior != NK_BUTTON_DEFAULT) ?
  24424                 nk_input_is_mouse_down(i, NK_BUTTON_LEFT):
  24425 #ifdef NK_BUTTON_TRIGGER_ON_RELEASE
  24426                 nk_input_is_mouse_released(i, NK_BUTTON_LEFT);
  24427 #else
  24428                 nk_input_is_mouse_pressed(i, NK_BUTTON_LEFT);
  24429 #endif
  24430         }
  24431     }
  24432     if (*state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER && !nk_input_is_mouse_prev_hovering_rect(i, r))
  24433         *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_ENTERED;
  24434     else if (nk_input_is_mouse_prev_hovering_rect(i, r))
  24435         *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_LEFT;
  24436     return ret;
  24437 }
  24438 NK_LIB const struct nk_style_item*
  24439 nk_draw_button(struct nk_command_buffer *out,
  24440     const struct nk_rect *bounds, nk_flags state,
  24441     const struct nk_style_button *style)
  24442 {
  24443     const struct nk_style_item *background;
  24444     if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER)
  24445         background = &style->hover;
  24446     else if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED)
  24447         background = &style->active;
  24448     else background = &style->normal;
  24449 
  24450     switch (background->type) {
  24451         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE:
  24452             nk_draw_image(out, *bounds, &background->data.image, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor_background));
  24453             break;
  24454         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_NINE_SLICE:
  24455             nk_draw_nine_slice(out, *bounds, &background->data.slice, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor_background));
  24456             break;
  24457         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR:
  24458             nk_fill_rect(out, *bounds, style->rounding, nk_rgb_factor(background->data.color, style->color_factor_background));
  24459             nk_stroke_rect(out, *bounds, style->rounding, style->border, nk_rgb_factor(style->border_color, style->color_factor_background));
  24460             break;
  24461     }
  24462     return background;
  24463 }
  24464 NK_LIB nk_bool
  24465 nk_do_button(nk_flags *state, struct nk_command_buffer *out, struct nk_rect r,
  24466     const struct nk_style_button *style, const struct nk_input *in,
  24467     enum nk_button_behavior behavior, struct nk_rect *content)
  24468 {
  24469     struct nk_rect bounds;
  24470     NK_ASSERT(style);
  24471     NK_ASSERT(state);
  24472     NK_ASSERT(out);
  24473     if (!out || !style)
  24474         return nk_false;
  24475 
  24476     /* calculate button content space */
  24477     content->x = r.x + style->padding.x + style->border + style->rounding;
  24478     content->y = r.y + style->padding.y + style->border + style->rounding;
  24479     content->w = r.w - (2 * (style->padding.x + style->border + style->rounding));
  24480     content->h = r.h - (2 * (style->padding.y + style->border + style->rounding));
  24481 
  24482     /* execute button behavior */
  24483     bounds.x = r.x - style->touch_padding.x;
  24484     bounds.y = r.y - style->touch_padding.y;
  24485     bounds.w = r.w + 2 * style->touch_padding.x;
  24486     bounds.h = r.h + 2 * style->touch_padding.y;
  24487     return nk_button_behavior(state, bounds, in, behavior);
  24488 }
  24489 NK_LIB void
  24490 nk_draw_button_text(struct nk_command_buffer *out,
  24491     const struct nk_rect *bounds, const struct nk_rect *content, nk_flags state,
  24492     const struct nk_style_button *style, const char *txt, int len,
  24493     nk_flags text_alignment, const struct nk_user_font *font)
  24494 {
  24495     struct nk_text text;
  24496     const struct nk_style_item *background;
  24497     background = nk_draw_button(out, bounds, state, style);
  24498 
  24499     /* select correct colors/images */
  24500     if (background->type == NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR)
  24501         text.background = background->data.color;
  24502     else text.background = style->text_background;
  24503     if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER)
  24504         text.text = style->text_hover;
  24505     else if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED)
  24506         text.text = style->text_active;
  24507     else text.text = style->text_normal;
  24508 
  24509     text.text = nk_rgb_factor(text.text, style->color_factor_text);
  24510 
  24511     text.padding = nk_vec2(0,0);
  24512     nk_widget_text(out, *content, txt, len, &text, text_alignment, font);
  24513 }
  24514 NK_LIB nk_bool
  24515 nk_do_button_text(nk_flags *state,
  24516     struct nk_command_buffer *out, struct nk_rect bounds,
  24517     const char *string, int len, nk_flags align, enum nk_button_behavior behavior,
  24518     const struct nk_style_button *style, const struct nk_input *in,
  24519     const struct nk_user_font *font)
  24520 {
  24521     struct nk_rect content;
  24522     int ret = nk_false;
  24523 
  24524     NK_ASSERT(state);
  24525     NK_ASSERT(style);
  24526     NK_ASSERT(out);
  24527     NK_ASSERT(string);
  24528     NK_ASSERT(font);
  24529     if (!out || !style || !font || !string)
  24530         return nk_false;
  24531 
  24532     ret = nk_do_button(state, out, bounds, style, in, behavior, &content);
  24533     if (style->draw_begin) style->draw_begin(out, style->userdata);
  24534     nk_draw_button_text(out, &bounds, &content, *state, style, string, len, align, font);
  24535     if (style->draw_end) style->draw_end(out, style->userdata);
  24536     return ret;
  24537 }
  24538 NK_LIB void
  24539 nk_draw_button_symbol(struct nk_command_buffer *out,
  24540     const struct nk_rect *bounds, const struct nk_rect *content,
  24541     nk_flags state, const struct nk_style_button *style,
  24542     enum nk_symbol_type type, const struct nk_user_font *font)
  24543 {
  24544     struct nk_color sym, bg;
  24545     const struct nk_style_item *background;
  24546 
  24547     /* select correct colors/images */
  24548     background = nk_draw_button(out, bounds, state, style);
  24549     if (background->type == NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR)
  24550         bg = background->data.color;
  24551     else bg = style->text_background;
  24552 
  24553     if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER)
  24554         sym = style->text_hover;
  24555     else if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED)
  24556         sym = style->text_active;
  24557     else sym = style->text_normal;
  24558 
  24559     sym = nk_rgb_factor(sym, style->color_factor_text);
  24560     nk_draw_symbol(out, type, *content, bg, sym, 1, font);
  24561 }
  24562 NK_LIB nk_bool
  24563 nk_do_button_symbol(nk_flags *state,
  24564     struct nk_command_buffer *out, struct nk_rect bounds,
  24565     enum nk_symbol_type symbol, enum nk_button_behavior behavior,
  24566     const struct nk_style_button *style, const struct nk_input *in,
  24567     const struct nk_user_font *font)
  24568 {
  24569     int ret;
  24570     struct nk_rect content;
  24571 
  24572     NK_ASSERT(state);
  24573     NK_ASSERT(style);
  24574     NK_ASSERT(font);
  24575     NK_ASSERT(out);
  24576     if (!out || !style || !font || !state)
  24577         return nk_false;
  24578 
  24579     ret = nk_do_button(state, out, bounds, style, in, behavior, &content);
  24580     if (style->draw_begin) style->draw_begin(out, style->userdata);
  24581     nk_draw_button_symbol(out, &bounds, &content, *state, style, symbol, font);
  24582     if (style->draw_end) style->draw_end(out, style->userdata);
  24583     return ret;
  24584 }
  24585 NK_LIB void
  24586 nk_draw_button_image(struct nk_command_buffer *out,
  24587     const struct nk_rect *bounds, const struct nk_rect *content,
  24588     nk_flags state, const struct nk_style_button *style, const struct nk_image *img)
  24589 {
  24590     nk_draw_button(out, bounds, state, style);
  24591     nk_draw_image(out, *content, img, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor_background));
  24592 }
  24593 NK_LIB nk_bool
  24594 nk_do_button_image(nk_flags *state,
  24595     struct nk_command_buffer *out, struct nk_rect bounds,
  24596     struct nk_image img, enum nk_button_behavior b,
  24597     const struct nk_style_button *style, const struct nk_input *in)
  24598 {
  24599     int ret;
  24600     struct nk_rect content;
  24601 
  24602     NK_ASSERT(state);
  24603     NK_ASSERT(style);
  24604     NK_ASSERT(out);
  24605     if (!out || !style || !state)
  24606         return nk_false;
  24607 
  24608     ret = nk_do_button(state, out, bounds, style, in, b, &content);
  24609     content.x += style->image_padding.x;
  24610     content.y += style->image_padding.y;
  24611     content.w -= 2 * style->image_padding.x;
  24612     content.h -= 2 * style->image_padding.y;
  24613 
  24614     if (style->draw_begin) style->draw_begin(out, style->userdata);
  24615     nk_draw_button_image(out, &bounds, &content, *state, style, &img);
  24616     if (style->draw_end) style->draw_end(out, style->userdata);
  24617     return ret;
  24618 }
  24619 NK_LIB void
  24620 nk_draw_button_text_symbol(struct nk_command_buffer *out,
  24621     const struct nk_rect *bounds, const struct nk_rect *label,
  24622     const struct nk_rect *symbol, nk_flags state, const struct nk_style_button *style,
  24623     const char *str, int len, enum nk_symbol_type type,
  24624     const struct nk_user_font *font)
  24625 {
  24626     struct nk_color sym;
  24627     struct nk_text text;
  24628     const struct nk_style_item *background;
  24629 
  24630     /* select correct background colors/images */
  24631     background = nk_draw_button(out, bounds, state, style);
  24632     if (background->type == NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR)
  24633         text.background = background->data.color;
  24634     else text.background = style->text_background;
  24635 
  24636     /* select correct text colors */
  24637     if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER) {
  24638         sym = style->text_hover;
  24639         text.text = style->text_hover;
  24640     } else if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED) {
  24641         sym = style->text_active;
  24642         text.text = style->text_active;
  24643     } else {
  24644         sym = style->text_normal;
  24645         text.text = style->text_normal;
  24646     }
  24647 
  24648     sym = nk_rgb_factor(sym, style->color_factor_text);
  24649     text.text = nk_rgb_factor(text.text, style->color_factor_text);
  24650     text.padding = nk_vec2(0,0);
  24651     nk_draw_symbol(out, type, *symbol, style->text_background, sym, 0, font);
  24652     nk_widget_text(out, *label, str, len, &text, NK_TEXT_CENTERED, font);
  24653 }
  24654 NK_LIB nk_bool
  24655 nk_do_button_text_symbol(nk_flags *state,
  24656     struct nk_command_buffer *out, struct nk_rect bounds,
  24657     enum nk_symbol_type symbol, const char *str, int len, nk_flags align,
  24658     enum nk_button_behavior behavior, const struct nk_style_button *style,
  24659     const struct nk_user_font *font, const struct nk_input *in)
  24660 {
  24661     int ret;
  24662     struct nk_rect tri = {0,0,0,0};
  24663     struct nk_rect content;
  24664 
  24665     NK_ASSERT(style);
  24666     NK_ASSERT(out);
  24667     NK_ASSERT(font);
  24668     if (!out || !style || !font)
  24669         return nk_false;
  24670 
  24671     ret = nk_do_button(state, out, bounds, style, in, behavior, &content);
  24672     tri.y = content.y + (content.h/2) - font->height/2;
  24673     tri.w = font->height; tri.h = font->height;
  24674     if (align & NK_TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT) {
  24675         tri.x = (content.x + content.w) - (2 * style->padding.x + tri.w);
  24676         tri.x = NK_MAX(tri.x, 0);
  24677     } else tri.x = content.x + 2 * style->padding.x;
  24678 
  24679     /* draw button */
  24680     if (style->draw_begin) style->draw_begin(out, style->userdata);
  24681     nk_draw_button_text_symbol(out, &bounds, &content, &tri,
  24682         *state, style, str, len, symbol, font);
  24683     if (style->draw_end) style->draw_end(out, style->userdata);
  24684     return ret;
  24685 }
  24686 NK_LIB void
  24687 nk_draw_button_text_image(struct nk_command_buffer *out,
  24688     const struct nk_rect *bounds, const struct nk_rect *label,
  24689     const struct nk_rect *image, nk_flags state, const struct nk_style_button *style,
  24690     const char *str, int len, const struct nk_user_font *font,

  24692 {
  24693     struct nk_text text;

  24695     background = nk_draw_button(out, bounds, state, style);
  24696 
  24697     /* select correct colors */
  24698     if (background->type == NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR)
  24699         text.background = background->data.color;
  24700     else text.background = style->text_background;
  24701     if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER)
  24702         text.text = style->text_hover;
  24703     else if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED)
  24704         text.text = style->text_active;
  24705     else text.text = style->text_normal;
  24706 
  24707     text.text = nk_rgb_factor(text.text, style->color_factor_text);
  24708     text.padding = nk_vec2(0, 0);

  24710     nk_draw_image(out, *image, img, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor_background));
  24711 }
  24712 NK_LIB nk_bool
  24713 nk_do_button_text_image(nk_flags *state,
  24714     struct nk_command_buffer *out, struct nk_rect bounds,
  24715     struct nk_image img, const char* str, int len, nk_flags align,
  24716     enum nk_button_behavior behavior, const struct nk_style_button *style,
  24717     const struct nk_user_font *font, const struct nk_input *in)
  24718 {
  24719     int ret;
  24720     struct nk_rect icon;
  24721     struct nk_rect content;
  24722 
  24723     NK_ASSERT(style);
  24724     NK_ASSERT(state);
  24725     NK_ASSERT(font);
  24726     NK_ASSERT(out);
  24727     if (!out || !font || !style || !str)
  24728         return nk_false;
  24729 
  24730     ret = nk_do_button(state, out, bounds, style, in, behavior, &content);
  24731     icon.y = bounds.y + style->padding.y;
  24732     icon.w = icon.h = bounds.h - 2 * style->padding.y;
  24733     if (align & NK_TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT) {
  24734         icon.x = (bounds.x + bounds.w) - (2 * style->padding.x + icon.w);
  24735         icon.x = NK_MAX(icon.x, 0);
  24736     } else icon.x = bounds.x + 2 * style->padding.x;
  24737 
  24738     icon.x += style->image_padding.x;
  24739     icon.y += style->image_padding.y;
  24740     icon.w -= 2 * style->image_padding.x;
  24741     icon.h -= 2 * style->image_padding.y;
  24742 
  24743     if (style->draw_begin) style->draw_begin(out, style->userdata);
  24744     nk_draw_button_text_image(out, &bounds, &content, &icon, *state, style, str, len, font, &img);
  24745     if (style->draw_end) style->draw_end(out, style->userdata);
  24746     return ret;
  24747 }
  24748 NK_API void
  24749 nk_button_set_behavior(struct nk_context *ctx, enum nk_button_behavior behavior)
  24750 {
  24751     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  24752     if (!ctx) return;
  24753     ctx->button_behavior = behavior;
  24754 }
  24755 NK_API nk_bool
  24756 nk_button_push_behavior(struct nk_context *ctx, enum nk_button_behavior behavior)
  24757 {
  24758     struct nk_config_stack_button_behavior *button_stack;
  24759     struct nk_config_stack_button_behavior_element *element;
  24760 
  24761     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  24762     if (!ctx) return 0;
  24763 
  24764     button_stack = &ctx->stacks.button_behaviors;
  24765     NK_ASSERT(button_stack->head < (int)NK_LEN(button_stack->elements));
  24766     if (button_stack->head >= (int)NK_LEN(button_stack->elements))
  24767         return 0;
  24768 
  24769     element = &button_stack->elements[button_stack->head++];
  24770     element->address = &ctx->button_behavior;
  24771     element->old_value = ctx->button_behavior;
  24772     ctx->button_behavior = behavior;
  24773     return 1;
  24774 }
  24775 NK_API nk_bool
  24776 nk_button_pop_behavior(struct nk_context *ctx)
  24777 {
  24778     struct nk_config_stack_button_behavior *button_stack;
  24779     struct nk_config_stack_button_behavior_element *element;
  24780 
  24781     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  24782     if (!ctx) return 0;
  24783 
  24784     button_stack = &ctx->stacks.button_behaviors;
  24785     NK_ASSERT(button_stack->head > 0);
  24786     if (button_stack->head < 1)
  24787         return 0;
  24788 
  24789     element = &button_stack->elements[--button_stack->head];
  24790     *element->address = element->old_value;
  24791     return 1;
  24792 }

  25033 /* ===============================================================
  25034  *
  25035  *                              TOGGLE
  25036  *
  25037  * ===============================================================*/
  25038 NK_LIB nk_bool
  25039 nk_toggle_behavior(const struct nk_input *in, struct nk_rect select,
  25040     nk_flags *state, nk_bool active)
  25041 {
  25042     nk_widget_state_reset(state);
  25043     if (nk_button_behavior(state, select, in, NK_BUTTON_DEFAULT)) {
  25044         *state = NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVE;
  25045         active = !active;
  25046     }
  25047     if (*state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER && !nk_input_is_mouse_prev_hovering_rect(in, select))
  25048         *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_ENTERED;
  25049     else if (nk_input_is_mouse_prev_hovering_rect(in, select))
  25050         *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_LEFT;
  25051     return active;
  25052 }
  25053 NK_LIB void
  25054 nk_draw_checkbox(struct nk_command_buffer *out,
  25055     nk_flags state, const struct nk_style_toggle *style, nk_bool active,
  25056     const struct nk_rect *label, const struct nk_rect *selector,
  25057     const struct nk_rect *cursors, const char *string, int len,
  25058     const struct nk_user_font *font, nk_flags text_alignment)
  25059 {
  25060     const struct nk_style_item *background;
  25061     const struct nk_style_item *cursor;
  25062     struct nk_text text;
  25063 
  25064     /* select correct colors/images */
  25065     if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER) {
  25066         background = &style->hover;
  25067         cursor = &style->cursor_hover;
  25068         text.text = style->text_hover;
  25069     } else if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED) {
  25070         background = &style->hover;
  25071         cursor = &style->cursor_hover;
  25072         text.text = style->text_active;
  25073     } else {
  25074         background = &style->normal;
  25075         cursor = &style->cursor_normal;
  25076         text.text = style->text_normal;
  25077     }
  25078 
  25079     text.text = nk_rgb_factor(text.text, style->color_factor);
  25080     text.padding.x = 0;
  25081     text.padding.y = 0;
  25082     text.background = style->text_background;
  25083     nk_widget_text(out, *label, string, len, &text, text_alignment, font);
  25084 
  25085     /* draw background and cursor */
  25086     if (background->type == NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR) {
  25087         nk_fill_rect(out, *selector, 0, nk_rgb_factor(style->border_color, style->color_factor));
  25088         nk_fill_rect(out, nk_shrink_rect(*selector, style->border), 0, nk_rgb_factor(background->data.color, style->color_factor));
  25089     } else nk_draw_image(out, *selector, &background->data.image, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  25090     if (active) {
  25091         if (cursor->type == NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE)
  25092             nk_draw_image(out, *cursors, &cursor->data.image, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  25093         else nk_fill_rect(out, *cursors, 0, cursor->data.color);
  25094     }
  25095 }
  25096 NK_LIB void
  25097 nk_draw_option(struct nk_command_buffer *out,
  25098     nk_flags state, const struct nk_style_toggle *style, nk_bool active,
  25099     const struct nk_rect *label, const struct nk_rect *selector,
  25100     const struct nk_rect *cursors, const char *string, int len,
  25101     const struct nk_user_font *font, nk_flags text_alignment)
  25102 {
  25103     const struct nk_style_item *background;
  25104     const struct nk_style_item *cursor;
  25105     struct nk_text text;
  25106 
  25107     /* select correct colors/images */
  25108     if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER) {
  25109         background = &style->hover;
  25110         cursor = &style->cursor_hover;
  25111         text.text = style->text_hover;
  25112     } else if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED) {
  25113         background = &style->hover;
  25114         cursor = &style->cursor_hover;
  25115         text.text = style->text_active;
  25116     } else {
  25117         background = &style->normal;
  25118         cursor = &style->cursor_normal;
  25119         text.text = style->text_normal;
  25120     }
  25121 
  25122     text.text = nk_rgb_factor(text.text, style->color_factor);
  25123     text.padding.x = 0;
  25124     text.padding.y = 0;
  25125     text.background = style->text_background;
  25126     nk_widget_text(out, *label, string, len, &text, text_alignment, font);
  25127 
  25128     /* draw background and cursor */
  25129     if (background->type == NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR) {
  25130         nk_fill_circle(out, *selector, nk_rgb_factor(style->border_color, style->color_factor));
  25131         nk_fill_circle(out, nk_shrink_rect(*selector, style->border), nk_rgb_factor(background->data.color, style->color_factor));
  25132     } else nk_draw_image(out, *selector, &background->data.image, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  25133     if (active) {
  25134         if (cursor->type == NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE)
  25135             nk_draw_image(out, *cursors, &cursor->data.image, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  25136         else nk_fill_circle(out, *cursors, cursor->data.color);
  25137     }
  25138 }
  25139 NK_LIB nk_bool
  25140 nk_do_toggle(nk_flags *state,
  25141     struct nk_command_buffer *out, struct nk_rect r,
  25142     nk_bool *active, const char *str, int len, enum nk_toggle_type type,
  25143     const struct nk_style_toggle *style, const struct nk_input *in,
  25144     const struct nk_user_font *font, nk_flags widget_alignment, nk_flags text_alignment)
  25145 {
  25146     int was_active;
  25147     struct nk_rect bounds;
  25148     struct nk_rect select;
  25149     struct nk_rect cursor;
  25150     struct nk_rect label;
  25151 
  25152     NK_ASSERT(style);
  25153     NK_ASSERT(out);
  25154     NK_ASSERT(font);
  25155     if (!out || !style || !font || !active)
  25156         return 0;
  25157 
  25158     r.w = NK_MAX(r.w, font->height + 2 * style->padding.x);
  25159     r.h = NK_MAX(r.h, font->height + 2 * style->padding.y);
  25160 
  25161     /* add additional touch padding for touch screen devices */
  25162     bounds.x = r.x - style->touch_padding.x;
  25163     bounds.y = r.y - style->touch_padding.y;
  25164     bounds.w = r.w + 2 * style->touch_padding.x;
  25165     bounds.h = r.h + 2 * style->touch_padding.y;
  25166 
  25167     /* calculate the selector space */
  25168     select.w = font->height;
  25169     select.h = select.w;
  25170 
  25171     if (widget_alignment & NK_WIDGET_ALIGN_RIGHT) {
  25172         select.x = r.x + r.w - font->height;
  25173 
  25174         /* label in front of the selector */
  25175         label.x = r.x;
  25176         label.w = r.w - select.w - style->spacing * 2;
  25177     } else if (widget_alignment & NK_WIDGET_ALIGN_CENTERED) {
  25178         select.x = r.x + (r.w - select.w) / 2;
  25179 
  25180         /* label in front of selector */
  25181         label.x = r.x;
  25182         label.w = (r.w - select.w - style->spacing * 2) / 2;
  25183     } else { /* Default: NK_WIDGET_ALIGN_LEFT */
  25184         select.x = r.x;
  25185 
  25186         /* label behind the selector */
  25187         label.x = select.x + select.w + style->spacing;
  25188         label.w = NK_MAX(r.x + r.w, label.x) - label.x;
  25189     }
  25190 
  25191     if (widget_alignment & NK_WIDGET_ALIGN_TOP) {
  25192         select.y = r.y;
  25193     } else if (widget_alignment & NK_WIDGET_ALIGN_BOTTOM) {
  25194         select.y = r.y + r.h - select.h - 2 * style->padding.y;
  25195     } else { /* Default: NK_WIDGET_ALIGN_MIDDLE */
  25196         select.y = r.y + r.h/2.0f - select.h/2.0f;
  25197     }
  25198 
  25199     label.y = select.y;
  25200     label.h = select.w;
  25201 
  25202     /* calculate the bounds of the cursor inside the selector */
  25203     cursor.x = select.x + style->padding.x + style->border;
  25204     cursor.y = select.y + style->padding.y + style->border;
  25205     cursor.w = select.w - (2 * style->padding.x + 2 * style->border);
  25206     cursor.h = select.h - (2 * style->padding.y + 2 * style->border);
  25207 
  25208     /* update selector */
  25209     was_active = *active;
  25210     *active = nk_toggle_behavior(in, bounds, state, *active);
  25211 
  25212     /* draw selector */
  25213     if (style->draw_begin)
  25214         style->draw_begin(out, style->userdata);
  25215     if (type == NK_TOGGLE_CHECK) {
  25216         nk_draw_checkbox(out, *state, style, *active, &label, &select, &cursor, str, len, font, text_alignment);
  25217     } else {
  25218         nk_draw_option(out, *state, style, *active, &label, &select, &cursor, str, len, font, text_alignment);
  25219     }
  25220     if (style->draw_end)
  25221         style->draw_end(out, style->userdata);
  25222     return (was_active != *active);
  25223 }

  25229 NK_API nk_bool
  25230 nk_check_text(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *text, int len, nk_bool active)
  25231 {
  25232     struct nk_window *win;
  25233     struct nk_panel *layout;
  25234     const struct nk_input *in;
  25235     const struct nk_style *style;
  25236 
  25237     struct nk_rect bounds;
  25238     enum nk_widget_layout_states state;
  25239 
  25240     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  25241     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  25242     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  25243     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout)
  25244         return active;
  25245 
  25246     win = ctx->current;
  25247     style = &ctx->style;
  25248     layout = win->layout;
  25249 
  25250     state = nk_widget(&bounds, ctx);
  25251     if (!state) return active;
  25252     in = (state == NK_WIDGET_ROM || state == NK_WIDGET_DISABLED || layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_ROM) ? 0 : &ctx->input;
  25253     nk_do_toggle(&ctx->last_widget_state, &win->buffer, bounds, &active,
  25254         text, len, NK_TOGGLE_CHECK, &style->checkbox, in, style->font, NK_WIDGET_LEFT, NK_TEXT_LEFT);
  25255     return active;
  25256 }

  25285 NK_API unsigned int
  25286 nk_check_flags_text(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *text, int len,
  25287     unsigned int flags, unsigned int value)
  25288 {
  25289     int old_active;
  25290     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  25291     NK_ASSERT(text);
  25292     if (!ctx || !text) return flags;
  25293     old_active = (int)((flags & value) & value);
  25294     if (nk_check_text(ctx, text, len, old_active))
  25295         flags |= value;
  25296     else flags &= ~value;
  25297     return flags;
  25298 }
  25299 NK_API nk_bool
  25300 nk_checkbox_text(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *text, int len, nk_bool *active)
  25301 {
  25302     int old_val;
  25303     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  25304     NK_ASSERT(text);
  25305     NK_ASSERT(active);
  25306     if (!ctx || !text || !active) return 0;
  25307     old_val = *active;
  25308     *active = nk_check_text(ctx, text, len, *active);
  25309     return old_val != *active;
  25310 }
  25311 NK_API nk_bool
  25312 nk_checkbox_text_align(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *text, int len, nk_bool *active, nk_flags widget_alignment, nk_flags text_alignment)

  25319     old_val = *active;

  25321     return old_val != *active;
  25322 }
  25323 NK_API nk_bool
  25324 nk_checkbox_flags_text(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *text, int len,
  25325     unsigned int *flags, unsigned int value)
  25326 {
  25327     nk_bool active;
  25328     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  25329     NK_ASSERT(text);
  25330     NK_ASSERT(flags);
  25331     if (!ctx || !text || !flags) return 0;
  25332 
  25333     active = (int)((*flags & value) & value);
  25334     if (nk_checkbox_text(ctx, text, len, &active)) {
  25335         if (active) *flags |= value;
  25336         else *flags &= ~value;
  25337         return 1;
  25338     }
  25339     return 0;
  25340 }

  25473 /* ===============================================================
  25474  *
  25475  *                              SELECTABLE
  25476  *
  25477  * ===============================================================*/
  25478 NK_LIB void
  25479 nk_draw_selectable(struct nk_command_buffer *out,
  25480     nk_flags state, const struct nk_style_selectable *style, nk_bool active,
  25481     const struct nk_rect *bounds,
  25482     const struct nk_rect *icon, const struct nk_image *img, enum nk_symbol_type sym,
  25483     const char *string, int len, nk_flags align, const struct nk_user_font *font)
  25484 {
  25485     const struct nk_style_item *background;
  25486     struct nk_text text;
  25487     text.padding = style->padding;
  25488 
  25489     /* select correct colors/images */
  25490     if (!active) {
  25491         if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED) {
  25492             background = &style->pressed;
  25493             text.text = style->text_pressed;
  25494         } else if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER) {
  25495             background = &style->hover;
  25496             text.text = style->text_hover;
  25497         } else {
  25498             background = &style->normal;
  25499             text.text = style->text_normal;
  25500         }
  25501     } else {
  25502         if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED) {
  25503             background = &style->pressed_active;
  25504             text.text = style->text_pressed_active;
  25505         } else if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER) {
  25506             background = &style->hover_active;
  25507             text.text = style->text_hover_active;
  25508         } else {
  25509             background = &style->normal_active;
  25510             text.text = style->text_normal_active;
  25511         }
  25512     }
  25513 
  25514     text.text = nk_rgb_factor(text.text, style->color_factor);
  25515 
  25516     /* draw selectable background and text */
  25517     switch (background->type) {
  25518         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE:
  25519             text.background = nk_rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
  25520             nk_draw_image(out, *bounds, &background->data.image, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  25521             break;
  25522         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_NINE_SLICE:
  25523             text.background = nk_rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
  25524             nk_draw_nine_slice(out, *bounds, &background->data.slice, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  25525             break;
  25526         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR:
  25527             text.background = background->data.color;
  25528             nk_fill_rect(out, *bounds, style->rounding, background->data.color);
  25529             break;
  25530     }
  25531     if (icon) {
  25532         if (img) nk_draw_image(out, *icon, img, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  25533         else nk_draw_symbol(out, sym, *icon, text.background, text.text, 1, font);
  25534     }
  25535     nk_widget_text(out, *bounds, string, len, &text, align, font);
  25536 }
  25537 NK_LIB nk_bool
  25538 nk_do_selectable(nk_flags *state, struct nk_command_buffer *out,
  25539     struct nk_rect bounds, const char *str, int len, nk_flags align, nk_bool *value,
  25540     const struct nk_style_selectable *style, const struct nk_input *in,
  25541     const struct nk_user_font *font)
  25542 {
  25543     int old_value;
  25544     struct nk_rect touch;
  25545 
  25546     NK_ASSERT(state);
  25547     NK_ASSERT(out);
  25548     NK_ASSERT(str);
  25549     NK_ASSERT(len);
  25550     NK_ASSERT(value);
  25551     NK_ASSERT(style);
  25552     NK_ASSERT(font);
  25553 
  25554     if (!state || !out || !str || !len || !value || !style || !font) return 0;
  25555     old_value = *value;
  25556 
  25557     /* remove padding */
  25558     touch.x = bounds.x - style->touch_padding.x;
  25559     touch.y = bounds.y - style->touch_padding.y;
  25560     touch.w = bounds.w + style->touch_padding.x * 2;
  25561     touch.h = bounds.h + style->touch_padding.y * 2;
  25562 
  25563     /* update button */
  25564     if (nk_button_behavior(state, touch, in, NK_BUTTON_DEFAULT))
  25565         *value = !(*value);
  25566 
  25567     /* draw selectable */
  25568     if (style->draw_begin) style->draw_begin(out, style->userdata);
  25569     nk_draw_selectable(out, *state, style, *value, &bounds, 0,0,NK_SYMBOL_NONE, str, len, align, font);
  25570     if (style->draw_end) style->draw_end(out, style->userdata);
  25571     return old_value != *value;
  25572 }
  25573 NK_LIB nk_bool
  25574 nk_do_selectable_image(nk_flags *state, struct nk_command_buffer *out,
  25575     struct nk_rect bounds, const char *str, int len, nk_flags align, nk_bool *value,
  25576     const struct nk_image *img, const struct nk_style_selectable *style,
  25577     const struct nk_input *in, const struct nk_user_font *font)
  25578 {
  25579     nk_bool old_value;
  25580     struct nk_rect touch;
  25581     struct nk_rect icon;
  25582 
  25583     NK_ASSERT(state);
  25584     NK_ASSERT(out);
  25585     NK_ASSERT(str);
  25586     NK_ASSERT(len);
  25587     NK_ASSERT(value);
  25588     NK_ASSERT(style);
  25589     NK_ASSERT(font);
  25590 
  25591     if (!state || !out || !str || !len || !value || !style || !font) return 0;
  25592     old_value = *value;
  25593 
  25594     /* toggle behavior */
  25595     touch.x = bounds.x - style->touch_padding.x;
  25596     touch.y = bounds.y - style->touch_padding.y;
  25597     touch.w = bounds.w + style->touch_padding.x * 2;
  25598     touch.h = bounds.h + style->touch_padding.y * 2;
  25599     if (nk_button_behavior(state, touch, in, NK_BUTTON_DEFAULT))
  25600         *value = !(*value);
  25601 
  25602     icon.y = bounds.y + style->padding.y;
  25603     icon.w = icon.h = bounds.h - 2 * style->padding.y;
  25604     if (align & NK_TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT) {
  25605         icon.x = (bounds.x + bounds.w) - (2 * style->padding.x + icon.w);
  25606         icon.x = NK_MAX(icon.x, 0);
  25607     } else icon.x = bounds.x + 2 * style->padding.x;
  25608 
  25609     icon.x += style->image_padding.x;
  25610     icon.y += style->image_padding.y;
  25611     icon.w -= 2 * style->image_padding.x;
  25612     icon.h -= 2 * style->image_padding.y;
  25613 
  25614     /* draw selectable */
  25615     if (style->draw_begin) style->draw_begin(out, style->userdata);
  25616     nk_draw_selectable(out, *state, style, *value, &bounds, &icon, img, NK_SYMBOL_NONE, str, len, align, font);
  25617     if (style->draw_end) style->draw_end(out, style->userdata);
  25618     return old_value != *value;
  25619 }
  25620 NK_LIB nk_bool
  25621 nk_do_selectable_symbol(nk_flags *state, struct nk_command_buffer *out,
  25622     struct nk_rect bounds, const char *str, int len, nk_flags align, nk_bool *value,
  25623     enum nk_symbol_type sym, const struct nk_style_selectable *style,
  25624     const struct nk_input *in, const struct nk_user_font *font)

  25646     if (nk_button_behavior(state, touch, in, NK_BUTTON_DEFAULT))

  25648 
  25649     icon.y = bounds.y + style->padding.y;
  25650     icon.w = icon.h = bounds.h - 2 * style->padding.y;

  25655

  25660

  25662     if (style->draw_begin) style->draw_begin(out, style->userdata);
  25663     nk_draw_selectable(out, *state, style, *value, &bounds, &icon, 0, sym, str, len, align, font);
  25664     if (style->draw_end) style->draw_end(out, style->userdata);

  25698 nk_selectable_image_text(struct nk_context *ctx, struct nk_image img,

  25700 {
  25701     struct nk_window *win;

  25722     in = (state == NK_WIDGET_ROM || state == NK_WIDGET_DISABLED || layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_ROM) ? 0 : &ctx->input;
  25723     return nk_do_selectable_image(&ctx->last_widget_state, &win->buffer, bounds,
  25724                 str, len, align, value, &img, &style->selectable, in, style->font);
  25725 }
  25726 NK_API nk_bool
  25727 nk_selectable_symbol_text(struct nk_context *ctx, enum nk_symbol_type sym,
  25728     const char *str, int len, nk_flags align, nk_bool *value)
  25729 {
  25730     struct nk_window *win;
  25731     struct nk_panel *layout;

  25733     const struct nk_style *style;
  25734 
  25735     enum nk_widget_layout_states state;
  25736     struct nk_rect bounds;
  25737 
  25738     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  25739     NK_ASSERT(value);
  25740     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  25741     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  25742     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout || !value)
  25743         return 0;
  25744 
  25745     win = ctx->current;
  25746     layout = win->layout;
  25747     style = &ctx->style;
  25748 
  25749     state = nk_widget(&bounds, ctx);
  25750     if (!state) return 0;
  25751     in = (state == NK_WIDGET_ROM || state == NK_WIDGET_DISABLED || layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_ROM) ? 0 : &ctx->input;
  25752     return nk_do_selectable_symbol(&ctx->last_widget_state, &win->buffer, bounds,
  25753                 str, len, align, value, sym, &style->selectable, in, style->font);
  25754 }

  25806 /* ===============================================================
  25807  *
  25808  *                              SLIDER
  25809  *
  25810  * ===============================================================*/
  25811 NK_LIB float
  25812 nk_slider_behavior(nk_flags *state, struct nk_rect *logical_cursor,
  25813     struct nk_rect *visual_cursor, struct nk_input *in,
  25814     struct nk_rect bounds, float slider_min, float slider_max, float slider_value,
  25815     float slider_step, float slider_steps)
  25816 {
  25817     int left_mouse_down;
  25818     int left_mouse_click_in_cursor;
  25819 
  25820     /* check if visual cursor is being dragged */
  25821     nk_widget_state_reset(state);
  25822     left_mouse_down = in && in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].down;
  25823     left_mouse_click_in_cursor = in && nk_input_has_mouse_click_down_in_rect(in,
  25824             NK_BUTTON_LEFT, *visual_cursor, nk_true);
  25825 
  25826     if (left_mouse_down && left_mouse_click_in_cursor) {
  25827         float ratio = 0;
  25828         const float d = in->mouse.pos.x - (visual_cursor->x+visual_cursor->w*0.5f);
  25829         const float pxstep = bounds.w / slider_steps;
  25830 
  25831         /* only update value if the next slider step is reached */
  25832         *state = NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVE;
  25833         if (NK_ABS(d) >= pxstep) {
  25834             const float steps = (float)((int)(NK_ABS(d) / pxstep));
  25835             slider_value += (d > 0) ? (slider_step*steps) : -(slider_step*steps);
  25836             slider_value = NK_CLAMP(slider_min, slider_value, slider_max);
  25837             ratio = (slider_value - slider_min)/slider_step;
  25838             logical_cursor->x = bounds.x + (logical_cursor->w * ratio);
  25839             in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].clicked_pos.x = logical_cursor->x;
  25840         }
  25841     }
  25842 
  25843     /* slider widget state */
  25844     if (nk_input_is_mouse_hovering_rect(in, bounds))
  25845         *state = NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVERED;
  25846     if (*state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER &&
  25847         !nk_input_is_mouse_prev_hovering_rect(in, bounds))
  25848         *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_ENTERED;
  25849     else if (nk_input_is_mouse_prev_hovering_rect(in, bounds))
  25850         *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_LEFT;
  25851     return slider_value;
  25852 }
  25853 NK_LIB void
  25854 nk_draw_slider(struct nk_command_buffer *out, nk_flags state,
  25855     const struct nk_style_slider *style, const struct nk_rect *bounds,
  25856     const struct nk_rect *visual_cursor, float min, float value, float max)
  25857 {
  25858     struct nk_rect fill;
  25859     struct nk_rect bar;
  25860     const struct nk_style_item *background;
  25861 
  25862     /* select correct slider images/colors */
  25863     struct nk_color bar_color;
  25864     const struct nk_style_item *cursor;
  25865 
  25866     NK_UNUSED(min);
  25867     NK_UNUSED(max);
  25868     NK_UNUSED(value);
  25869 
  25870     if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED) {
  25871         background = &style->active;
  25872         bar_color = style->bar_active;
  25873         cursor = &style->cursor_active;
  25874     } else if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER) {
  25875         background = &style->hover;
  25876         bar_color = style->bar_hover;
  25877         cursor = &style->cursor_hover;
  25878     } else {
  25879         background = &style->normal;
  25880         bar_color = style->bar_normal;
  25881         cursor = &style->cursor_normal;
  25882     }
  25883 
  25884     /* calculate slider background bar */
  25885     bar.x = bounds->x;
  25886     bar.y = (visual_cursor->y + visual_cursor->h/2) - bounds->h/12;
  25887     bar.w = bounds->w;
  25888     bar.h = bounds->h/6;
  25889 
  25890     /* filled background bar style */
  25891     fill.w = (visual_cursor->x + (visual_cursor->w/2.0f)) - bar.x;
  25892     fill.x = bar.x;
  25893     fill.y = bar.y;
  25894     fill.h = bar.h;
  25895 
  25896     /* draw background */
  25897     switch(background->type) {
  25898         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE:
  25899             nk_draw_image(out, *bounds, &background->data.image, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  25900             break;
  25901         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_NINE_SLICE:
  25902             nk_draw_nine_slice(out, *bounds, &background->data.slice, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  25903             break;
  25904         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR:
  25905             nk_fill_rect(out, *bounds, style->rounding, nk_rgb_factor(background->data.color, style->color_factor));
  25906             nk_stroke_rect(out, *bounds, style->rounding, style->border, nk_rgb_factor(style->border_color, style->color_factor));
  25907             break;
  25908     }
  25909 
  25910     /* draw slider bar */
  25911     nk_fill_rect(out, bar, style->rounding, nk_rgb_factor(bar_color, style->color_factor));
  25912     nk_fill_rect(out, fill, style->rounding, nk_rgb_factor(style->bar_filled, style->color_factor));
  25913 
  25914     /* draw cursor */
  25915     if (cursor->type == NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE)
  25916         nk_draw_image(out, *visual_cursor, &cursor->data.image, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  25917     else
  25918         nk_fill_circle(out, *visual_cursor, nk_rgb_factor(cursor->data.color, style->color_factor));
  25919 }
  25920 NK_LIB float
  25921 nk_do_slider(nk_flags *state,
  25922     struct nk_command_buffer *out, struct nk_rect bounds,
  25923     float min, float val, float max, float step,
  25924     const struct nk_style_slider *style, struct nk_input *in,
  25925     const struct nk_user_font *font)
  25926 {
  25927     float slider_range;
  25928     float slider_min;
  25929     float slider_max;
  25930     float slider_value;
  25931     float slider_steps;
  25932     float cursor_offset;
  25933 
  25934     struct nk_rect visual_cursor;
  25935     struct nk_rect logical_cursor;
  25936 
  25937     NK_ASSERT(style);
  25938     NK_ASSERT(out);
  25939     if (!out || !style)
  25940         return 0;
  25941 
  25942     /* remove padding from slider bounds */
  25943     bounds.x = bounds.x + style->padding.x;
  25944     bounds.y = bounds.y + style->padding.y;
  25945     bounds.h = NK_MAX(bounds.h, 2*style->padding.y);
  25946     bounds.w = NK_MAX(bounds.w, 2*style->padding.x + style->cursor_size.x);
  25947     bounds.w -= 2 * style->padding.x;
  25948     bounds.h -= 2 * style->padding.y;
  25949 
  25950     /* optional buttons */
  25951     if (style->show_buttons) {
  25952         nk_flags ws;
  25953         struct nk_rect button;
  25954         button.y = bounds.y;
  25955         button.w = bounds.h;
  25956         button.h = bounds.h;
  25957 
  25958         /* decrement button */
  25959         button.x = bounds.x;
  25960         if (nk_do_button_symbol(&ws, out, button, style->dec_symbol, NK_BUTTON_DEFAULT,
  25961             &style->dec_button, in, font))
  25962             val -= step;
  25963 
  25964         /* increment button */
  25965         button.x = (bounds.x + bounds.w) - button.w;
  25966         if (nk_do_button_symbol(&ws, out, button, style->inc_symbol, NK_BUTTON_DEFAULT,
  25967             &style->inc_button, in, font))
  25968             val += step;
  25969 
  25970         bounds.x = bounds.x + button.w + style->spacing.x;
  25971         bounds.w = bounds.w - (2*button.w + 2*style->spacing.x);
  25972     }
  25973 
  25974     /* remove one cursor size to support visual cursor */
  25975     bounds.x += style->cursor_size.x*0.5f;
  25976     bounds.w -= style->cursor_size.x;
  25977 
  25978     /* make sure the provided values are correct */
  25979     slider_max = NK_MAX(min, max);
  25980     slider_min = NK_MIN(min, max);
  25981     slider_value = NK_CLAMP(slider_min, val, slider_max);
  25982     slider_range = slider_max - slider_min;
  25983     slider_steps = slider_range / step;
  25984     cursor_offset = (slider_value - slider_min) / step;
  25985 
  25986     /* calculate cursor
  25987     Basically you have two cursors. One for visual representation and interaction
  25988     and one for updating the actual cursor value. */
  25989     logical_cursor.h = bounds.h;
  25990     logical_cursor.w = bounds.w / slider_steps;
  25991     logical_cursor.x = bounds.x + (logical_cursor.w * cursor_offset);
  25992     logical_cursor.y = bounds.y;
  25993 
  25994     visual_cursor.h = style->cursor_size.y;
  25995     visual_cursor.w = style->cursor_size.x;
  25996     visual_cursor.y = (bounds.y + bounds.h*0.5f) - visual_cursor.h*0.5f;
  25997     visual_cursor.x = logical_cursor.x - visual_cursor.w*0.5f;
  25998 
  25999     slider_value = nk_slider_behavior(state, &logical_cursor, &visual_cursor,
  26000         in, bounds, slider_min, slider_max, slider_value, step, slider_steps);
  26001     visual_cursor.x = logical_cursor.x - visual_cursor.w*0.5f;
  26002 
  26003     /* draw slider */
  26004     if (style->draw_begin) style->draw_begin(out, style->userdata);
  26005     nk_draw_slider(out, *state, style, &bounds, &visual_cursor, slider_min, slider_value, slider_max);
  26006     if (style->draw_end) style->draw_end(out, style->userdata);
  26007     return slider_value;
  26008 }
  26009 NK_API nk_bool
  26010 nk_slider_float(struct nk_context *ctx, float min_value, float *value, float max_value,
  26011     float value_step)
  26012 {
  26013     struct nk_window *win;
  26014     struct nk_panel *layout;
  26015     struct nk_input *in;
  26016     const struct nk_style *style;
  26017 
  26018     int ret = 0;
  26019     float old_value;
  26020     struct nk_rect bounds;
  26021     enum nk_widget_layout_states state;
  26022 
  26023     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  26024     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  26025     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  26026     NK_ASSERT(value);
  26027     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout || !value)
  26028         return ret;
  26029 
  26030     win = ctx->current;
  26031     style = &ctx->style;
  26032     layout = win->layout;
  26033 
  26034     state = nk_widget(&bounds, ctx);
  26035     if (!state) return ret;
  26036     in = (/*state == NK_WIDGET_ROM || */ state == NK_WIDGET_DISABLED || layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_ROM) ? 0 : &ctx->input;
  26037 
  26038     old_value = *value;
  26039     *value = nk_do_slider(&ctx->last_widget_state, &win->buffer, bounds, min_value,
  26040                 old_value, max_value, value_step, &style->slider, in, style->font);
  26041     return (old_value > *value || old_value < *value);
  26042 }
  26043 NK_API float
  26044 nk_slide_float(struct nk_context *ctx, float min, float val, float max, float step)
  26045 {
  26046     nk_slider_float(ctx, min, &val, max, step); return val;
  26047 }
  26048 NK_API int
  26049 nk_slide_int(struct nk_context *ctx, int min, int val, int max, int step)
  26050 {
  26051     float value = (float)val;
  26052     nk_slider_float(ctx, (float)min, &value, (float)max, (float)step);
  26053     return (int)value;
  26054 }
  26055 NK_API nk_bool
  26056 nk_slider_int(struct nk_context *ctx, int min, int *val, int max, int step)
  26057 {
  26058     int ret;
  26059     float value = (float)*val;
  26060     ret = nk_slider_float(ctx, (float)min, &value, (float)max, (float)step);
  26061     *val =  (int)value;
  26062     return ret;
  26063 }
