  26069 /* ===============================================================
  26070  *
  26071  *                               KNOB
  26072  *
  26073  * ===============================================================*/
  26074 
  26075 NK_LIB float
  26076 nk_knob_behavior(nk_flags *state, struct nk_input *in,
  26077     struct nk_rect bounds, float knob_min, float knob_max, float knob_value,
  26078     float knob_step, float knob_steps,
  26079     enum nk_heading zero_direction, float dead_zone_percent)
  26080 {
  26081     struct nk_vec2 origin;
  26082     float angle = 0.0f;
  26083     origin.x = bounds.x + (bounds.w / 2);
  26084     origin.y = bounds.y + (bounds.h / 2);
  26085 
  26086     nk_widget_state_reset(state);
  26087 
  26088     /* handle click and drag input */
  26089     if(in &&
  26090        in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].down &&
  26091        nk_input_has_mouse_click_down_in_rect(in, NK_BUTTON_LEFT, bounds, nk_true)){
  26092         /* calculate angle from origin and rotate */
  26093         const float direction_rads[4] = {
  26094             NK_PI * 2.5f, /* 90  NK_UP */
  26095             NK_PI * 2.0f, /* 0   NK_RIGHT */
  26096             NK_PI * 1.5f, /* 270 NK_DOWN */
  26097             NK_PI,        /* 180 NK_LEFT */
  26098         };
  26099         *state = NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVE;
  26100 
  26101         angle = NK_ATAN2(in->mouse.pos.y - origin.y, in->mouse.pos.x - origin.x) + direction_rads[zero_direction];
  26102         angle -= (angle > NK_PI * 2) ? NK_PI * 3 : NK_PI;
  26103 
  26104         /* account for dead space applied when drawing */
  26105         angle *= 1.0f / (1.0f - dead_zone_percent);
  26106         angle = NK_CLAMP(-NK_PI, angle, NK_PI);
  26107 
  26108         /* convert -pi -> pi range to 0.0 -> 1.0 */
  26109         angle = (angle + NK_PI) / (NK_PI * 2);
  26110 
  26111         /* click to closest step */
  26112         knob_value = knob_min + ( (int)(angle * knob_steps + (knob_step / 2)) ) * knob_step;
  26113         knob_value = NK_CLAMP(knob_min, knob_value, knob_max);
  26114     }
  26115 
  26116     /* knob widget state */
  26117     if (nk_input_is_mouse_hovering_rect(in, bounds)){
  26118         *state = NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVERED;
  26119         /* handle scroll and arrow inputs */
  26120         if (in->mouse.scroll_delta.y > 0 ||
  26121            (in->keyboard.keys[NK_KEY_UP].down && in->keyboard.keys[NK_KEY_UP].clicked)) {
  26122             knob_value += knob_step;
  26123         }
  26124 
  26125         if (in->mouse.scroll_delta.y < 0 ||
  26126            (in->keyboard.keys[NK_KEY_DOWN].down && in->keyboard.keys[NK_KEY_DOWN].clicked)) {
  26127             knob_value -= knob_step;
  26128         }
  26129         /* easiest way to disable scrolling of parent panels..knob eats scrolling */
  26130         in->mouse.scroll_delta.y = 0;
  26131         knob_value = NK_CLAMP(knob_min, knob_value, knob_max);
  26132     }
  26133     if (*state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER &&
  26134         !nk_input_is_mouse_prev_hovering_rect(in, bounds))
  26135         *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_ENTERED;
  26136     else if (nk_input_is_mouse_prev_hovering_rect(in, bounds))
  26137         *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_LEFT;
  26138 
  26139     return knob_value;
  26140 }
  26141 NK_LIB void
  26142 nk_draw_knob(struct nk_command_buffer *out, nk_flags state,
  26143     const struct nk_style_knob *style, const struct nk_rect *bounds, float min, float value, float max,
  26144     enum nk_heading zero_direction, float dead_zone_percent)
  26145 {
  26146     const struct nk_style_item *background;
  26147     struct nk_color knob_color, cursor;
  26148 
  26149     NK_UNUSED(min);
  26150     NK_UNUSED(max);
  26151     NK_UNUSED(value);
  26152 
  26153     if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED) {
  26154         background = &style->active;
  26155         knob_color = style->knob_active;
  26156         cursor = style->cursor_active;
  26157     } else if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER) {
  26158         background = &style->hover;
  26159         knob_color = style->knob_hover;
  26160         cursor = style->cursor_hover;
  26161     } else {
  26162         background = &style->normal;
  26163         knob_color = style->knob_normal;
  26164         cursor = style->cursor_normal;
  26165     }
  26166 
  26167     /* draw background */
  26168     switch(background->type) {
  26169         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE:
  26170             nk_draw_image(out, *bounds, &background->data.image, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  26171             break;
  26172         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_NINE_SLICE:
  26173             nk_draw_nine_slice(out, *bounds, &background->data.slice, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  26174             break;
  26175         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR:
  26176             nk_fill_rect(out, *bounds, 0, nk_rgb_factor(background->data.color, style->color_factor));
  26177             nk_stroke_rect(out, *bounds, 0, style->border, nk_rgb_factor(style->border_color, style->color_factor));
  26178             break;
  26179     }
  26180 
  26181     /* draw knob */
  26182     nk_fill_circle(out, *bounds, nk_rgb_factor(knob_color, style->color_factor));
  26183     if(style->knob_border > 0){
  26184         struct nk_rect border_bounds = *bounds;
  26185         border_bounds.x += style->knob_border / 2;
  26186         border_bounds.y += style->knob_border / 2;
  26187         border_bounds.w -= style->knob_border;
  26188         border_bounds.h -= style->knob_border;
  26189         nk_stroke_circle(out, border_bounds, style->knob_border, nk_rgb_factor(style->knob_border_color, style->color_factor));
  26190     }
  26191     { /* calculate cursor line cords */
  26192     float half_circle_size = (bounds->w / 2);
  26193     float angle = (value - min) / (max - min);
  26194     float alive_zone =  1.0f - dead_zone_percent;
  26195     struct nk_vec2 cursor_start, cursor_end;
  26196     const float direction_rads[4] = {
  26197         NK_PI * 1.5f, /* 90  NK_UP */
  26198         0.0f,         /* 0   NK_RIGHT */
  26199         NK_PI * 0.5f, /* 270 NK_DOWN */
  26200         NK_PI,        /* 180 NK_LEFT */
  26201     };
  26202     /* calculate + apply dead zone */
  26203     angle = (angle * alive_zone) + (dead_zone_percent / 2);
  26204 
  26205     /* percentage 0.0 -> 1.0 to radians, rads are 0.0 to (2*pi) NOT -pi to pi */
  26206     angle *= NK_PI * 2;
  26207 
  26208     /* apply zero angle */
  26209     angle += direction_rads[zero_direction];
  26210     if(angle > NK_PI * 2)
  26211         angle -= NK_PI * 2;
  26212 
  26213     cursor_start.x = bounds->x + half_circle_size + (angle > NK_PI);
  26214     cursor_start.y = bounds->y + half_circle_size + (angle < NK_PI_HALF || angle > (NK_PI * 1.5f));
  26215 
  26216     cursor_end.x = cursor_start.x + (half_circle_size * NK_COS(angle));
  26217     cursor_end.y = cursor_start.y + (half_circle_size * NK_SIN(angle));
  26218 
  26219     /* cut off half of the cursor */
  26220     cursor_start.x = (cursor_start.x + cursor_end.x) / 2;
  26221     cursor_start.y = (cursor_start.y + cursor_end.y) / 2;
  26222 
  26223     /* draw cursor */
  26224     nk_stroke_line(out, cursor_start.x, cursor_start.y, cursor_end.x, cursor_end.y, 2, nk_rgb_factor(cursor, style->color_factor));
  26225     }
  26226 }
  26227 NK_LIB float
  26228 nk_do_knob(nk_flags *state,
  26229     struct nk_command_buffer *out, struct nk_rect bounds,
  26230     float min, float val, float max, float step,
  26231     enum nk_heading zero_direction, float dead_zone_percent,
  26232     const struct nk_style_knob *style, struct nk_input *in)
  26233 {
  26234     float knob_range;
  26235     float knob_min;
  26236     float knob_max;
  26237     float knob_value;
  26238     float knob_steps;
  26239 
  26240     NK_ASSERT(style);
  26241     NK_ASSERT(out);
  26242     if (!out || !style)
  26243         return 0;
  26244 
  26245     /* remove padding from knob bounds */
  26246     bounds.y = bounds.y + style->padding.y;
  26247     bounds.x = bounds.x + style->padding.x;
  26248     bounds.h = NK_MAX(bounds.h, 2*style->padding.y);
  26249     bounds.w = NK_MAX(bounds.w, 2*style->padding.x);
  26250     bounds.w -= 2 * style->padding.x;
  26251     bounds.h -= 2 * style->padding.y;
  26252     if(bounds.h < bounds.w){
  26253         bounds.x += (bounds.w - bounds.h) / 2;
  26254         bounds.w = bounds.h;
  26255     }
  26256 
  26257     /* make sure the provided values are correct */
  26258     knob_max = NK_MAX(min, max);
  26259     knob_min = NK_MIN(min, max);
  26260     knob_value = NK_CLAMP(knob_min, val, knob_max);
  26261     knob_range = knob_max - knob_min;
  26262     knob_steps = knob_range / step;
  26263 
  26264     knob_value = nk_knob_behavior(state, in, bounds, knob_min, knob_max, knob_value, step, knob_steps, zero_direction, dead_zone_percent);
  26265 
  26266     /* draw knob */
  26267     if (style->draw_begin) style->draw_begin(out, style->userdata);
  26268     nk_draw_knob(out, *state, style, &bounds, knob_min, knob_value, knob_max, zero_direction, dead_zone_percent);
  26269     if (style->draw_end) style->draw_end(out, style->userdata);
  26270     return knob_value;
  26271 }
  26272 NK_API nk_bool
  26273 nk_knob_float(struct nk_context *ctx, float min_value, float *value, float max_value,
  26274     float value_step, enum nk_heading zero_direction, float dead_zone_degrees)
  26275 {
  26276     struct nk_window *win;
  26277     struct nk_panel *layout;
  26278     struct nk_input *in;
  26279     const struct nk_style *style;
  26280 
  26281     int ret = 0;
  26282     float old_value;
  26283     struct nk_rect bounds;
  26284     enum nk_widget_layout_states state;
  26285 
  26286     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  26287     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  26288     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  26289     NK_ASSERT(value);
  26290     NK_ASSERT(NK_BETWEEN(dead_zone_degrees, 0.0f, 360.0f));
  26291     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout || !value)
  26292         return ret;
  26293 
  26294     win = ctx->current;
  26295     style = &ctx->style;
  26296     layout = win->layout;
  26297 
  26298     state = nk_widget(&bounds, ctx);
  26299     if (!state) return ret;
  26300     in = (state == NK_WIDGET_DISABLED || layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_ROM) ? 0 : &ctx->input;
  26301 
  26302     old_value = *value;
  26303     *value = nk_do_knob(&ctx->last_widget_state, &win->buffer, bounds, min_value,
  26304                 old_value, max_value, value_step, zero_direction, dead_zone_degrees / 360.0f, &style->knob, in);
  26305 
  26306     return (old_value > *value || old_value < *value);
  26307 }
  26308 NK_API nk_bool
  26309 nk_knob_int(struct nk_context *ctx, int min, int *val, int max, int step,
  26310     enum nk_heading zero_direction, float dead_zone_degrees)
  26311 {
  26312     int ret;
  26313     float value = (float)*val;
  26314     ret = nk_knob_float(ctx, (float)min, &value, (float)max, (float)step, zero_direction, dead_zone_degrees);
  26315     *val =  (int)value;
  26316     return ret;
  26317 }

  26322 /* ===============================================================
  26323  *
  26324  *                          PROGRESS
  26325  *
  26326  * ===============================================================*/
  26327 NK_LIB nk_size
  26328 nk_progress_behavior(nk_flags *state, struct nk_input *in,
  26329     struct nk_rect r, struct nk_rect cursor, nk_size max, nk_size value, nk_bool modifiable)
  26330 {
  26331     int left_mouse_down = 0;
  26332     int left_mouse_click_in_cursor = 0;
  26333 
  26334     nk_widget_state_reset(state);
  26335     if (!in || !modifiable) return value;
  26336     left_mouse_down = in && in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].down;
  26337     left_mouse_click_in_cursor = in && nk_input_has_mouse_click_down_in_rect(in,
  26338             NK_BUTTON_LEFT, cursor, nk_true);
  26339     if (nk_input_is_mouse_hovering_rect(in, r))
  26340         *state = NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVERED;
  26341 
  26342     if (in && left_mouse_down && left_mouse_click_in_cursor) {
  26343         if (left_mouse_down && left_mouse_click_in_cursor) {
  26344             float ratio = NK_MAX(0, (float)(in->mouse.pos.x - cursor.x)) / (float)cursor.w;
  26345             value = (nk_size)NK_CLAMP(0, (float)max * ratio, (float)max);
  26346             in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].clicked_pos.x = cursor.x + cursor.w/2.0f;
  26347             *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVE;
  26348         }
  26349     }
  26350     /* set progressbar widget state */
  26351     if (*state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER && !nk_input_is_mouse_prev_hovering_rect(in, r))
  26352         *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_ENTERED;
  26353     else if (nk_input_is_mouse_prev_hovering_rect(in, r))
  26354         *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_LEFT;
  26355     return value;
  26356 }
  26357 NK_LIB void
  26358 nk_draw_progress(struct nk_command_buffer *out, nk_flags state,
  26359     const struct nk_style_progress *style, const struct nk_rect *bounds,
  26360     const struct nk_rect *scursor, nk_size value, nk_size max)
  26361 {
  26362     const struct nk_style_item *background;
  26363     const struct nk_style_item *cursor;
  26364 
  26365     NK_UNUSED(max);
  26366     NK_UNUSED(value);
  26367 
  26368     /* select correct colors/images to draw */
  26369     if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED) {
  26370         background = &style->active;
  26371         cursor = &style->cursor_active;
  26372     } else if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER){
  26373         background = &style->hover;
  26374         cursor = &style->cursor_hover;
  26375     } else {
  26376         background = &style->normal;
  26377         cursor = &style->cursor_normal;
  26378     }
  26379 
  26380     /* draw background */
  26381     switch(background->type) {
  26382         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE:
  26383             nk_draw_image(out, *bounds, &background->data.image, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  26384             break;
  26385         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_NINE_SLICE:
  26386             nk_draw_nine_slice(out, *bounds, &background->data.slice, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  26387             break;
  26388         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR:
  26389             nk_fill_rect(out, *bounds, style->rounding, nk_rgb_factor(background->data.color, style->color_factor));
  26390             nk_stroke_rect(out, *bounds, style->rounding, style->border, nk_rgb_factor(style->border_color, style->color_factor));
  26391             break;
  26392     }
  26393 
  26394     /* draw cursor */
  26395     switch(cursor->type) {
  26396         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE:
  26397             nk_draw_image(out, *scursor, &cursor->data.image, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  26398             break;
  26399         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_NINE_SLICE:
  26400             nk_draw_nine_slice(out, *scursor, &cursor->data.slice, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  26401             break;
  26402         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR:
  26403             nk_fill_rect(out, *scursor, style->rounding, nk_rgb_factor(cursor->data.color, style->color_factor));
  26404             nk_stroke_rect(out, *scursor, style->rounding, style->border, nk_rgb_factor(style->border_color, style->color_factor));
  26405             break;
  26406     }
  26407 }
  26408 NK_LIB nk_size
  26409 nk_do_progress(nk_flags *state,
  26410     struct nk_command_buffer *out, struct nk_rect bounds,
  26411     nk_size value, nk_size max, nk_bool modifiable,
  26412     const struct nk_style_progress *style, struct nk_input *in)
  26413 {
  26414     float prog_scale;
  26415     nk_size prog_value;
  26416     struct nk_rect cursor;
  26417 
  26418     NK_ASSERT(style);
  26419     NK_ASSERT(out);
  26420     if (!out || !style) return 0;
  26421 
  26422     /* calculate progressbar cursor */
  26423     cursor.w = NK_MAX(bounds.w, 2 * style->padding.x + 2 * style->border);
  26424     cursor.h = NK_MAX(bounds.h, 2 * style->padding.y + 2 * style->border);
  26425     cursor = nk_pad_rect(bounds, nk_vec2(style->padding.x + style->border, style->padding.y + style->border));
  26426     prog_scale = (float)value / (float)max;
  26427 
  26428     /* update progressbar */
  26429     prog_value = NK_MIN(value, max);
  26430     prog_value = nk_progress_behavior(state, in, bounds, cursor,max, prog_value, modifiable);
  26431     cursor.w = cursor.w * prog_scale;
  26432 
  26433     /* draw progressbar */
  26434     if (style->draw_begin) style->draw_begin(out, style->userdata);
  26435     nk_draw_progress(out, *state, style, &bounds, &cursor, value, max);
  26436     if (style->draw_end) style->draw_end(out, style->userdata);
  26437     return prog_value;
  26438 }
  26439 NK_API nk_bool
  26440 nk_progress(struct nk_context *ctx, nk_size *cur, nk_size max, nk_bool is_modifyable)
  26441 {
  26442     struct nk_window *win;
  26443     struct nk_panel *layout;
  26444     const struct nk_style *style;
  26445     struct nk_input *in;
  26446 
  26447     struct nk_rect bounds;
  26448     enum nk_widget_layout_states state;
  26449     nk_size old_value;
  26450 
  26451     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  26452     NK_ASSERT(cur);
  26453     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  26454     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  26455     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout || !cur)
  26456         return 0;
  26457 
  26458     win = ctx->current;
  26459     style = &ctx->style;
  26460     layout = win->layout;
  26461     state = nk_widget(&bounds, ctx);
  26462     if (!state) return 0;
  26463 
  26464     in = (state == NK_WIDGET_ROM || state == NK_WIDGET_DISABLED || layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_ROM) ? 0 : &ctx->input;
  26465     old_value = *cur;
  26466     *cur = nk_do_progress(&ctx->last_widget_state, &win->buffer, bounds,
  26467             *cur, max, is_modifyable, &style->progress, in);
  26468     return (*cur != old_value);
  26469 }
  26470 NK_API nk_size
  26471 nk_prog(struct nk_context *ctx, nk_size cur, nk_size max, nk_bool modifyable)
  26472 {
  26473     nk_progress(ctx, &cur, max, modifyable);
  26474     return cur;
  26475 }

  26481 /* ===============================================================
  26482  *
  26483  *                              SCROLLBAR
  26484  *
  26485  * ===============================================================*/
  26486 NK_LIB float
  26487 nk_scrollbar_behavior(nk_flags *state, struct nk_input *in,
  26488     int has_scrolling, const struct nk_rect *scroll,
  26489     const struct nk_rect *cursor, const struct nk_rect *empty0,
  26490     const struct nk_rect *empty1, float scroll_offset,
  26491     float target, float scroll_step, enum nk_orientation o)
  26492 {
  26493     nk_flags ws = 0;
  26494     int left_mouse_down;
  26495     unsigned int left_mouse_clicked;
  26496     int left_mouse_click_in_cursor;
  26497     float scroll_delta;
  26498 
  26499     nk_widget_state_reset(state);
  26500     if (!in) return scroll_offset;
  26501 
  26502     left_mouse_down = in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].down;
  26503     left_mouse_clicked = in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].clicked;
  26504     left_mouse_click_in_cursor = nk_input_has_mouse_click_down_in_rect(in,
  26505         NK_BUTTON_LEFT, *cursor, nk_true);
  26506     if (nk_input_is_mouse_hovering_rect(in, *scroll))
  26507         *state = NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVERED;
  26508 
  26509     scroll_delta = (o == NK_VERTICAL) ? in->mouse.scroll_delta.y: in->mouse.scroll_delta.x;
  26510     if (left_mouse_down && left_mouse_click_in_cursor && !left_mouse_clicked) {
  26511         /* update cursor by mouse dragging */
  26512         float pixel, delta;
  26513         *state = NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVE;
  26514         if (o == NK_VERTICAL) {
  26515             float cursor_y;
  26516             pixel = in->mouse.delta.y;
  26517             delta = (pixel / scroll->h) * target;
  26518             scroll_offset = NK_CLAMP(0, scroll_offset + delta, target - scroll->h);
  26519             cursor_y = scroll->y + ((scroll_offset/target) * scroll->h);
  26520             in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].clicked_pos.y = cursor_y + cursor->h/2.0f;
  26521         } else {
  26522             float cursor_x;
  26523             pixel = in->mouse.delta.x;
  26524             delta = (pixel / scroll->w) * target;
  26525             scroll_offset = NK_CLAMP(0, scroll_offset + delta, target - scroll->w);
  26526             cursor_x = scroll->x + ((scroll_offset/target) * scroll->w);
  26527             in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].clicked_pos.x = cursor_x + cursor->w/2.0f;
  26528         }
  26529     } else if ((nk_input_is_key_pressed(in, NK_KEY_SCROLL_UP) && o == NK_VERTICAL && has_scrolling)||
  26530             nk_button_behavior(&ws, *empty0, in, NK_BUTTON_DEFAULT)) {
  26531         /* scroll page up by click on empty space or shortcut */
  26532         if (o == NK_VERTICAL)
  26533             scroll_offset = NK_MAX(0, scroll_offset - scroll->h);
  26534         else scroll_offset = NK_MAX(0, scroll_offset - scroll->w);
  26535     } else if ((nk_input_is_key_pressed(in, NK_KEY_SCROLL_DOWN) && o == NK_VERTICAL && has_scrolling) ||
  26536         nk_button_behavior(&ws, *empty1, in, NK_BUTTON_DEFAULT)) {
  26537         /* scroll page down by click on empty space or shortcut */
  26538         if (o == NK_VERTICAL)
  26539             scroll_offset = NK_MIN(scroll_offset + scroll->h, target - scroll->h);
  26540         else scroll_offset = NK_MIN(scroll_offset + scroll->w, target - scroll->w);
  26541     } else if (has_scrolling) {
  26542         if ((scroll_delta < 0 || (scroll_delta > 0))) {
  26543             /* update cursor by mouse scrolling */
  26544             scroll_offset = scroll_offset + scroll_step * (-scroll_delta);
  26545             if (o == NK_VERTICAL)
  26546                 scroll_offset = NK_CLAMP(0, scroll_offset, target - scroll->h);
  26547             else scroll_offset = NK_CLAMP(0, scroll_offset, target - scroll->w);
  26548         } else if (nk_input_is_key_pressed(in, NK_KEY_SCROLL_START)) {
  26549             /* update cursor to the beginning  */
  26550             if (o == NK_VERTICAL) scroll_offset = 0;
  26551         } else if (nk_input_is_key_pressed(in, NK_KEY_SCROLL_END)) {
  26552             /* update cursor to the end */
  26553             if (o == NK_VERTICAL) scroll_offset = target - scroll->h;
  26554         }
  26555     }
  26556     if (*state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER && !nk_input_is_mouse_prev_hovering_rect(in, *scroll))
  26557         *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_ENTERED;
  26558     else if (nk_input_is_mouse_prev_hovering_rect(in, *scroll))
  26559         *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_LEFT;
  26560     return scroll_offset;
  26561 }
  26562 NK_LIB void
  26563 nk_draw_scrollbar(struct nk_command_buffer *out, nk_flags state,
  26564     const struct nk_style_scrollbar *style, const struct nk_rect *bounds,
  26565     const struct nk_rect *scroll)
  26566 {
  26567     const struct nk_style_item *background;
  26568     const struct nk_style_item *cursor;
  26569 
  26570     /* select correct colors/images to draw */
  26571     if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED) {
  26572         background = &style->active;
  26573         cursor = &style->cursor_active;
  26574     } else if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER) {
  26575         background = &style->hover;
  26576         cursor = &style->cursor_hover;
  26577     } else {
  26578         background = &style->normal;
  26579         cursor = &style->cursor_normal;
  26580     }
  26581 
  26582     /* draw background */
  26583     switch (background->type) {
  26584         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE:
  26585             nk_draw_image(out, *bounds, &background->data.image, nk_white);
  26586             break;
  26587         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_NINE_SLICE:
  26588             nk_draw_nine_slice(out, *bounds, &background->data.slice, nk_white);
  26589             break;
  26590         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR:
  26591             nk_fill_rect(out, *bounds, style->rounding, background->data.color);
  26592             nk_stroke_rect(out, *bounds, style->rounding, style->border, style->border_color);
  26593             break;
  26594     }
  26595 
  26596     /* draw cursor */
  26597     switch (cursor->type) {
  26598         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE:
  26599             nk_draw_image(out, *scroll, &cursor->data.image, nk_white);
  26600             break;
  26601         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_NINE_SLICE:
  26602             nk_draw_nine_slice(out, *scroll, &cursor->data.slice, nk_white);
  26603             break;
  26604         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR:
  26605             nk_fill_rect(out, *scroll, style->rounding_cursor, cursor->data.color);
  26606             nk_stroke_rect(out, *scroll, style->rounding_cursor, style->border_cursor, style->cursor_border_color);
  26607             break;
  26608     }
  26609 }
  26610 NK_LIB float
  26611 nk_do_scrollbarv(nk_flags *state,
  26612     struct nk_command_buffer *out, struct nk_rect scroll, int has_scrolling,
  26613     float offset, float target, float step, float button_pixel_inc,
  26614     const struct nk_style_scrollbar *style, struct nk_input *in,
  26615     const struct nk_user_font *font)
  26616 {
  26617     struct nk_rect empty_north;
  26618     struct nk_rect empty_south;
  26619     struct nk_rect cursor;
  26620 
  26621     float scroll_step;
  26622     float scroll_offset;
  26623     float scroll_off;
  26624     float scroll_ratio;
  26625 
  26626     NK_ASSERT(out);
  26627     NK_ASSERT(style);
  26628     NK_ASSERT(state);
  26629     if (!out || !style) return 0;
  26630 
  26631     scroll.w = NK_MAX(scroll.w, 1);
  26632     scroll.h = NK_MAX(scroll.h, 0);
  26633     if (target <= scroll.h) return 0;
  26634 
  26635     /* optional scrollbar buttons */
  26636     if (style->show_buttons) {
  26637         nk_flags ws;
  26638         float scroll_h;
  26639         struct nk_rect button;
  26640 
  26641         button.x = scroll.x;
  26642         button.w = scroll.w;
  26643         button.h = scroll.w;
  26644 
  26645         scroll_h = NK_MAX(scroll.h - 2 * button.h,0);
  26646         scroll_step = NK_MIN(step, button_pixel_inc);
  26647 
  26648         /* decrement button */
  26649         button.y = scroll.y;
  26650         if (nk_do_button_symbol(&ws, out, button, style->dec_symbol,
  26651             NK_BUTTON_REPEATER, &style->dec_button, in, font))
  26652             offset = offset - scroll_step;
  26653 
  26654         /* increment button */
  26655         button.y = scroll.y + scroll.h - button.h;
  26656         if (nk_do_button_symbol(&ws, out, button, style->inc_symbol,
  26657             NK_BUTTON_REPEATER, &style->inc_button, in, font))
  26658             offset = offset + scroll_step;
  26659 
  26660         scroll.y = scroll.y + button.h;
  26661         scroll.h = scroll_h;
  26662     }
  26663 
  26664     /* calculate scrollbar constants */
  26665     scroll_step = NK_MIN(step, scroll.h);
  26666     scroll_offset = NK_CLAMP(0, offset, target - scroll.h);
  26667     scroll_ratio = scroll.h / target;
  26668     scroll_off = scroll_offset / target;
  26669 
  26670     /* calculate scrollbar cursor bounds */
  26671     cursor.h = NK_MAX((scroll_ratio * scroll.h) - (2*style->border + 2*style->padding.y), 0);
  26672     cursor.y = scroll.y + (scroll_off * scroll.h) + style->border + style->padding.y;
  26673     cursor.w = scroll.w - (2 * style->border + 2 * style->padding.x);
  26674     cursor.x = scroll.x + style->border + style->padding.x;
  26675 
  26676     /* calculate empty space around cursor */
  26677     empty_north.x = scroll.x;
  26678     empty_north.y = scroll.y;
  26679     empty_north.w = scroll.w;
  26680     empty_north.h = NK_MAX(cursor.y - scroll.y, 0);
  26681 
  26682     empty_south.x = scroll.x;
  26683     empty_south.y = cursor.y + cursor.h;
  26684     empty_south.w = scroll.w;
  26685     empty_south.h = NK_MAX((scroll.y + scroll.h) - (cursor.y + cursor.h), 0);
  26686 
  26687     /* update scrollbar */
  26688     scroll_offset = nk_scrollbar_behavior(state, in, has_scrolling, &scroll, &cursor,
  26689         &empty_north, &empty_south, scroll_offset, target, scroll_step, NK_VERTICAL);
  26690     scroll_off = scroll_offset / target;
  26691     cursor.y = scroll.y + (scroll_off * scroll.h) + style->border_cursor + style->padding.y;
  26692 
  26693     /* draw scrollbar */
  26694     if (style->draw_begin) style->draw_begin(out, style->userdata);
  26695     nk_draw_scrollbar(out, *state, style, &scroll, &cursor);
  26696     if (style->draw_end) style->draw_end(out, style->userdata);
  26697     return scroll_offset;
  26698 }
  26699 NK_LIB float
  26700 nk_do_scrollbarh(nk_flags *state,
  26701     struct nk_command_buffer *out, struct nk_rect scroll, int has_scrolling,
  26702     float offset, float target, float step, float button_pixel_inc,
  26703     const struct nk_style_scrollbar *style, struct nk_input *in,
  26704     const struct nk_user_font *font)
  26705 {
  26706     struct nk_rect cursor;
  26707     struct nk_rect empty_west;
  26708     struct nk_rect empty_east;
  26709 
  26710     float scroll_step;
  26711     float scroll_offset;
  26712     float scroll_off;
  26713     float scroll_ratio;
  26714 
  26715     NK_ASSERT(out);
  26716     NK_ASSERT(style);
  26717     if (!out || !style) return 0;
  26718 
  26719     /* scrollbar background */
  26720     scroll.h = NK_MAX(scroll.h, 1);
  26721     scroll.w = NK_MAX(scroll.w, 2 * scroll.h);
  26722     if (target <= scroll.w) return 0;
  26723 
  26724     /* optional scrollbar buttons */
  26725     if (style->show_buttons) {
  26726         nk_flags ws;
  26727         float scroll_w;
  26728         struct nk_rect button;
  26729         button.y = scroll.y;
  26730         button.w = scroll.h;
  26731         button.h = scroll.h;
  26732 
  26733         scroll_w = scroll.w - 2 * button.w;
  26734         scroll_step = NK_MIN(step, button_pixel_inc);
  26735 
  26736         /* decrement button */
  26737         button.x = scroll.x;
  26738         if (nk_do_button_symbol(&ws, out, button, style->dec_symbol,
  26739             NK_BUTTON_REPEATER, &style->dec_button, in, font))
  26740             offset = offset - scroll_step;
  26741 
  26742         /* increment button */
  26743         button.x = scroll.x + scroll.w - button.w;
  26744         if (nk_do_button_symbol(&ws, out, button, style->inc_symbol,
  26745             NK_BUTTON_REPEATER, &style->inc_button, in, font))
  26746             offset = offset + scroll_step;
  26747 
  26748         scroll.x = scroll.x + button.w;
  26749         scroll.w = scroll_w;
  26750     }
  26751 
  26752     /* calculate scrollbar constants */
  26753     scroll_step = NK_MIN(step, scroll.w);
  26754     scroll_offset = NK_CLAMP(0, offset, target - scroll.w);
  26755     scroll_ratio = scroll.w / target;
  26756     scroll_off = scroll_offset / target;
  26757 
  26758     /* calculate cursor bounds */
  26759     cursor.w = (scroll_ratio * scroll.w) - (2*style->border + 2*style->padding.x);
  26760     cursor.x = scroll.x + (scroll_off * scroll.w) + style->border + style->padding.x;
  26761     cursor.h = scroll.h - (2 * style->border + 2 * style->padding.y);
  26762     cursor.y = scroll.y + style->border + style->padding.y;
  26763 
  26764     /* calculate empty space around cursor */
  26765     empty_west.x = scroll.x;
  26766     empty_west.y = scroll.y;
  26767     empty_west.w = cursor.x - scroll.x;
  26768     empty_west.h = scroll.h;
  26769 
  26770     empty_east.x = cursor.x + cursor.w;
  26771     empty_east.y = scroll.y;
  26772     empty_east.w = (scroll.x + scroll.w) - (cursor.x + cursor.w);
  26773     empty_east.h = scroll.h;
  26774 
  26775     /* update scrollbar */
  26776     scroll_offset = nk_scrollbar_behavior(state, in, has_scrolling, &scroll, &cursor,
  26777         &empty_west, &empty_east, scroll_offset, target, scroll_step, NK_HORIZONTAL);
  26778     scroll_off = scroll_offset / target;
  26779     cursor.x = scroll.x + (scroll_off * scroll.w);
  26780 
  26781     /* draw scrollbar */
  26782     if (style->draw_begin) style->draw_begin(out, style->userdata);
  26783     nk_draw_scrollbar(out, *state, style, &scroll, &cursor);
  26784     if (style->draw_end) style->draw_end(out, style->userdata);
  26785     return scroll_offset;
  26786 }

  26792 /* ===============================================================
  26793  *
  26794  *                          TEXT EDITOR
  26795  *
  26796  * ===============================================================*/
  26797 /* stb_textedit.h - v1.8  - public domain - Sean Barrett */
  26798 struct nk_text_find {
  26799    float x,y;    /* position of n'th character */
  26800    float height; /* height of line */
  26801    int first_char, length; /* first char of row, and length */
  26802    int prev_first;  /*_ first char of previous row */
  26803 };
  26804 
  26805 struct nk_text_edit_row {
  26806    float x0,x1;
  26807    /* starting x location, end x location (allows for align=right, etc) */
  26808    float baseline_y_delta;
  26809    /* position of baseline relative to previous row's baseline*/
  26810    float ymin,ymax;
  26811    /* height of row above and below baseline */
  26812    int num_chars;
  26813 };
  26814 
  26815 /* forward declarations */
  26816 NK_INTERN void nk_textedit_makeundo_delete(struct nk_text_edit*, int, int);
  26817 NK_INTERN void nk_textedit_makeundo_insert(struct nk_text_edit*, int, int);
  26818 NK_INTERN void nk_textedit_makeundo_replace(struct nk_text_edit*, int, int, int);
  26819 #define NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION(s)   ((s)->select_start != (s)->select_end)
  26820 
  26821 NK_INTERN float
  26822 nk_textedit_get_width(const struct nk_text_edit *edit, int line_start, int char_id,
  26823     const struct nk_user_font *font)
  26824 {
  26825     int len = 0;
  26826     nk_rune unicode = 0;
  26827     const char *str = nk_str_at_const(&edit->string, line_start + char_id, &unicode, &len);
  26828     return font->width(font->userdata, font->height, str, len);
  26829 }
  26830 NK_INTERN void
  26831 nk_textedit_layout_row(struct nk_text_edit_row *r, struct nk_text_edit *edit,
  26832     int line_start_id, float row_height, const struct nk_user_font *font)
  26833 {
  26834     int l;
  26835     int glyphs = 0;
  26836     nk_rune unicode;
  26837     const char *remaining;
  26838     int len = nk_str_len_char(&edit->string);
  26839     const char *end = nk_str_get_const(&edit->string) + len;
  26840     const char *text = nk_str_at_const(&edit->string, line_start_id, &unicode, &l);
  26841     const struct nk_vec2 size = nk_text_calculate_text_bounds(font,
  26842         text, (int)(end - text), row_height, &remaining, 0, &glyphs, NK_STOP_ON_NEW_LINE);
  26843 
  26844     r->x0 = 0.0f;
  26845     r->x1 = size.x;
  26846     r->baseline_y_delta = size.y;
  26847     r->ymin = 0.0f;
  26848     r->ymax = size.y;
  26849     r->num_chars = glyphs;
  26850 }
  26851 NK_INTERN int
  26852 nk_textedit_locate_coord(struct nk_text_edit *edit, float x, float y,
  26853     const struct nk_user_font *font, float row_height)
  26854 {
  26855     struct nk_text_edit_row r;
  26856     int n = edit->string.len;
  26857     float base_y = 0, prev_x;
  26858     int i=0, k;
  26859 
  26860     r.x0 = r.x1 = 0;
  26861     r.ymin = r.ymax = 0;
  26862     r.num_chars = 0;
  26863 
  26864     /* search rows to find one that straddles 'y' */
  26865     while (i < n) {
  26866         nk_textedit_layout_row(&r, edit, i, row_height, font);
  26867         if (r.num_chars <= 0)
  26868             return n;
  26869 
  26870         if (i==0 && y < base_y + r.ymin)
  26871             return 0;
  26872 
  26873         if (y < base_y + r.ymax)
  26874             break;
  26875 
  26876         i += r.num_chars;
  26877         base_y += r.baseline_y_delta;
  26878     }
  26879 
  26880     /* below all text, return 'after' last character */
  26881     if (i >= n)
  26882         return n;
  26883 
  26884     /* check if it's before the beginning of the line */
  26885     if (x < r.x0)
  26886         return i;
  26887 
  26888     /* check if it's before the end of the line */
  26889     if (x < r.x1) {
  26890         /* search characters in row for one that straddles 'x' */
  26891         k = i;
  26892         prev_x = r.x0;
  26893         for (i=0; i < r.num_chars; ++i) {
  26894             float w = nk_textedit_get_width(edit, k, i, font);
  26895             if (x < prev_x+w) {
  26896                 if (x < prev_x+w/2)
  26897                     return k+i;
  26898                 else return k+i+1;
  26899             }
  26900             prev_x += w;
  26901         }
  26902         /* shouldn't happen, but if it does, fall through to end-of-line case */
  26903     }
  26904 
  26905     /* if the last character is a newline, return that.
  26906      * otherwise return 'after' the last character */
  26907     if (nk_str_rune_at(&edit->string, i+r.num_chars-1) == '\n')
  26908         return i+r.num_chars-1;
  26909     else return i+r.num_chars;
  26910 }
  26911 NK_LIB void
  26912 nk_textedit_click(struct nk_text_edit *state, float x, float y,
  26913     const struct nk_user_font *font, float row_height)
  26914 {
  26915     /* API click: on mouse down, move the cursor to the clicked location,
  26916      * and reset the selection */
  26917     state->cursor = nk_textedit_locate_coord(state, x, y, font, row_height);
  26918     state->select_start = state->cursor;
  26919     state->select_end = state->cursor;
  26920     state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  26921 }
  26922 NK_LIB void
  26923 nk_textedit_drag(struct nk_text_edit *state, float x, float y,
  26924     const struct nk_user_font *font, float row_height)
  26925 {
  26926     /* API drag: on mouse drag, move the cursor and selection endpoint
  26927      * to the clicked location */
  26928     int p = nk_textedit_locate_coord(state, x, y, font, row_height);
  26929     if (state->select_start == state->select_end)
  26930         state->select_start = state->cursor;
  26931     state->cursor = state->select_end = p;
  26932 }
  26933 NK_INTERN void
  26934 nk_textedit_find_charpos(struct nk_text_find *find, struct nk_text_edit *state,
  26935     int n, int single_line, const struct nk_user_font *font, float row_height)
  26936 {
  26937     /* find the x/y location of a character, and remember info about the previous
  26938      * row in case we get a move-up event (for page up, we'll have to rescan) */
  26939     struct nk_text_edit_row r;
  26940     int prev_start = 0;
  26941     int z = state->string.len;
  26942     int i=0, first;
  26943 
  26944     nk_zero_struct(r);
  26945     if (n == z) {
  26946         /* if it's at the end, then find the last line -- simpler than trying to
  26947         explicitly handle this case in the regular code */
  26948         nk_textedit_layout_row(&r, state, 0, row_height, font);
  26949         if (single_line) {
  26950             find->first_char = 0;
  26951             find->length = z;
  26952         } else {
  26953             while (i < z) {
  26954                 prev_start = i;
  26955                 i += r.num_chars;
  26956                 nk_textedit_layout_row(&r, state, i, row_height, font);
  26957             }
  26958 
  26959             find->first_char = i;
  26960             find->length = r.num_chars;
  26961         }
  26962         find->x = r.x1;
  26963         find->y = r.ymin;
  26964         find->height = r.ymax - r.ymin;
  26965         find->prev_first = prev_start;
  26966         return;
  26967     }
  26968 
  26969     /* search rows to find the one that straddles character n */
  26970     find->y = 0;
  26971 
  26972     for(;;) {
  26973         nk_textedit_layout_row(&r, state, i, row_height, font);
  26974         if (n < i + r.num_chars) break;
  26975         prev_start = i;
  26976         i += r.num_chars;
  26977         find->y += r.baseline_y_delta;
  26978     }
  26979 
  26980     find->first_char = first = i;
  26981     find->length = r.num_chars;
  26982     find->height = r.ymax - r.ymin;
  26983     find->prev_first = prev_start;
  26984 
  26985     /* now scan to find xpos */
  26986     find->x = r.x0;
  26987     for (i=0; first+i < n; ++i)
  26988         find->x += nk_textedit_get_width(state, first, i, font);
  26989 }
  26990 NK_INTERN void
  26991 nk_textedit_clamp(struct nk_text_edit *state)
  26992 {
  26993     /* make the selection/cursor state valid if client altered the string */
  26994     int n = state->string.len;
  26995     if (NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION(state)) {
  26996         if (state->select_start > n) state->select_start = n;
  26997         if (state->select_end   > n) state->select_end = n;
  26998         /* if clamping forced them to be equal, move the cursor to match */
  26999         if (state->select_start == state->select_end)
  27000             state->cursor = state->select_start;
  27001     }
  27002     if (state->cursor > n) state->cursor = n;
  27003 }
  27004 NK_API void
  27005 nk_textedit_delete(struct nk_text_edit *state, int where, int len)
  27006 {
  27007     /* delete characters while updating undo */
  27008     nk_textedit_makeundo_delete(state, where, len);
  27009     nk_str_delete_runes(&state->string, where, len);
  27010     state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27011 }
  27012 NK_API void
  27013 nk_textedit_delete_selection(struct nk_text_edit *state)
  27014 {
  27015     /* delete the section */
  27016     nk_textedit_clamp(state);
  27017     if (NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION(state)) {
  27018         if (state->select_start < state->select_end) {
  27019             nk_textedit_delete(state, state->select_start,
  27020                 state->select_end - state->select_start);
  27021             state->select_end = state->cursor = state->select_start;
  27022         } else {
  27023             nk_textedit_delete(state, state->select_end,
  27024                 state->select_start - state->select_end);
  27025             state->select_start = state->cursor = state->select_end;
  27026         }
  27027         state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27028     }
  27029 }
  27030 NK_INTERN void
  27031 nk_textedit_sortselection(struct nk_text_edit *state)
  27032 {
  27033     /* canonicalize the selection so start <= end */
  27034     if (state->select_end < state->select_start) {
  27035         int temp = state->select_end;
  27036         state->select_end = state->select_start;
  27037         state->select_start = temp;
  27038     }
  27039 }
  27040 NK_INTERN void
  27041 nk_textedit_move_to_first(struct nk_text_edit *state)
  27042 {
  27043     /* move cursor to first character of selection */
  27044     if (NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION(state)) {
  27045         nk_textedit_sortselection(state);
  27046         state->cursor = state->select_start;
  27047         state->select_end = state->select_start;
  27048         state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27049     }
  27050 }
  27051 NK_INTERN void
  27052 nk_textedit_move_to_last(struct nk_text_edit *state)
  27053 {
  27054     /* move cursor to last character of selection */
  27055     if (NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION(state)) {
  27056         nk_textedit_sortselection(state);
  27057         nk_textedit_clamp(state);
  27058         state->cursor = state->select_end;
  27059         state->select_start = state->select_end;
  27060         state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27061     }
  27062 }
  27063 NK_INTERN int
  27064 nk_is_word_boundary( struct nk_text_edit *state, int idx)
  27065 {
  27066     int len;
  27067     nk_rune c;
  27068     if (idx < 0) return 1;
  27069     if (!nk_str_at_rune(&state->string, idx, &c, &len)) return 1;
  27070 #ifndef NK_IS_WORD_BOUNDARY
  27071     return (c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\f' ||
  27072             c == '\v' || c == 0x3000);
  27073 #else
  27074     return NK_IS_WORD_BOUNDARY(c);
  27075 #endif
  27076 }
  27077 NK_INTERN int
  27078 nk_textedit_move_to_word_previous(struct nk_text_edit *state)
  27079 {
  27080    int c = state->cursor - 1;
  27081    if (c > 0) {
  27082       if (nk_is_word_boundary(state, c)) {
  27083          while (c > 0 && nk_is_word_boundary(state, --c));
  27084       }
  27085       while (!nk_is_word_boundary(state, --c));
  27086       c++;
  27087    } else {
  27088       return 0;
  27089    }
  27090 
  27091    return c;
  27092 }
  27093 NK_INTERN int
  27094 nk_textedit_move_to_word_next(struct nk_text_edit *state)
  27095 {
  27096    const int len = state->string.len;
  27097    int c = state->cursor;
  27098    if (c < len) {
  27099       if (!nk_is_word_boundary(state, c)) {
  27100          while (c < len && !nk_is_word_boundary(state, ++c));
  27101       }
  27102       while (c < len && nk_is_word_boundary(state, ++c));
  27103    } else {
  27104       return len;
  27105    }
  27106 
  27107    return c;
  27108 }
  27109 NK_INTERN void
  27110 nk_textedit_prep_selection_at_cursor(struct nk_text_edit *state)
  27111 {
  27112     /* update selection and cursor to match each other */
  27113     if (!NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION(state))
  27114         state->select_start = state->select_end = state->cursor;
  27115     else state->cursor = state->select_end;
  27116 }
  27117 NK_API nk_bool
  27118 nk_textedit_cut(struct nk_text_edit *state)
  27119 {
  27120     /* API cut: delete selection */
  27121     if (state->mode == NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_VIEW)
  27122         return 0;
  27123     if (NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION(state)) {
  27124         nk_textedit_delete_selection(state); /* implicitly clamps */
  27125         state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27126         return 1;
  27127     }
  27128    return 0;
  27129 }
  27130 NK_API nk_bool
  27131 nk_textedit_paste(struct nk_text_edit *state, char const *ctext, int len)
  27132 {
  27133     /* API paste: replace existing selection with passed-in text */
  27134     int glyphs;
  27135     const char *text = (const char *) ctext;
  27136     if (state->mode == NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_VIEW) return 0;
  27137 
  27138     /* if there's a selection, the paste should delete it */
  27139     nk_textedit_clamp(state);
  27140     nk_textedit_delete_selection(state);
  27141 
  27142     /* try to insert the characters */
  27143     glyphs = nk_utf_len(ctext, len);
  27144     if (nk_str_insert_text_char(&state->string, state->cursor, text, len)) {
  27145         nk_textedit_makeundo_insert(state, state->cursor, glyphs);
  27146         state->cursor += len;
  27147         state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27148         return 1;
  27149     }
  27150     /* remove the undo since we didn't actually insert the characters */
  27151     if (state->undo.undo_point)
  27152         --state->undo.undo_point;
  27153     return 0;
  27154 }
  27155 NK_API void
  27156 nk_textedit_text(struct nk_text_edit *state, const char *text, int total_len)
  27157 {
  27158     nk_rune unicode;
  27159     int glyph_len;
  27160     int text_len = 0;
  27161 
  27162     NK_ASSERT(state);
  27163     NK_ASSERT(text);
  27164     if (!text || !total_len || state->mode == NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_VIEW) return;
  27165 
  27166     glyph_len = nk_utf_decode(text, &unicode, total_len);
  27167     while ((text_len < total_len) && glyph_len)
  27168     {
  27169         /* don't insert a backward delete, just process the event */
  27170         if (unicode == 127) goto next;
  27171         /* can't add newline in single-line mode */
  27172         if (unicode == '\n' && state->single_line) goto next;
  27173         /* filter incoming text */
  27174         if (state->filter && !state->filter(state, unicode)) goto next;
  27175 
  27176         if (!NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION(state) &&
  27177             state->cursor < state->string.len)
  27178         {
  27179             if (state->mode == NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_REPLACE) {
  27180                 nk_textedit_makeundo_replace(state, state->cursor, 1, 1);
  27181                 nk_str_delete_runes(&state->string, state->cursor, 1);
  27182             }
  27183             if (nk_str_insert_text_utf8(&state->string, state->cursor,
  27184                                         text+text_len, 1))
  27185             {
  27186                 ++state->cursor;
  27187                 state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27188             }
  27189         } else {
  27190             nk_textedit_delete_selection(state); /* implicitly clamps */
  27191             if (nk_str_insert_text_utf8(&state->string, state->cursor,
  27192                                         text+text_len, 1))
  27193             {
  27194                 nk_textedit_makeundo_insert(state, state->cursor, 1);
  27195                 state->cursor = NK_MIN(state->cursor + 1, state->string.len);
  27196                 state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27197             }
  27198         }
  27199         next:
  27200         text_len += glyph_len;
  27201         glyph_len = nk_utf_decode(text + text_len, &unicode, total_len-text_len);
  27202     }
  27203 }
  27204 NK_LIB void
  27205 nk_textedit_key(struct nk_text_edit *state, enum nk_keys key, int shift_mod,
  27206     const struct nk_user_font *font, float row_height)
  27207 {
  27208 retry:
  27209     switch (key)
  27210     {
  27211     case NK_KEY_NONE:
  27212     case NK_KEY_CTRL:
  27213     case NK_KEY_ENTER:
  27214     case NK_KEY_SHIFT:
  27215     case NK_KEY_TAB:
  27216     case NK_KEY_COPY:
  27217     case NK_KEY_CUT:
  27218     case NK_KEY_PASTE:
  27219     case NK_KEY_MAX:
  27220     default: break;
  27221     case NK_KEY_TEXT_UNDO:
  27222          nk_textedit_undo(state);
  27223          state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27224          break;
  27225 
  27226     case NK_KEY_TEXT_REDO:
  27227         nk_textedit_redo(state);
  27228         state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27229         break;
  27230 
  27231     case NK_KEY_TEXT_SELECT_ALL:
  27232         nk_textedit_select_all(state);
  27233         state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27234         break;
  27235 
  27236     case NK_KEY_TEXT_INSERT_MODE:
  27237         if (state->mode == NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_VIEW)
  27238             state->mode = NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_INSERT;
  27239         break;
  27240     case NK_KEY_TEXT_REPLACE_MODE:
  27241         if (state->mode == NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_VIEW)
  27242             state->mode = NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_REPLACE;
  27243         break;
  27244     case NK_KEY_TEXT_RESET_MODE:
  27245         if (state->mode == NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_INSERT ||
  27246             state->mode == NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_REPLACE)
  27247             state->mode = NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_VIEW;
  27248         break;
  27249 
  27250     case NK_KEY_LEFT:
  27251         if (shift_mod) {
  27252             nk_textedit_clamp(state);
  27253             nk_textedit_prep_selection_at_cursor(state);
  27254             /* move selection left */
  27255             if (state->select_end > 0)
  27256                 --state->select_end;
  27257             state->cursor = state->select_end;
  27258             state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27259         } else {
  27260             /* if currently there's a selection,
  27261              * move cursor to start of selection */
  27262             if (NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION(state))
  27263                 nk_textedit_move_to_first(state);
  27264             else if (state->cursor > 0)
  27265                --state->cursor;
  27266             state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27267         } break;
  27268 
  27269     case NK_KEY_RIGHT:
  27270         if (shift_mod) {
  27271             nk_textedit_prep_selection_at_cursor(state);
  27272             /* move selection right */
  27273             ++state->select_end;
  27274             nk_textedit_clamp(state);
  27275             state->cursor = state->select_end;
  27276             state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27277         } else {
  27278             /* if currently there's a selection,
  27279              * move cursor to end of selection */
  27280             if (NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION(state))
  27281                 nk_textedit_move_to_last(state);
  27282             else ++state->cursor;
  27283             nk_textedit_clamp(state);
  27284             state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27285         } break;
  27286 
  27287     case NK_KEY_TEXT_WORD_LEFT:
  27288         if (shift_mod) {
  27289             if( !NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION( state ) )
  27290                 nk_textedit_prep_selection_at_cursor(state);
  27291             state->cursor = nk_textedit_move_to_word_previous(state);
  27292             state->select_end = state->cursor;
  27293             nk_textedit_clamp(state );
  27294         } else {
  27295             if (NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION(state))
  27296                 nk_textedit_move_to_first(state);
  27297             else {
  27298                 state->cursor = nk_textedit_move_to_word_previous(state);
  27299                 nk_textedit_clamp(state );
  27300             }
  27301         } break;
  27302 
  27303     case NK_KEY_TEXT_WORD_RIGHT:
  27304         if (shift_mod) {
  27305             if( !NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION( state ) )
  27306                 nk_textedit_prep_selection_at_cursor(state);
  27307             state->cursor = nk_textedit_move_to_word_next(state);
  27308             state->select_end = state->cursor;
  27309             nk_textedit_clamp(state);
  27310         } else {
  27311             if (NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION(state))
  27312                 nk_textedit_move_to_last(state);
  27313             else {
  27314                 state->cursor = nk_textedit_move_to_word_next(state);
  27315                 nk_textedit_clamp(state );
  27316             }
  27317         } break;
  27318 
  27319     case NK_KEY_DOWN: {
  27320         struct nk_text_find find;
  27321         struct nk_text_edit_row row;
  27322         int i, sel = shift_mod;
  27323 
  27324         if (state->single_line) {
  27325             /* on windows, up&down in single-line behave like left&right */
  27326             key = NK_KEY_RIGHT;
  27327             goto retry;
  27328         }
  27329 
  27330         if (sel)
  27331             nk_textedit_prep_selection_at_cursor(state);
  27332         else if (NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION(state))
  27333             nk_textedit_move_to_last(state);
  27334 
  27335         /* compute current position of cursor point */
  27336         nk_textedit_clamp(state);
  27337         nk_textedit_find_charpos(&find, state, state->cursor, state->single_line,
  27338             font, row_height);
  27339 
  27340         /* now find character position down a row */
  27341         if (find.length)
  27342         {
  27343             float x;
  27344             float goal_x = state->has_preferred_x ? state->preferred_x : find.x;
  27345             int start = find.first_char + find.length;
  27346 
  27347             state->cursor = start;
  27348             nk_textedit_layout_row(&row, state, state->cursor, row_height, font);
  27349             x = row.x0;
  27350 
  27351             for (i=0; i < row.num_chars && x < row.x1; ++i) {
  27352                 float dx = nk_textedit_get_width(state, start, i, font);
  27353                 x += dx;
  27354                 if (x > goal_x)
  27355                     break;
  27356                 ++state->cursor;
  27357             }
  27358             nk_textedit_clamp(state);
  27359 
  27360             state->has_preferred_x = 1;
  27361             state->preferred_x = goal_x;
  27362             if (sel)
  27363                 state->select_end = state->cursor;
  27364         }
  27365     } break;
  27366 
  27367     case NK_KEY_UP: {
  27368         struct nk_text_find find;
  27369         struct nk_text_edit_row row;
  27370         int i, sel = shift_mod;
  27371 
  27372         if (state->single_line) {
  27373             /* on windows, up&down become left&right */
  27374             key = NK_KEY_LEFT;
  27375             goto retry;
  27376         }
  27377 
  27378         if (sel)
  27379             nk_textedit_prep_selection_at_cursor(state);
  27380         else if (NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION(state))
  27381             nk_textedit_move_to_first(state);
  27382 
  27383          /* compute current position of cursor point */
  27384          nk_textedit_clamp(state);
  27385          nk_textedit_find_charpos(&find, state, state->cursor, state->single_line,
  27386                 font, row_height);
  27387 
  27388          /* can only go up if there's a previous row */
  27389          if (find.prev_first != find.first_char) {
  27390             /* now find character position up a row */
  27391             float x;
  27392             float goal_x = state->has_preferred_x ? state->preferred_x : find.x;
  27393 
  27394             state->cursor = find.prev_first;
  27395             nk_textedit_layout_row(&row, state, state->cursor, row_height, font);
  27396             x = row.x0;
  27397 
  27398             for (i=0; i < row.num_chars && x < row.x1; ++i) {
  27399                 float dx = nk_textedit_get_width(state, find.prev_first, i, font);
  27400                 x += dx;
  27401                 if (x > goal_x)
  27402                     break;
  27403                 ++state->cursor;
  27404             }
  27405             nk_textedit_clamp(state);
  27406 
  27407             state->has_preferred_x = 1;
  27408             state->preferred_x = goal_x;
  27409             if (sel) state->select_end = state->cursor;
  27410          }
  27411       } break;
  27412 
  27413     case NK_KEY_DEL:
  27414         if (state->mode == NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_VIEW)
  27415             break;
  27416         if (NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION(state))
  27417             nk_textedit_delete_selection(state);
  27418         else {
  27419             int n = state->string.len;
  27420             if (state->cursor < n)
  27421                 nk_textedit_delete(state, state->cursor, 1);
  27422          }
  27423          state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27424          break;
  27425 
  27426     case NK_KEY_BACKSPACE:
  27427         if (state->mode == NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_VIEW)
  27428             break;
  27429         if (NK_TEXT_HAS_SELECTION(state))
  27430             nk_textedit_delete_selection(state);
  27431         else {
  27432             nk_textedit_clamp(state);
  27433             if (state->cursor > 0) {
  27434                 nk_textedit_delete(state, state->cursor-1, 1);
  27435                 --state->cursor;
  27436             }
  27437          }
  27438          state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27439          break;
  27440 
  27441     case NK_KEY_TEXT_START:
  27442          if (shift_mod) {
  27443             nk_textedit_prep_selection_at_cursor(state);
  27444             state->cursor = state->select_end = 0;
  27445             state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27446          } else {
  27447             state->cursor = state->select_start = state->select_end = 0;
  27448             state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27449          }
  27450          break;
  27451 
  27452     case NK_KEY_TEXT_END:
  27453          if (shift_mod) {
  27454             nk_textedit_prep_selection_at_cursor(state);
  27455             state->cursor = state->select_end = state->string.len;
  27456             state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27457          } else {
  27458             state->cursor = state->string.len;
  27459             state->select_start = state->select_end = 0;
  27460             state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27461          }
  27462          break;
  27463 
  27464     case NK_KEY_TEXT_LINE_START: {
  27465         if (shift_mod) {
  27466             struct nk_text_find find;
  27467            nk_textedit_clamp(state);
  27468             nk_textedit_prep_selection_at_cursor(state);
  27469             if (state->string.len && state->cursor == state->string.len)
  27470                 --state->cursor;
  27471             nk_textedit_find_charpos(&find, state,state->cursor, state->single_line,
  27472                 font, row_height);
  27473             state->cursor = state->select_end = find.first_char;
  27474             state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27475         } else {
  27476             struct nk_text_find find;
  27477             if (state->string.len && state->cursor == state->string.len)
  27478                 --state->cursor;
  27479             nk_textedit_clamp(state);
  27480             nk_textedit_move_to_first(state);
  27481             nk_textedit_find_charpos(&find, state, state->cursor, state->single_line,
  27482                 font, row_height);
  27483             state->cursor = find.first_char;
  27484             state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27485         }
  27486       } break;
  27487 
  27488     case NK_KEY_TEXT_LINE_END: {
  27489         if (shift_mod) {
  27490             struct nk_text_find find;
  27491             nk_textedit_clamp(state);
  27492             nk_textedit_prep_selection_at_cursor(state);
  27493             nk_textedit_find_charpos(&find, state, state->cursor, state->single_line,
  27494                 font, row_height);
  27495             state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27496             state->cursor = find.first_char + find.length;
  27497             if (find.length > 0 && nk_str_rune_at(&state->string, state->cursor-1) == '\n')
  27498                 --state->cursor;
  27499             state->select_end = state->cursor;
  27500         } else {
  27501             struct nk_text_find find;
  27502             nk_textedit_clamp(state);
  27503             nk_textedit_move_to_first(state);
  27504             nk_textedit_find_charpos(&find, state, state->cursor, state->single_line,
  27505                 font, row_height);
  27506 
  27507             state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27508             state->cursor = find.first_char + find.length;
  27509             if (find.length > 0 && nk_str_rune_at(&state->string, state->cursor-1) == '\n')
  27510                 --state->cursor;
  27511         }} break;
  27512     }
  27513 }
  27514 NK_INTERN void
  27515 nk_textedit_flush_redo(struct nk_text_undo_state *state)
  27516 {
  27517     state->redo_point = NK_TEXTEDIT_UNDOSTATECOUNT;
  27518     state->redo_char_point = NK_TEXTEDIT_UNDOCHARCOUNT;
  27519 }
  27520 NK_INTERN void
  27521 nk_textedit_discard_undo(struct nk_text_undo_state *state)
  27522 {
  27523     /* discard the oldest entry in the undo list */
  27524     if (state->undo_point > 0) {
  27525         /* if the 0th undo state has characters, clean those up */
  27526         if (state->undo_rec[0].char_storage >= 0) {
  27527             int n = state->undo_rec[0].insert_length, i;
  27528             /* delete n characters from all other records */
  27529             state->undo_char_point = (short)(state->undo_char_point - n);
  27530             NK_MEMCPY(state->undo_char, state->undo_char + n,
  27531                 (nk_size)state->undo_char_point*sizeof(nk_rune));
  27532             for (i=0; i < state->undo_point; ++i) {
  27533                 if (state->undo_rec[i].char_storage >= 0)
  27534                 state->undo_rec[i].char_storage = (short)
  27535                     (state->undo_rec[i].char_storage - n);
  27536             }
  27537         }
  27538         --state->undo_point;
  27539         NK_MEMCPY(state->undo_rec, state->undo_rec+1,
  27540             (nk_size)((nk_size)state->undo_point * sizeof(state->undo_rec[0])));
  27541     }
  27542 }
  27543 NK_INTERN void
  27544 nk_textedit_discard_redo(struct nk_text_undo_state *state)
  27545 {
  27546 /*  discard the oldest entry in the redo list--it's bad if this
  27547     ever happens, but because undo & redo have to store the actual
  27548     characters in different cases, the redo character buffer can
  27549     fill up even though the undo buffer didn't */
  27550     nk_size num;
  27551     int k = NK_TEXTEDIT_UNDOSTATECOUNT-1;
  27552     if (state->redo_point <= k) {
  27553         /* if the k'th undo state has characters, clean those up */
  27554         if (state->undo_rec[k].char_storage >= 0) {
  27555             int n = state->undo_rec[k].insert_length, i;
  27556             /* delete n characters from all other records */
  27557             state->redo_char_point = (short)(state->redo_char_point + n);
  27558             num = (nk_size)(NK_TEXTEDIT_UNDOCHARCOUNT - state->redo_char_point);
  27559             NK_MEMCPY(state->undo_char + state->redo_char_point,
  27560                 state->undo_char + state->redo_char_point-n, num * sizeof(char));
  27561             for (i = state->redo_point; i < k; ++i) {
  27562                 if (state->undo_rec[i].char_storage >= 0) {
  27563                     state->undo_rec[i].char_storage = (short)
  27564                         (state->undo_rec[i].char_storage + n);
  27565                 }
  27566             }
  27567         }
  27568         ++state->redo_point;
  27569         num = (nk_size)(NK_TEXTEDIT_UNDOSTATECOUNT - state->redo_point);
  27570         if (num) NK_MEMCPY(state->undo_rec + state->redo_point-1,
  27571             state->undo_rec + state->redo_point, num * sizeof(state->undo_rec[0]));
  27572     }
  27573 }
  27574 NK_INTERN struct nk_text_undo_record*
  27575 nk_textedit_create_undo_record(struct nk_text_undo_state *state, int numchars)
  27576 {
  27577     /* any time we create a new undo record, we discard redo*/
  27578     nk_textedit_flush_redo(state);
  27579 
  27580     /* if we have no free records, we have to make room,
  27581      * by sliding the existing records down */
  27582     if (state->undo_point == NK_TEXTEDIT_UNDOSTATECOUNT)
  27583         nk_textedit_discard_undo(state);
  27584 
  27585     /* if the characters to store won't possibly fit in the buffer,
  27586      * we can't undo */
  27587     if (numchars > NK_TEXTEDIT_UNDOCHARCOUNT) {
  27588         state->undo_point = 0;
  27589         state->undo_char_point = 0;
  27590         return 0;
  27591     }
  27592 
  27593     /* if we don't have enough free characters in the buffer,
  27594      * we have to make room */
  27595     while (state->undo_char_point + numchars > NK_TEXTEDIT_UNDOCHARCOUNT)
  27596         nk_textedit_discard_undo(state);
  27597     return &state->undo_rec[state->undo_point++];
  27598 }
  27599 NK_INTERN nk_rune*
  27600 nk_textedit_createundo(struct nk_text_undo_state *state, int pos,
  27601     int insert_len, int delete_len)
  27602 {
  27603     struct nk_text_undo_record *r = nk_textedit_create_undo_record(state, insert_len);
  27604     if (r == 0)
  27605         return 0;
  27606 
  27607     r->where = pos;
  27608     r->insert_length = (short) insert_len;
  27609     r->delete_length = (short) delete_len;
  27610 
  27611     if (insert_len == 0) {
  27612         r->char_storage = -1;
  27613         return 0;
  27614     } else {
  27615         r->char_storage = state->undo_char_point;
  27616         state->undo_char_point = (short)(state->undo_char_point +  insert_len);
  27617         return &state->undo_char[r->char_storage];
  27618     }
  27619 }
  27620 NK_API void
  27621 nk_textedit_undo(struct nk_text_edit *state)
  27622 {
  27623     struct nk_text_undo_state *s = &state->undo;
  27624     struct nk_text_undo_record u, *r;
  27625     if (s->undo_point == 0)
  27626         return;
  27627 
  27628     /* we need to do two things: apply the undo record, and create a redo record */
  27629     u = s->undo_rec[s->undo_point-1];
  27630     r = &s->undo_rec[s->redo_point-1];
  27631     r->char_storage = -1;
  27632 
  27633     r->insert_length = u.delete_length;
  27634     r->delete_length = u.insert_length;
  27635     r->where = u.where;
  27636 
  27637     if (u.delete_length)
  27638     {
  27639        /*   if the undo record says to delete characters, then the redo record will
  27640             need to re-insert the characters that get deleted, so we need to store
  27641             them.
  27642             there are three cases:
  27643                 - there's enough room to store the characters
  27644                 - characters stored for *redoing* don't leave room for redo
  27645                 - characters stored for *undoing* don't leave room for redo
  27646             if the last is true, we have to bail */
  27647         if (s->undo_char_point + u.delete_length >= NK_TEXTEDIT_UNDOCHARCOUNT) {
  27648             /* the undo records take up too much character space; there's no space
  27649             * to store the redo characters */
  27650             r->insert_length = 0;
  27651         } else {
  27652             int i;
  27653             /* there's definitely room to store the characters eventually */
  27654             while (s->undo_char_point + u.delete_length > s->redo_char_point) {
  27655                 /* there's currently not enough room, so discard a redo record */
  27656                 nk_textedit_discard_redo(s);
  27657                 /* should never happen: */
  27658                 if (s->redo_point == NK_TEXTEDIT_UNDOSTATECOUNT)
  27659                     return;
  27660             }
  27661 
  27662             r = &s->undo_rec[s->redo_point-1];
  27663             r->char_storage = (short)(s->redo_char_point - u.delete_length);
  27664             s->redo_char_point = (short)(s->redo_char_point -  u.delete_length);
  27665 
  27666             /* now save the characters */
  27667             for (i=0; i < u.delete_length; ++i)
  27668                 s->undo_char[r->char_storage + i] =
  27669                     nk_str_rune_at(&state->string, u.where + i);
  27670         }
  27671         /* now we can carry out the deletion */
  27672         nk_str_delete_runes(&state->string, u.where, u.delete_length);
  27673     }
  27674 
  27675     /* check type of recorded action: */
  27676     if (u.insert_length) {
  27677         /* easy case: was a deletion, so we need to insert n characters */
  27678         nk_str_insert_text_runes(&state->string, u.where,
  27679             &s->undo_char[u.char_storage], u.insert_length);
  27680         s->undo_char_point = (short)(s->undo_char_point - u.insert_length);
  27681     }
  27682     state->cursor = (short)(u.where + u.insert_length);
  27683 
  27684     s->undo_point--;
  27685     s->redo_point--;
  27686 }
  27687 NK_API void
  27688 nk_textedit_redo(struct nk_text_edit *state)
  27689 {
  27690     struct nk_text_undo_state *s = &state->undo;
  27691     struct nk_text_undo_record *u, r;
  27692     if (s->redo_point == NK_TEXTEDIT_UNDOSTATECOUNT)
  27693         return;
  27694 
  27695     /* we need to do two things: apply the redo record, and create an undo record */
  27696     u = &s->undo_rec[s->undo_point];
  27697     r = s->undo_rec[s->redo_point];
  27698 
  27699     /* we KNOW there must be room for the undo record, because the redo record
  27700     was derived from an undo record */
  27701     u->delete_length = r.insert_length;
  27702     u->insert_length = r.delete_length;
  27703     u->where = r.where;
  27704     u->char_storage = -1;
  27705 
  27706     if (r.delete_length) {
  27707         /* the redo record requires us to delete characters, so the undo record
  27708         needs to store the characters */
  27709         if (s->undo_char_point + u->insert_length > s->redo_char_point) {
  27710             u->insert_length = 0;
  27711             u->delete_length = 0;
  27712         } else {
  27713             int i;
  27714             u->char_storage = s->undo_char_point;
  27715             s->undo_char_point = (short)(s->undo_char_point + u->insert_length);
  27716 
  27717             /* now save the characters */
  27718             for (i=0; i < u->insert_length; ++i) {
  27719                 s->undo_char[u->char_storage + i] =
  27720                     nk_str_rune_at(&state->string, u->where + i);
  27721             }
  27722         }
  27723         nk_str_delete_runes(&state->string, r.where, r.delete_length);
  27724     }
  27725 
  27726     if (r.insert_length) {
  27727         /* easy case: need to insert n characters */
  27728         nk_str_insert_text_runes(&state->string, r.where,
  27729             &s->undo_char[r.char_storage], r.insert_length);
  27730     }
  27731     state->cursor = r.where + r.insert_length;
  27732 
  27733     s->undo_point++;
  27734     s->redo_point++;
  27735 }
  27736 NK_INTERN void
  27737 nk_textedit_makeundo_insert(struct nk_text_edit *state, int where, int length)
  27738 {
  27739     nk_textedit_createundo(&state->undo, where, 0, length);
  27740 }
  27741 NK_INTERN void
  27742 nk_textedit_makeundo_delete(struct nk_text_edit *state, int where, int length)
  27743 {
  27744     int i;
  27745     nk_rune *p = nk_textedit_createundo(&state->undo, where, length, 0);
  27746     if (p) {
  27747         for (i=0; i < length; ++i)
  27748             p[i] = nk_str_rune_at(&state->string, where+i);
  27749     }
  27750 }
  27751 NK_INTERN void
  27752 nk_textedit_makeundo_replace(struct nk_text_edit *state, int where,
  27753     int old_length, int new_length)
  27754 {
  27755     int i;
  27756     nk_rune *p = nk_textedit_createundo(&state->undo, where, old_length, new_length);
  27757     if (p) {
  27758         for (i=0; i < old_length; ++i)
  27759             p[i] = nk_str_rune_at(&state->string, where+i);
  27760     }
  27761 }
  27762 NK_LIB void
  27763 nk_textedit_clear_state(struct nk_text_edit *state, enum nk_text_edit_type type,
  27764     nk_plugin_filter filter)
  27765 {
  27766     /* reset the state to default */
  27767    state->undo.undo_point = 0;
  27768    state->undo.undo_char_point = 0;
  27769    state->undo.redo_point = NK_TEXTEDIT_UNDOSTATECOUNT;
  27770    state->undo.redo_char_point = NK_TEXTEDIT_UNDOCHARCOUNT;
  27771    state->select_end = state->select_start = 0;
  27772    state->cursor = 0;
  27773    state->has_preferred_x = 0;
  27774    state->preferred_x = 0;
  27775    state->cursor_at_end_of_line = 0;
  27776    state->initialized = 1;
  27777    state->single_line = (unsigned char)(type == NK_TEXT_EDIT_SINGLE_LINE);
  27778    state->mode = NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_VIEW;
  27779    state->filter = filter;
  27780    state->scrollbar = nk_vec2(0,0);
  27781 }
  27782 NK_API void
  27783 nk_textedit_init_fixed(struct nk_text_edit *state, void *memory, nk_size size)
  27784 {
  27785     NK_ASSERT(state);
  27786     NK_ASSERT(memory);
  27787     if (!state || !memory || !size) return;
  27788     NK_MEMSET(state, 0, sizeof(struct nk_text_edit));
  27789     nk_textedit_clear_state(state, NK_TEXT_EDIT_SINGLE_LINE, 0);
  27790     nk_str_init_fixed(&state->string, memory, size);
  27791 }
  27792 NK_API void
  27793 nk_textedit_init(struct nk_text_edit *state, const struct nk_allocator *alloc, nk_size size)
  27794 {
  27795     NK_ASSERT(state);
  27796     NK_ASSERT(alloc);
  27797     if (!state || !alloc) return;
  27798     NK_MEMSET(state, 0, sizeof(struct nk_text_edit));
  27799     nk_textedit_clear_state(state, NK_TEXT_EDIT_SINGLE_LINE, 0);
  27800     nk_str_init(&state->string, alloc, size);
  27801 }
  27802 #ifdef NK_INCLUDE_DEFAULT_ALLOCATOR
  27803 NK_API void
  27804 nk_textedit_init_default(struct nk_text_edit *state)
  27805 {
  27806     NK_ASSERT(state);
  27807     if (!state) return;
  27808     NK_MEMSET(state, 0, sizeof(struct nk_text_edit));
  27809     nk_textedit_clear_state(state, NK_TEXT_EDIT_SINGLE_LINE, 0);
  27810     nk_str_init_default(&state->string);
  27811 }
  27812 #endif
  27813 NK_API void
  27814 nk_textedit_select_all(struct nk_text_edit *state)
  27815 {
  27816     NK_ASSERT(state);
  27817     state->select_start = 0;
  27818     state->select_end = state->string.len;
  27819 }
  27820 NK_API void
  27821 nk_textedit_free(struct nk_text_edit *state)
  27822 {
  27823     NK_ASSERT(state);
  27824     if (!state) return;
  27825     nk_str_free(&state->string);
  27826 }

  27832 /* ===============================================================
  27833  *
  27834  *                          FILTER
  27835  *
  27836  * ===============================================================*/
  27837 NK_API nk_bool
  27838 nk_filter_default(const struct nk_text_edit *box, nk_rune unicode)
  27839 {
  27840     NK_UNUSED(unicode);
  27841     NK_UNUSED(box);
  27842     return nk_true;
  27843 }
  27844 NK_API nk_bool
  27845 nk_filter_ascii(const struct nk_text_edit *box, nk_rune unicode)
  27846 {
  27847     NK_UNUSED(box);
  27848     if (unicode > 128) return nk_false;
  27849     else return nk_true;
  27850 }
  27851 NK_API nk_bool
  27852 nk_filter_float(const struct nk_text_edit *box, nk_rune unicode)
  27853 {
  27854     NK_UNUSED(box);
  27855     if ((unicode < '0' || unicode > '9') && unicode != '.' && unicode != '-')
  27856         return nk_false;
  27857     else return nk_true;
  27858 }
  27859 NK_API nk_bool
  27860 nk_filter_decimal(const struct nk_text_edit *box, nk_rune unicode)
  27861 {
  27862     NK_UNUSED(box);
  27863     if ((unicode < '0' || unicode > '9') && unicode != '-')
  27864         return nk_false;
  27865     else return nk_true;
  27866 }
  27867 NK_API nk_bool
  27868 nk_filter_hex(const struct nk_text_edit *box, nk_rune unicode)
  27869 {
  27870     NK_UNUSED(box);
  27871     if ((unicode < '0' || unicode > '9') &&
  27872         (unicode < 'a' || unicode > 'f') &&
  27873         (unicode < 'A' || unicode > 'F'))
  27874         return nk_false;
  27875     else return nk_true;
  27876 }
  27877 NK_API nk_bool
  27878 nk_filter_oct(const struct nk_text_edit *box, nk_rune unicode)
  27879 {
  27880     NK_UNUSED(box);
  27881     if (unicode < '0' || unicode > '7')
  27882         return nk_false;
  27883     else return nk_true;
  27884 }
  27885 NK_API nk_bool
  27886 nk_filter_binary(const struct nk_text_edit *box, nk_rune unicode)
  27887 {
  27888     NK_UNUSED(box);
  27889     if (unicode != '0' && unicode != '1')
  27890         return nk_false;
  27891     else return nk_true;
  27892 }
