  27894 /* ===============================================================
  27895  *
  27896  *                          EDIT
  27897  *
  27898  * ===============================================================*/
  27899 NK_LIB void
  27900 nk_edit_draw_text(struct nk_command_buffer *out,
  27901     const struct nk_style_edit *style, float pos_x, float pos_y,
  27902     float x_offset, const char *text, int byte_len, float row_height,
  27903     const struct nk_user_font *font, struct nk_color background,
  27904     struct nk_color foreground, nk_bool is_selected)
  27905 {
  27906     NK_ASSERT(out);
  27907     NK_ASSERT(font);
  27908     NK_ASSERT(style);
  27909     if (!text || !byte_len || !out || !style) return;
  27910 
  27911     {int glyph_len = 0;
  27912     nk_rune unicode = 0;
  27913     int text_len = 0;
  27914     float line_width = 0;
  27915     float glyph_width;
  27916     const char *line = text;
  27917     float line_offset = 0;
  27918     int line_count = 0;
  27919 
  27920     struct nk_text txt;
  27921     txt.padding = nk_vec2(0,0);
  27922     txt.background = background;
  27923     txt.text = foreground;
  27924 
  27925     foreground = nk_rgb_factor(foreground, style->color_factor);
  27926     background = nk_rgb_factor(background, style->color_factor);
  27927 
  27928     glyph_len = nk_utf_decode(text+text_len, &unicode, byte_len-text_len);
  27929     if (!glyph_len) return;
  27930     while ((text_len < byte_len) && glyph_len)
  27931     {
  27932         if (unicode == '\n') {
  27933             /* new line separator so draw previous line */
  27934             struct nk_rect label;
  27935             label.y = pos_y + line_offset;
  27936             label.h = row_height;
  27937             label.w = line_width;
  27938             label.x = pos_x;
  27939             if (!line_count)
  27940                 label.x += x_offset;
  27941 
  27942             if (is_selected) /* selection needs to draw different background color */
  27943                 nk_fill_rect(out, label, 0, background);
  27944             nk_widget_text(out, label, line, (int)((text + text_len) - line),
  27945                 &txt, NK_TEXT_CENTERED, font);
  27946 
  27947             text_len++;
  27948             line_count++;
  27949             line_width = 0;
  27950             line = text + text_len;
  27951             line_offset += row_height;
  27952             glyph_len = nk_utf_decode(text + text_len, &unicode, (int)(byte_len-text_len));
  27953             continue;
  27954         }
  27955         if (unicode == '\r') {
  27956             text_len++;
  27957             glyph_len = nk_utf_decode(text + text_len, &unicode, byte_len-text_len);
  27958             continue;
  27959         }
  27960         glyph_width = font->width(font->userdata, font->height, text+text_len, glyph_len);
  27961         line_width += (float)glyph_width;
  27962         text_len += glyph_len;
  27963         glyph_len = nk_utf_decode(text + text_len, &unicode, byte_len-text_len);
  27964         continue;
  27965     }
  27966     if (line_width > 0) {
  27967         /* draw last line */
  27968         struct nk_rect label;
  27969         label.y = pos_y + line_offset;
  27970         label.h = row_height;
  27971         label.w = line_width;
  27972         label.x = pos_x;
  27973         if (!line_count)
  27974             label.x += x_offset;
  27975 
  27976         if (is_selected)
  27977             nk_fill_rect(out, label, 0, background);
  27978         nk_widget_text(out, label, line, (int)((text + text_len) - line),
  27979             &txt, NK_TEXT_LEFT, font);
  27980     }}
  27981 }
  27982 NK_LIB nk_flags
  27983 nk_do_edit(nk_flags *state, struct nk_command_buffer *out,
  27984     struct nk_rect bounds, nk_flags flags, nk_plugin_filter filter,
  27985     struct nk_text_edit *edit, const struct nk_style_edit *style,
  27986     struct nk_input *in, const struct nk_user_font *font)
  27987 {
  27988     struct nk_rect area;
  27989     nk_flags ret = 0;
  27990     float row_height;
  27991     char prev_state = 0;
  27992     char is_hovered = 0;
  27993     char select_all = 0;
  27994     char cursor_follow = 0;
  27995     struct nk_rect old_clip;
  27996     struct nk_rect clip;
  27997 
  27998     NK_ASSERT(state);
  27999     NK_ASSERT(out);
  28000     NK_ASSERT(style);
  28001     if (!state || !out || !style)
  28002         return ret;
  28003 
  28004     /* visible text area calculation */
  28005     area.x = bounds.x + style->padding.x + style->border;
  28006     area.y = bounds.y + style->padding.y + style->border;
  28007     area.w = bounds.w - (2.0f * style->padding.x + 2 * style->border);
  28008     area.h = bounds.h - (2.0f * style->padding.y + 2 * style->border);
  28009     if (flags & NK_EDIT_MULTILINE)
  28010         area.w = NK_MAX(0, area.w - style->scrollbar_size.x);
  28011     row_height = (flags & NK_EDIT_MULTILINE)? font->height + style->row_padding: area.h;
  28012 
  28013     /* calculate clipping rectangle */
  28014     old_clip = out->clip;
  28015     nk_unify(&clip, &old_clip, area.x, area.y, area.x + area.w, area.y + area.h);
  28016 
  28017     /* update edit state */
  28018     prev_state = (char)edit->active;
  28019     if (in && in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].clicked && in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].down) {
  28020         edit->active = NK_INBOX(in->mouse.pos.x, in->mouse.pos.y,
  28021                                 bounds.x, bounds.y, bounds.w, bounds.h);
  28022     }
  28023 
  28024     /* (de)activate text editor */
  28025     if (!prev_state && edit->active) {
  28026         const enum nk_text_edit_type type = (flags & NK_EDIT_MULTILINE) ?
  28027             NK_TEXT_EDIT_MULTI_LINE: NK_TEXT_EDIT_SINGLE_LINE;
  28028         /* keep scroll position when re-activating edit widget */
  28029         struct nk_vec2 oldscrollbar = edit->scrollbar;
  28030         nk_textedit_clear_state(edit, type, filter);
  28031         edit->scrollbar = oldscrollbar;
  28032         if (flags & NK_EDIT_AUTO_SELECT)
  28033             select_all = nk_true;
  28034         if (flags & NK_EDIT_GOTO_END_ON_ACTIVATE) {
  28035             edit->cursor = edit->string.len;
  28036             in = 0;
  28037         }
  28038     } else if (!edit->active) edit->mode = NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_VIEW;
  28039     if (flags & NK_EDIT_READ_ONLY)
  28040         edit->mode = NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_VIEW;
  28041     else if (flags & NK_EDIT_ALWAYS_INSERT_MODE)
  28042         edit->mode = NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_INSERT;
  28043 
  28044     ret = (edit->active) ? NK_EDIT_ACTIVE: NK_EDIT_INACTIVE;
  28045     if (prev_state != edit->active)
  28046         ret |= (edit->active) ? NK_EDIT_ACTIVATED: NK_EDIT_DEACTIVATED;
  28047 
  28048     /* handle user input */
  28049     if (edit->active && in)
  28050     {
  28051         int shift_mod = in->keyboard.keys[NK_KEY_SHIFT].down;
  28052         const float mouse_x = (in->mouse.pos.x - area.x) + edit->scrollbar.x;
  28053         const float mouse_y = (in->mouse.pos.y - area.y) + edit->scrollbar.y;
  28054 
  28055         /* mouse click handler */
  28056         is_hovered = (char)nk_input_is_mouse_hovering_rect(in, area);
  28057         if (select_all) {
  28058             nk_textedit_select_all(edit);
  28059         } else if (is_hovered && in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].down &&
  28060             in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].clicked) {
  28061             nk_textedit_click(edit, mouse_x, mouse_y, font, row_height);
  28062         } else if (is_hovered && in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].down &&
  28063             (in->mouse.delta.x != 0.0f || in->mouse.delta.y != 0.0f)) {
  28064             nk_textedit_drag(edit, mouse_x, mouse_y, font, row_height);
  28065             cursor_follow = nk_true;
  28066         } else if (is_hovered && in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_RIGHT].clicked &&
  28067             in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_RIGHT].down) {
  28068             nk_textedit_key(edit, NK_KEY_TEXT_WORD_LEFT, nk_false, font, row_height);
  28069             nk_textedit_key(edit, NK_KEY_TEXT_WORD_RIGHT, nk_true, font, row_height);
  28070             cursor_follow = nk_true;
  28071         }
  28072 
  28073         {int i; /* keyboard input */
  28074         int old_mode = edit->mode;
  28075         for (i = 0; i < NK_KEY_MAX; ++i) {
  28076             if (i == NK_KEY_ENTER || i == NK_KEY_TAB) continue; /* special case */
  28077             if (nk_input_is_key_pressed(in, (enum nk_keys)i)) {
  28078                 nk_textedit_key(edit, (enum nk_keys)i, shift_mod, font, row_height);
  28079                 cursor_follow = nk_true;
  28080             }
  28081         }
  28082         if (old_mode != edit->mode) {
  28083             in->keyboard.text_len = 0;
  28084         }}
  28085 
  28086         /* text input */
  28087         edit->filter = filter;
  28088         if (in->keyboard.text_len) {
  28089             nk_textedit_text(edit, in->keyboard.text, in->keyboard.text_len);
  28090             cursor_follow = nk_true;
  28091             in->keyboard.text_len = 0;
  28092         }
  28093 
  28094         /* enter key handler */
  28095         if (nk_input_is_key_pressed(in, NK_KEY_ENTER)) {
  28096             cursor_follow = nk_true;
  28097             if (flags & NK_EDIT_CTRL_ENTER_NEWLINE && shift_mod)
  28098                 nk_textedit_text(edit, "\n", 1);
  28099             else if (flags & NK_EDIT_SIG_ENTER)
  28100                 ret |= NK_EDIT_COMMITED;
  28101             else nk_textedit_text(edit, "\n", 1);
  28102         }
  28103 
  28104         /* cut & copy handler */
  28105         {int copy= nk_input_is_key_pressed(in, NK_KEY_COPY);
  28106         int cut = nk_input_is_key_pressed(in, NK_KEY_CUT);
  28107         if ((copy || cut) && (flags & NK_EDIT_CLIPBOARD))
  28108         {
  28109             int glyph_len;
  28110             nk_rune unicode;
  28111             const char *text;
  28112             int b = edit->select_start;
  28113             int e = edit->select_end;
  28114 
  28115             int begin = NK_MIN(b, e);
  28116             int end = NK_MAX(b, e);
  28117             text = nk_str_at_const(&edit->string, begin, &unicode, &glyph_len);
  28118             if (edit->clip.copy)
  28119                 edit->clip.copy(edit->clip.userdata, text, end - begin);
  28120             if (cut && !(flags & NK_EDIT_READ_ONLY)){
  28121                 nk_textedit_cut(edit);
  28122                 cursor_follow = nk_true;
  28123             }
  28124         }}
  28125 
  28126         /* paste handler */
  28127         {int paste = nk_input_is_key_pressed(in, NK_KEY_PASTE);
  28128         if (paste && (flags & NK_EDIT_CLIPBOARD) && edit->clip.paste) {
  28129             edit->clip.paste(edit->clip.userdata, edit);
  28130             cursor_follow = nk_true;
  28131         }}
  28132 
  28133         /* tab handler */
  28134         {int tab = nk_input_is_key_pressed(in, NK_KEY_TAB);
  28135         if (tab && (flags & NK_EDIT_ALLOW_TAB)) {
  28136             nk_textedit_text(edit, "    ", 4);
  28137             cursor_follow = nk_true;
  28138         }}
  28139     }
  28140 
  28141     /* set widget state */
  28142     if (edit->active)
  28143         *state = NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVE;
  28144     else nk_widget_state_reset(state);
  28145 
  28146     if (is_hovered)
  28147         *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVERED;
  28148 
  28149     /* DRAW EDIT */
  28150     {const char *text = nk_str_get_const(&edit->string);
  28151     int len = nk_str_len_char(&edit->string);
  28152 
  28153     {/* select background colors/images  */
  28154     const struct nk_style_item *background;
  28155     if (*state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED)
  28156         background = &style->active;
  28157     else if (*state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER)
  28158         background = &style->hover;
  28159     else background = &style->normal;
  28160 
  28161     /* draw background frame */
  28162     switch(background->type) {
  28163         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE:
  28164             nk_draw_image(out, bounds, &background->data.image, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  28165             break;
  28166         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_NINE_SLICE:
  28167             nk_draw_nine_slice(out, bounds, &background->data.slice, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  28168             break;
  28169         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR:
  28170             nk_fill_rect(out, bounds, style->rounding, nk_rgb_factor(background->data.color, style->color_factor));
  28171             nk_stroke_rect(out, bounds, style->rounding, style->border, nk_rgb_factor(style->border_color, style->color_factor));
  28172             break;
  28173     }}
  28174 
  28175 
  28176     area.w = NK_MAX(0, area.w - style->cursor_size);
  28177     if (edit->active)
  28178     {
  28179         int total_lines = 1;
  28180         struct nk_vec2 text_size = nk_vec2(0,0);
  28181 
  28182         /* text pointer positions */
  28183         const char *cursor_ptr = 0;
  28184         const char *select_begin_ptr = 0;
  28185         const char *select_end_ptr = 0;
  28186 
  28187         /* 2D pixel positions */
  28188         struct nk_vec2 cursor_pos = nk_vec2(0,0);
  28189         struct nk_vec2 selection_offset_start = nk_vec2(0,0);
  28190         struct nk_vec2 selection_offset_end = nk_vec2(0,0);
  28191 
  28192         int selection_begin = NK_MIN(edit->select_start, edit->select_end);
  28193         int selection_end = NK_MAX(edit->select_start, edit->select_end);
  28194 
  28195         /* calculate total line count + total space + cursor/selection position */
  28196         float line_width = 0.0f;
  28197         if (text && len)
  28198         {
  28199             /* utf8 encoding */
  28200             float glyph_width;
  28201             int glyph_len = 0;
  28202             nk_rune unicode = 0;
  28203             int text_len = 0;
  28204             int glyphs = 0;
  28205             int row_begin = 0;
  28206 
  28207             glyph_len = nk_utf_decode(text, &unicode, len);
  28208             glyph_width = font->width(font->userdata, font->height, text, glyph_len);
  28209             line_width = 0;
  28210 
  28211             /* iterate all lines */
  28212             while ((text_len < len) && glyph_len)
  28213             {
  28214                 /* set cursor 2D position and line */
  28215                 if (!cursor_ptr && glyphs == edit->cursor)
  28216                 {
  28217                     int glyph_offset;
  28218                     struct nk_vec2 out_offset;
  28219                     struct nk_vec2 row_size;
  28220                     const char *remaining;
  28221 
  28222                     /* calculate 2d position */
  28223                     cursor_pos.y = (float)(total_lines-1) * row_height;
  28224                     row_size = nk_text_calculate_text_bounds(font, text+row_begin,
  28225                                 text_len-row_begin, row_height, &remaining,
  28226                                 &out_offset, &glyph_offset, NK_STOP_ON_NEW_LINE);
  28227                     cursor_pos.x = row_size.x;
  28228                     cursor_ptr = text + text_len;
  28229                 }
  28230 
  28231                 /* set start selection 2D position and line */
  28232                 if (!select_begin_ptr && edit->select_start != edit->select_end &&
  28233                     glyphs == selection_begin)
  28234                 {
  28235                     int glyph_offset;
  28236                     struct nk_vec2 out_offset;
  28237                     struct nk_vec2 row_size;
  28238                     const char *remaining;
  28239 
  28240                     /* calculate 2d position */
  28241                     selection_offset_start.y = (float)(NK_MAX(total_lines-1,0)) * row_height;
  28242                     row_size = nk_text_calculate_text_bounds(font, text+row_begin,
  28243                                 text_len-row_begin, row_height, &remaining,
  28244                                 &out_offset, &glyph_offset, NK_STOP_ON_NEW_LINE);
  28245                     selection_offset_start.x = row_size.x;
  28246                     select_begin_ptr = text + text_len;
  28247                 }
  28248 
  28249                 /* set end selection 2D position and line */
  28250                 if (!select_end_ptr && edit->select_start != edit->select_end &&
  28251                     glyphs == selection_end)
  28252                 {
  28253                     int glyph_offset;
  28254                     struct nk_vec2 out_offset;
  28255                     struct nk_vec2 row_size;
  28256                     const char *remaining;
  28257 
  28258                     /* calculate 2d position */
  28259                     selection_offset_end.y = (float)(total_lines-1) * row_height;
  28260                     row_size = nk_text_calculate_text_bounds(font, text+row_begin,
  28261                                 text_len-row_begin, row_height, &remaining,
  28262                                 &out_offset, &glyph_offset, NK_STOP_ON_NEW_LINE);
  28263                     selection_offset_end.x = row_size.x;
  28264                     select_end_ptr = text + text_len;
  28265                 }
  28266                 if (unicode == '\n') {
  28267                     text_size.x = NK_MAX(text_size.x, line_width);
  28268                     total_lines++;
  28269                     line_width = 0;
  28270                     text_len++;
  28271                     glyphs++;
  28272                     row_begin = text_len;
  28273                     glyph_len = nk_utf_decode(text + text_len, &unicode, len-text_len);
  28274                     glyph_width = font->width(font->userdata, font->height, text+text_len, glyph_len);
  28275                     continue;
  28276                 }
  28277 
  28278                 glyphs++;
  28279                 text_len += glyph_len;
  28280                 line_width += (float)glyph_width;
  28281 
  28282                 glyph_len = nk_utf_decode(text + text_len, &unicode, len-text_len);
  28283                 glyph_width = font->width(font->userdata, font->height,
  28284                     text+text_len, glyph_len);
  28285                 continue;
  28286             }
  28287             text_size.y = (float)total_lines * row_height;
  28288 
  28289             /* handle case when cursor is at end of text buffer */
  28290             if (!cursor_ptr && edit->cursor == edit->string.len) {
  28291                 cursor_pos.x = line_width;
  28292                 cursor_pos.y = text_size.y - row_height;
  28293             }
  28294         }
  28295         {
  28296             /* scrollbar */
  28297             if (cursor_follow)
  28298             {
  28299                 /* update scrollbar to follow cursor */
  28300                 if (!(flags & NK_EDIT_NO_HORIZONTAL_SCROLL)) {
  28301                     /* horizontal scroll */
  28302                     const float scroll_increment = area.w * 0.25f;
  28303                     if (cursor_pos.x < edit->scrollbar.x)
  28304                         edit->scrollbar.x = (float)(int)NK_MAX(0.0f, cursor_pos.x - scroll_increment);
  28305                     if (cursor_pos.x >= edit->scrollbar.x + area.w)
  28306                         edit->scrollbar.x = (float)(int)NK_MAX(0.0f, cursor_pos.x - area.w + scroll_increment);
  28307                 } else edit->scrollbar.x = 0;
  28308 
  28309                 if (flags & NK_EDIT_MULTILINE) {
  28310                     /* vertical scroll: like horizontal, it only adjusts if the
  28311                      * cursor leaves the visible area, and then only just enough
  28312                      * to keep it visible */
  28313                     if (cursor_pos.y < edit->scrollbar.y)
  28314                         edit->scrollbar.y = NK_MAX(0.0f, cursor_pos.y);
  28315                     if (cursor_pos.y > edit->scrollbar.y + area.h - row_height)
  28316                         edit->scrollbar.y = edit->scrollbar.y + row_height;
  28317                 } else edit->scrollbar.y = 0;
  28318             }
  28319 
  28320             /* scrollbar widget */
  28321             if (flags & NK_EDIT_MULTILINE)
  28322             {
  28323                 nk_flags ws;
  28324                 struct nk_rect scroll;
  28325                 float scroll_target;
  28326                 float scroll_offset;
  28327                 float scroll_step;
  28328                 float scroll_inc;
  28329 
  28330                 scroll = area;
  28331                 scroll.x = (bounds.x + bounds.w - style->border) - style->scrollbar_size.x;
  28332                 scroll.w = style->scrollbar_size.x;
  28333 
  28334                 scroll_offset = edit->scrollbar.y;
  28335                 scroll_step = scroll.h * 0.10f;
  28336                 scroll_inc = scroll.h * 0.01f;
  28337                 scroll_target = text_size.y;
  28338                 edit->scrollbar.y = nk_do_scrollbarv(&ws, out, scroll, is_hovered,
  28339                         scroll_offset, scroll_target, scroll_step, scroll_inc,
  28340                         &style->scrollbar, in, font);
  28341                 /* Eat mouse scroll if we're active */
  28342                 if (is_hovered && in->mouse.scroll_delta.y) {
  28343                     in->mouse.scroll_delta.y = 0;
  28344                 }
  28345             }
  28346         }
  28347 
  28348         /* draw text */
  28349         {struct nk_color background_color;
  28350         struct nk_color text_color;
  28351         struct nk_color sel_background_color;
  28352         struct nk_color sel_text_color;
  28353         struct nk_color cursor_color;
  28354         struct nk_color cursor_text_color;
  28355         const struct nk_style_item *background;
  28356         nk_push_scissor(out, clip);
  28357 
  28358         /* select correct colors to draw */
  28359         if (*state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED) {
  28360             background = &style->active;
  28361             text_color = style->text_active;
  28362             sel_text_color = style->selected_text_hover;
  28363             sel_background_color = style->selected_hover;
  28364             cursor_color = style->cursor_hover;
  28365             cursor_text_color = style->cursor_text_hover;
  28366         } else if (*state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER) {
  28367             background = &style->hover;
  28368             text_color = style->text_hover;
  28369             sel_text_color = style->selected_text_hover;
  28370             sel_background_color = style->selected_hover;
  28371             cursor_text_color = style->cursor_text_hover;
  28372             cursor_color = style->cursor_hover;
  28373         } else {
  28374             background = &style->normal;
  28375             text_color = style->text_normal;
  28376             sel_text_color = style->selected_text_normal;
  28377             sel_background_color = style->selected_normal;
  28378             cursor_color = style->cursor_normal;
  28379             cursor_text_color = style->cursor_text_normal;
  28380         }
  28381         if (background->type == NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE)
  28382             background_color = nk_rgba(0,0,0,0);
  28383         else
  28384             background_color = background->data.color;
  28385 
  28386         cursor_color = nk_rgb_factor(cursor_color, style->color_factor);
  28387         cursor_text_color = nk_rgb_factor(cursor_text_color, style->color_factor);
  28388 
  28389         if (edit->select_start == edit->select_end) {
  28390             /* no selection so just draw the complete text */
  28391             const char *begin = nk_str_get_const(&edit->string);
  28392             int l = nk_str_len_char(&edit->string);
  28393             nk_edit_draw_text(out, style, area.x - edit->scrollbar.x,
  28394                 area.y - edit->scrollbar.y, 0, begin, l, row_height, font,
  28395                 background_color, text_color, nk_false);
  28396         } else {
  28397             /* edit has selection so draw 1-3 text chunks */
  28398             if (edit->select_start != edit->select_end && selection_begin > 0){
  28399                 /* draw unselected text before selection */
  28400                 const char *begin = nk_str_get_const(&edit->string);
  28401                 NK_ASSERT(select_begin_ptr);
  28402                 nk_edit_draw_text(out, style, area.x - edit->scrollbar.x,
  28403                     area.y - edit->scrollbar.y, 0, begin, (int)(select_begin_ptr - begin),
  28404                     row_height, font, background_color, text_color, nk_false);
  28405             }
  28406             if (edit->select_start != edit->select_end) {
  28407                 /* draw selected text */
  28408                 NK_ASSERT(select_begin_ptr);
  28409                 if (!select_end_ptr) {
  28410                     const char *begin = nk_str_get_const(&edit->string);
  28411                     select_end_ptr = begin + nk_str_len_char(&edit->string);
  28412                 }
  28413                 nk_edit_draw_text(out, style,
  28414                     area.x - edit->scrollbar.x,
  28415                     area.y + selection_offset_start.y - edit->scrollbar.y,
  28416                     selection_offset_start.x,
  28417                     select_begin_ptr, (int)(select_end_ptr - select_begin_ptr),
  28418                     row_height, font, sel_background_color, sel_text_color, nk_true);
  28419             }
  28420             if ((edit->select_start != edit->select_end &&
  28421                 selection_end < edit->string.len))
  28422             {
  28423                 /* draw unselected text after selected text */
  28424                 const char *begin = select_end_ptr;
  28425                 const char *end = nk_str_get_const(&edit->string) +
  28426                                     nk_str_len_char(&edit->string);
  28427                 NK_ASSERT(select_end_ptr);
  28428                 nk_edit_draw_text(out, style,
  28429                     area.x - edit->scrollbar.x,
  28430                     area.y + selection_offset_end.y - edit->scrollbar.y,
  28431                     selection_offset_end.x,
  28432                     begin, (int)(end - begin), row_height, font,
  28433                     background_color, text_color, nk_true);
  28434             }
  28435         }
  28436 
  28437         /* cursor */
  28438         if (edit->select_start == edit->select_end)
  28439         {
  28440             if (edit->cursor >= nk_str_len(&edit->string) ||
  28441                 (cursor_ptr && *cursor_ptr == '\n')) {
  28442                 /* draw cursor at end of line */
  28443                 struct nk_rect cursor;
  28444                 cursor.w = style->cursor_size;
  28445                 cursor.h = font->height;
  28446                 cursor.x = area.x + cursor_pos.x - edit->scrollbar.x;
  28447                 cursor.y = area.y + cursor_pos.y + row_height/2.0f - cursor.h/2.0f;
  28448                 cursor.y -= edit->scrollbar.y;
  28449                 nk_fill_rect(out, cursor, 0, cursor_color);
  28450             } else {
  28451                 /* draw cursor inside text */
  28452                 int glyph_len;
  28453                 struct nk_rect label;
  28454                 struct nk_text txt;
  28455 
  28456                 nk_rune unicode;
  28457                 NK_ASSERT(cursor_ptr);
  28458                 glyph_len = nk_utf_decode(cursor_ptr, &unicode, 4);
  28459 
  28460                 label.x = area.x + cursor_pos.x - edit->scrollbar.x;
  28461                 label.y = area.y + cursor_pos.y - edit->scrollbar.y;
  28462                 label.w = font->width(font->userdata, font->height, cursor_ptr, glyph_len);
  28463                 label.h = row_height;
  28464 
  28465                 txt.padding = nk_vec2(0,0);
  28466                 txt.background = cursor_color;;
  28467                 txt.text = cursor_text_color;
  28468                 nk_fill_rect(out, label, 0, cursor_color);
  28469                 nk_widget_text(out, label, cursor_ptr, glyph_len, &txt, NK_TEXT_LEFT, font);
  28470             }
  28471         }}
  28472     } else {
  28473         /* not active so just draw text */
  28474         int l = nk_str_len_char(&edit->string);
  28475         const char *begin = nk_str_get_const(&edit->string);
  28476 
  28477         const struct nk_style_item *background;
  28478         struct nk_color background_color;
  28479         struct nk_color text_color;
  28480         nk_push_scissor(out, clip);
  28481         if (*state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED) {
  28482             background = &style->active;
  28483             text_color = style->text_active;
  28484         } else if (*state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER) {
  28485             background = &style->hover;
  28486             text_color = style->text_hover;
  28487         } else {
  28488             background = &style->normal;
  28489             text_color = style->text_normal;
  28490         }
  28491         if (background->type == NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE)
  28492             background_color = nk_rgba(0,0,0,0);
  28493         else
  28494             background_color = background->data.color;
  28495 
  28496         background_color = nk_rgb_factor(background_color, style->color_factor);
  28497         text_color = nk_rgb_factor(text_color, style->color_factor);
  28498 
  28499         nk_edit_draw_text(out, style, area.x - edit->scrollbar.x,
  28500             area.y - edit->scrollbar.y, 0, begin, l, row_height, font,
  28501             background_color, text_color, nk_false);
  28502     }
  28503     nk_push_scissor(out, old_clip);}
  28504     return ret;
  28505 }
  28506 NK_API void
  28507 nk_edit_focus(struct nk_context *ctx, nk_flags flags)
  28508 {
  28509     nk_hash hash;
  28510     struct nk_window *win;
  28511 
  28512     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  28513     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  28514     if (!ctx || !ctx->current) return;
  28515 
  28516     win = ctx->current;
  28517     hash = win->edit.seq;
  28518     win->edit.active = nk_true;
  28519     win->edit.name = hash;
  28520     if (flags & NK_EDIT_ALWAYS_INSERT_MODE)
  28521         win->edit.mode = NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_INSERT;
  28522 }
  28523 NK_API void
  28524 nk_edit_unfocus(struct nk_context *ctx)
  28525 {
  28526     struct nk_window *win;
  28527     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  28528     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  28529     if (!ctx || !ctx->current) return;
  28530 
  28531     win = ctx->current;
  28532     win->edit.active = nk_false;
  28533     win->edit.name = 0;
  28534 }
  28535 NK_API nk_flags
  28536 nk_edit_string(struct nk_context *ctx, nk_flags flags,
  28537     char *memory, int *len, int max, nk_plugin_filter filter)
  28538 {
  28539     nk_hash hash;
  28540     nk_flags state;
  28541     struct nk_text_edit *edit;
  28542     struct nk_window *win;
  28543 
  28544     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  28545     NK_ASSERT(memory);
  28546     NK_ASSERT(len);
  28547     if (!ctx || !memory || !len)
  28548         return 0;
  28549 
  28550     filter = (!filter) ? nk_filter_default: filter;
  28551     win = ctx->current;
  28552     hash = win->edit.seq;
  28553     edit = &ctx->text_edit;
  28554     nk_textedit_clear_state(&ctx->text_edit, (flags & NK_EDIT_MULTILINE)?
  28555         NK_TEXT_EDIT_MULTI_LINE: NK_TEXT_EDIT_SINGLE_LINE, filter);
  28556 
  28557     if (win->edit.active && hash == win->edit.name) {
  28558         if (flags & NK_EDIT_NO_CURSOR)
  28559             edit->cursor = nk_utf_len(memory, *len);
  28560         else edit->cursor = win->edit.cursor;
  28561         if (!(flags & NK_EDIT_SELECTABLE)) {
  28562             edit->select_start = win->edit.cursor;
  28563             edit->select_end = win->edit.cursor;
  28564         } else {
  28565             edit->select_start = win->edit.sel_start;
  28566             edit->select_end = win->edit.sel_end;
  28567         }
  28568         edit->mode = win->edit.mode;
  28569         edit->scrollbar.x = (float)win->edit.scrollbar.x;
  28570         edit->scrollbar.y = (float)win->edit.scrollbar.y;
  28571         edit->active = nk_true;
  28572     } else edit->active = nk_false;
  28573 
  28574     max = NK_MAX(1, max);
  28575     *len = NK_MIN(*len, max-1);
  28576     nk_str_init_fixed(&edit->string, memory, (nk_size)max);
  28577     edit->string.buffer.allocated = (nk_size)*len;
  28578     edit->string.len = nk_utf_len(memory, *len);
  28579     state = nk_edit_buffer(ctx, flags, edit, filter);
  28580     *len = (int)edit->string.buffer.allocated;
  28581 
  28582     if (edit->active) {
  28583         win->edit.cursor = edit->cursor;
  28584         win->edit.sel_start = edit->select_start;
  28585         win->edit.sel_end = edit->select_end;
  28586         win->edit.mode = edit->mode;
  28587         win->edit.scrollbar.x = (nk_uint)edit->scrollbar.x;
  28588         win->edit.scrollbar.y = (nk_uint)edit->scrollbar.y;
  28589     } return state;
  28590 }
  28591 NK_API nk_flags
  28592 nk_edit_buffer(struct nk_context *ctx, nk_flags flags,
  28593     struct nk_text_edit *edit, nk_plugin_filter filter)
  28594 {
  28595     struct nk_window *win;
  28596     struct nk_style *style;
  28597     struct nk_input *in;
  28598 
  28599     enum nk_widget_layout_states state;
  28600     struct nk_rect bounds;
  28601 
  28602     nk_flags ret_flags = 0;
  28603     unsigned char prev_state;
  28604     nk_hash hash;
  28605 
  28606     /* make sure correct values */
  28607     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  28608     NK_ASSERT(edit);
  28609     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  28610     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  28611     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout)
  28612         return 0;
  28613 
  28614     win = ctx->current;
  28615     style = &ctx->style;
  28616     state = nk_widget(&bounds, ctx);
  28617     if (!state) return state;
  28618     else if (state == NK_WIDGET_DISABLED)
  28619         flags |= NK_EDIT_READ_ONLY;
  28620     in = (win->layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_ROM) ? 0 : &ctx->input;
  28621 
  28622     /* check if edit is currently hot item */
  28623     hash = win->edit.seq++;
  28624     if (win->edit.active && hash == win->edit.name) {
  28625         if (flags & NK_EDIT_NO_CURSOR)
  28626             edit->cursor = edit->string.len;
  28627         if (!(flags & NK_EDIT_SELECTABLE)) {
  28628             edit->select_start = edit->cursor;
  28629             edit->select_end = edit->cursor;
  28630         }
  28631         if (flags & NK_EDIT_CLIPBOARD)
  28632             edit->clip = ctx->clip;
  28633         edit->active = (unsigned char)win->edit.active;
  28634     } else edit->active = nk_false;
  28635     edit->mode = win->edit.mode;
  28636 
  28637     filter = (!filter) ? nk_filter_default: filter;
  28638     prev_state = (unsigned char)edit->active;
  28639     in = (flags & NK_EDIT_READ_ONLY) ? 0: in;
  28640     ret_flags = nk_do_edit(&ctx->last_widget_state, &win->buffer, bounds, flags,
  28641                     filter, edit, &style->edit, in, style->font);
  28642 
  28643     if (ctx->last_widget_state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER)
  28644         ctx->style.cursor_active = ctx->style.cursors[NK_CURSOR_TEXT];
  28645     if (edit->active && prev_state != edit->active) {
  28646         /* current edit is now hot */
  28647         win->edit.active = nk_true;
  28648         win->edit.name = hash;
  28649     } else if (prev_state && !edit->active) {
  28650         /* current edit is now cold */
  28651         win->edit.active = nk_false;
  28652     } return ret_flags;
  28653 }
  28654 NK_API nk_flags
  28655 nk_edit_string_zero_terminated(struct nk_context *ctx, nk_flags flags,
  28656     char *buffer, int max, nk_plugin_filter filter)
  28657 {
  28658     nk_flags result;
  28659     int len = nk_strlen(buffer);
  28660     result = nk_edit_string(ctx, flags, buffer, &len, max, filter);
  28661     buffer[NK_MIN(NK_MAX(max-1,0), len)] = '\0';
  28662     return result;
  28663 }

  28669 /* ===============================================================
  28670  *
  28671  *                              PROPERTY
  28672  *
  28673  * ===============================================================*/
  28674 NK_LIB void
  28675 nk_drag_behavior(nk_flags *state, const struct nk_input *in,
  28676     struct nk_rect drag, struct nk_property_variant *variant,
  28677     float inc_per_pixel)
  28678 {
  28679     int left_mouse_down = in && in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].down;
  28680     int left_mouse_click_in_cursor = in &&
  28681         nk_input_has_mouse_click_down_in_rect(in, NK_BUTTON_LEFT, drag, nk_true);
  28682 
  28683     nk_widget_state_reset(state);
  28684     if (nk_input_is_mouse_hovering_rect(in, drag))
  28685         *state = NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVERED;
  28686 
  28687     if (left_mouse_down && left_mouse_click_in_cursor) {
  28688         float delta, pixels;
  28689         pixels = in->mouse.delta.x;
  28690         delta = pixels * inc_per_pixel;
  28691         switch (variant->kind) {
  28692         default: break;
  28693         case NK_PROPERTY_INT:
  28694             variant->value.i = variant->value.i + (int)delta;
  28695             variant->value.i = NK_CLAMP(variant->min_value.i, variant->value.i, variant->max_value.i);
  28696             break;
  28697         case NK_PROPERTY_FLOAT:
  28698             variant->value.f = variant->value.f + (float)delta;
  28699             variant->value.f = NK_CLAMP(variant->min_value.f, variant->value.f, variant->max_value.f);
  28700             break;
  28701         case NK_PROPERTY_DOUBLE:
  28702             variant->value.d = variant->value.d + (double)delta;
  28703             variant->value.d = NK_CLAMP(variant->min_value.d, variant->value.d, variant->max_value.d);
  28704             break;
  28705         }
  28706         *state = NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVE;
  28707     }
  28708     if (*state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER && !nk_input_is_mouse_prev_hovering_rect(in, drag))
  28709         *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_ENTERED;
  28710     else if (nk_input_is_mouse_prev_hovering_rect(in, drag))
  28711         *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_LEFT;
  28712 }
  28713 NK_LIB void
  28714 nk_property_behavior(nk_flags *ws, const struct nk_input *in,
  28715     struct nk_rect property,  struct nk_rect label, struct nk_rect edit,
  28716     struct nk_rect empty, int *state, struct nk_property_variant *variant,
  28717     float inc_per_pixel)
  28718 {
  28719     nk_widget_state_reset(ws);
  28720     if (in && *state == NK_PROPERTY_DEFAULT) {
  28721         if (nk_button_behavior(ws, edit, in, NK_BUTTON_DEFAULT))
  28722             *state = NK_PROPERTY_EDIT;
  28723         else if (nk_input_is_mouse_click_down_in_rect(in, NK_BUTTON_LEFT, label, nk_true))
  28724             *state = NK_PROPERTY_DRAG;
  28725         else if (nk_input_is_mouse_click_down_in_rect(in, NK_BUTTON_LEFT, empty, nk_true))
  28726             *state = NK_PROPERTY_DRAG;
  28727     }
  28728     if (*state == NK_PROPERTY_DRAG) {
  28729         nk_drag_behavior(ws, in, property, variant, inc_per_pixel);
  28730         if (!(*ws & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED)) *state = NK_PROPERTY_DEFAULT;
  28731     }
  28732 }
  28733 NK_LIB void
  28734 nk_draw_property(struct nk_command_buffer *out, const struct nk_style_property *style,
  28735     const struct nk_rect *bounds, const struct nk_rect *label, nk_flags state,
  28736     const char *name, int len, const struct nk_user_font *font)
  28737 {
  28738     struct nk_text text;
  28739     const struct nk_style_item *background;
  28740 
  28741     /* select correct background and text color */
  28742     if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED) {
  28743         background = &style->active;
  28744         text.text = style->label_active;
  28745     } else if (state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER) {
  28746         background = &style->hover;
  28747         text.text = style->label_hover;
  28748     } else {
  28749         background = &style->normal;
  28750         text.text = style->label_normal;
  28751     }
  28752 
  28753     text.text = nk_rgb_factor(text.text, style->color_factor);
  28754 
  28755     /* draw background */
  28756     switch(background->type) {
  28757         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE:
  28758             text.background = nk_rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
  28759             nk_draw_image(out, *bounds, &background->data.image, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  28760             break;
  28761         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_NINE_SLICE:
  28762             text.background = nk_rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
  28763             nk_draw_nine_slice(out, *bounds, &background->data.slice, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  28764             break;
  28765         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR:
  28766             text.background = background->data.color;
  28767             nk_fill_rect(out, *bounds, style->rounding, nk_rgb_factor(background->data.color, style->color_factor));
  28768             nk_stroke_rect(out, *bounds, style->rounding, style->border, nk_rgb_factor(style->border_color, style->color_factor));
  28769             break;
  28770     }
  28771 
  28772     /* draw label */
  28773     text.padding = nk_vec2(0,0);
  28774     if (name && name[0] != '#') {
  28775         nk_widget_text(out, *label, name, len, &text, NK_TEXT_CENTERED, font);
  28776     }
  28777 }
  28778 NK_LIB void
  28779 nk_do_property(nk_flags *ws,
  28780     struct nk_command_buffer *out, struct nk_rect property,
  28781     const char *name, struct nk_property_variant *variant,
  28782     float inc_per_pixel, char *buffer, int *len,
  28783     int *state, int *cursor, int *select_begin, int *select_end,
  28784     const struct nk_style_property *style,
  28785     enum nk_property_filter filter, struct nk_input *in,
  28786     const struct nk_user_font *font, struct nk_text_edit *text_edit,
  28787     enum nk_button_behavior behavior)
  28788 {
  28789     const nk_plugin_filter filters[] = {
  28790         nk_filter_decimal,
  28791         nk_filter_float
  28792     };
  28793     nk_bool active, old;
  28794     int num_len = 0, name_len = 0;
  28795     char string[NK_MAX_NUMBER_BUFFER];
  28796     float size;
  28797 
  28798     char *dst = 0;
  28799     int *length;
  28800 
  28801     struct nk_rect left;
  28802     struct nk_rect right;
  28803     struct nk_rect label;
  28804     struct nk_rect edit;
  28805     struct nk_rect empty;
  28806 
  28807     /* left decrement button */
  28808     left.h = font->height/2;
  28809     left.w = left.h;
  28810     left.x = property.x + style->border + style->padding.x;
  28811     left.y = property.y + style->border + property.h/2.0f - left.h/2;
  28812 
  28813     /* text label */
  28814     if (name && name[0] != '#') {
  28815         name_len = nk_strlen(name);
  28816     }
  28817     size = font->width(font->userdata, font->height, name, name_len);
  28818     label.x = left.x + left.w + style->padding.x;
  28819     label.w = (float)size + 2 * style->padding.x;
  28820     label.y = property.y + style->border + style->padding.y;
  28821     label.h = property.h - (2 * style->border + 2 * style->padding.y);
  28822 
  28823     /* right increment button */
  28824     right.y = left.y;
  28825     right.w = left.w;
  28826     right.h = left.h;
  28827     right.x = property.x + property.w - (right.w + style->padding.x);
  28828 
  28829     /* edit */
  28830     if (*state == NK_PROPERTY_EDIT) {
  28831         size = font->width(font->userdata, font->height, buffer, *len);
  28832         size += style->edit.cursor_size;
  28833         length = len;
  28834         dst = buffer;
  28835     } else {
  28836         switch (variant->kind) {
  28837         default: break;
  28838         case NK_PROPERTY_INT:
  28839             nk_itoa(string, variant->value.i);
  28840             num_len = nk_strlen(string);
  28841             break;
  28842         case NK_PROPERTY_FLOAT:
  28843             NK_DTOA(string, (double)variant->value.f);
  28844             num_len = nk_string_float_limit(string, NK_MAX_FLOAT_PRECISION);
  28845             break;
  28846         case NK_PROPERTY_DOUBLE:
  28847             NK_DTOA(string, variant->value.d);
  28848             num_len = nk_string_float_limit(string, NK_MAX_FLOAT_PRECISION);
  28849             break;
  28850         }
  28851         size = font->width(font->userdata, font->height, string, num_len);
  28852         dst = string;
  28853         length = &num_len;
  28854     }
  28855 
  28856     edit.w =  (float)size + 2 * style->padding.x;
  28857     edit.w = NK_MIN(edit.w, right.x - (label.x + label.w));
  28858     edit.x = right.x - (edit.w + style->padding.x);
  28859     edit.y = property.y + style->border;
  28860     edit.h = property.h - (2 * style->border);
  28861 
  28862     /* empty left space activator */
  28863     empty.w = edit.x - (label.x + label.w);
  28864     empty.x = label.x + label.w;
  28865     empty.y = property.y;
  28866     empty.h = property.h;
  28867 
  28868     /* update property */
  28869     old = (*state == NK_PROPERTY_EDIT);
  28870     nk_property_behavior(ws, in, property, label, edit, empty, state, variant, inc_per_pixel);
  28871 
  28872     /* draw property */
  28873     if (style->draw_begin) style->draw_begin(out, style->userdata);
  28874     nk_draw_property(out, style, &property, &label, *ws, name, name_len, font);
  28875     if (style->draw_end) style->draw_end(out, style->userdata);
  28876 
  28877     /* execute right button  */
  28878     if (nk_do_button_symbol(ws, out, left, style->sym_left, behavior, &style->dec_button, in, font)) {
  28879         switch (variant->kind) {
  28880         default: break;
  28881         case NK_PROPERTY_INT:
  28882             variant->value.i = NK_CLAMP(variant->min_value.i, variant->value.i - variant->step.i, variant->max_value.i); break;
  28883         case NK_PROPERTY_FLOAT:
  28884             variant->value.f = NK_CLAMP(variant->min_value.f, variant->value.f - variant->step.f, variant->max_value.f); break;
  28885         case NK_PROPERTY_DOUBLE:
  28886             variant->value.d = NK_CLAMP(variant->min_value.d, variant->value.d - variant->step.d, variant->max_value.d); break;
  28887         }
  28888     }
  28889     /* execute left button  */
  28890     if (nk_do_button_symbol(ws, out, right, style->sym_right, behavior, &style->inc_button, in, font)) {
  28891         switch (variant->kind) {
  28892         default: break;
  28893         case NK_PROPERTY_INT:
  28894             variant->value.i = NK_CLAMP(variant->min_value.i, variant->value.i + variant->step.i, variant->max_value.i); break;
  28895         case NK_PROPERTY_FLOAT:
  28896             variant->value.f = NK_CLAMP(variant->min_value.f, variant->value.f + variant->step.f, variant->max_value.f); break;
  28897         case NK_PROPERTY_DOUBLE:
  28898             variant->value.d = NK_CLAMP(variant->min_value.d, variant->value.d + variant->step.d, variant->max_value.d); break;
  28899         }
  28900     }
  28901     if (old != NK_PROPERTY_EDIT && (*state == NK_PROPERTY_EDIT)) {
  28902         /* property has been activated so setup buffer */
  28903         NK_MEMCPY(buffer, dst, (nk_size)*length);
  28904         *cursor = nk_utf_len(buffer, *length);
  28905         *len = *length;
  28906         length = len;
  28907         dst = buffer;
  28908         active = 0;
  28909     } else active = (*state == NK_PROPERTY_EDIT);
  28910 
  28911     /* execute and run text edit field */
  28912     nk_textedit_clear_state(text_edit, NK_TEXT_EDIT_SINGLE_LINE, filters[filter]);
  28913     text_edit->active = (unsigned char)active;
  28914     text_edit->string.len = *length;
  28915     text_edit->cursor = NK_CLAMP(0, *cursor, *length);
  28916     text_edit->select_start = NK_CLAMP(0,*select_begin, *length);
  28917     text_edit->select_end = NK_CLAMP(0,*select_end, *length);
  28918     text_edit->string.buffer.allocated = (nk_size)*length;
  28919     text_edit->string.buffer.memory.size = NK_MAX_NUMBER_BUFFER;
  28920     text_edit->string.buffer.memory.ptr = dst;
  28921     text_edit->string.buffer.size = NK_MAX_NUMBER_BUFFER;
  28922     text_edit->mode = NK_TEXT_EDIT_MODE_INSERT;
  28923     nk_do_edit(ws, out, edit, (int)NK_EDIT_FIELD|(int)NK_EDIT_AUTO_SELECT,
  28924         filters[filter], text_edit, &style->edit, (*state == NK_PROPERTY_EDIT) ? in: 0, font);
  28925 
  28926     *length = text_edit->string.len;
  28927     *cursor = text_edit->cursor;
  28928     *select_begin = text_edit->select_start;
  28929     *select_end = text_edit->select_end;
  28930     if (text_edit->active && nk_input_is_key_pressed(in, NK_KEY_ENTER))
  28931         text_edit->active = nk_false;
  28932 
  28933     if (active && !text_edit->active) {
  28934         /* property is now not active so convert edit text to value*/
  28935         *state = NK_PROPERTY_DEFAULT;
  28936         buffer[*len] = '\0';
  28937         switch (variant->kind) {
  28938         default: break;
  28939         case NK_PROPERTY_INT:
  28940             variant->value.i = nk_strtoi(buffer, 0);
  28941             variant->value.i = NK_CLAMP(variant->min_value.i, variant->value.i, variant->max_value.i);
  28942             break;
  28943         case NK_PROPERTY_FLOAT:
  28944             nk_string_float_limit(buffer, NK_MAX_FLOAT_PRECISION);
  28945             variant->value.f = nk_strtof(buffer, 0);
  28946             variant->value.f = NK_CLAMP(variant->min_value.f, variant->value.f, variant->max_value.f);
  28947             break;
  28948         case NK_PROPERTY_DOUBLE:
  28949             nk_string_float_limit(buffer, NK_MAX_FLOAT_PRECISION);
  28950             variant->value.d = nk_strtod(buffer, 0);
  28951             variant->value.d = NK_CLAMP(variant->min_value.d, variant->value.d, variant->max_value.d);
  28952             break;
  28953         }
  28954     }
  28955 }
  28956 NK_LIB struct nk_property_variant
  28957 nk_property_variant_int(int value, int min_value, int max_value, int step)
  28958 {
  28959     struct nk_property_variant result;
  28960     result.kind = NK_PROPERTY_INT;
  28961     result.value.i = value;
  28962     result.min_value.i = min_value;
  28963     result.max_value.i = max_value;
  28964     result.step.i = step;
  28965     return result;
  28966 }
  28967 NK_LIB struct nk_property_variant
  28968 nk_property_variant_float(float value, float min_value, float max_value, float step)
  28969 {
  28970     struct nk_property_variant result;
  28971     result.kind = NK_PROPERTY_FLOAT;
  28972     result.value.f = value;
  28973     result.min_value.f = min_value;
  28974     result.max_value.f = max_value;
  28975     result.step.f = step;
  28976     return result;
  28977 }
  28978 NK_LIB struct nk_property_variant
  28979 nk_property_variant_double(double value, double min_value, double max_value,
  28980     double step)
  28981 {
  28982     struct nk_property_variant result;
  28983     result.kind = NK_PROPERTY_DOUBLE;
  28984     result.value.d = value;
  28985     result.min_value.d = min_value;
  28986     result.max_value.d = max_value;
  28987     result.step.d = step;
  28988     return result;
  28989 }
  28990 NK_LIB void
  28991 nk_property(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *name, struct nk_property_variant *variant,
  28992     float inc_per_pixel, const enum nk_property_filter filter)
  28993 {
  28994     struct nk_window *win;
  28995     struct nk_panel *layout;
  28996     struct nk_input *in;
  28997     const struct nk_style *style;
  28998 
  28999     struct nk_rect bounds;
  29000     enum nk_widget_layout_states s;
  29001 
  29002     int *state = 0;
  29003     nk_hash hash = 0;
  29004     char *buffer = 0;
  29005     int *len = 0;
  29006     int *cursor = 0;
  29007     int *select_begin = 0;
  29008     int *select_end = 0;
  29009     int old_state;
  29010 
  29011     char dummy_buffer[NK_MAX_NUMBER_BUFFER];
  29012     int dummy_state = NK_PROPERTY_DEFAULT;
  29013     int dummy_length = 0;
  29014     int dummy_cursor = 0;
  29015     int dummy_select_begin = 0;
  29016     int dummy_select_end = 0;
  29017 
  29018     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  29019     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  29020     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  29021     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout)
  29022         return;
  29023 
  29024     win = ctx->current;
  29025     layout = win->layout;
  29026     style = &ctx->style;
  29027     s = nk_widget(&bounds, ctx);
  29028     if (!s) return;
  29029 
  29030     /* calculate hash from name */
  29031     if (name[0] == '#') {
  29032         hash = nk_murmur_hash(name, (int)nk_strlen(name), win->property.seq++);
  29033         name++; /* special number hash */
  29034     } else hash = nk_murmur_hash(name, (int)nk_strlen(name), 42);
  29035 
  29036     /* check if property is currently hot item */
  29037     if (win->property.active && hash == win->property.name) {
  29038         buffer = win->property.buffer;
  29039         len = &win->property.length;
  29040         cursor = &win->property.cursor;
  29041         state = &win->property.state;
  29042         select_begin = &win->property.select_start;
  29043         select_end = &win->property.select_end;
  29044     } else {
  29045         buffer = dummy_buffer;
  29046         len = &dummy_length;
  29047         cursor = &dummy_cursor;
  29048         state = &dummy_state;
  29049         select_begin =  &dummy_select_begin;
  29050         select_end = &dummy_select_end;
  29051     }
  29052 
  29053     /* execute property widget */
  29054     old_state = *state;
  29055     ctx->text_edit.clip = ctx->clip;
  29056     in = ((s == NK_WIDGET_ROM && !win->property.active) ||
  29057         layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_ROM || s == NK_WIDGET_DISABLED) ? 0 : &ctx->input;
  29058     nk_do_property(&ctx->last_widget_state, &win->buffer, bounds, name,
  29059         variant, inc_per_pixel, buffer, len, state, cursor, select_begin,
  29060         select_end, &style->property, filter, in, style->font, &ctx->text_edit,
  29061         ctx->button_behavior);
  29062 
  29063     if (in && *state != NK_PROPERTY_DEFAULT && !win->property.active) {
  29064         /* current property is now hot */
  29065         win->property.active = 1;
  29066         NK_MEMCPY(win->property.buffer, buffer, (nk_size)*len);
  29067         win->property.length = *len;
  29068         win->property.cursor = *cursor;
  29069         win->property.state = *state;
  29070         win->property.name = hash;
  29071         win->property.select_start = *select_begin;
  29072         win->property.select_end = *select_end;
  29073         if (*state == NK_PROPERTY_DRAG) {
  29074             ctx->input.mouse.grab = nk_true;
  29075             ctx->input.mouse.grabbed = nk_true;
  29076         }
  29077     }
  29078     /* check if previously active property is now inactive */
  29079     if (*state == NK_PROPERTY_DEFAULT && old_state != NK_PROPERTY_DEFAULT) {
  29080         if (old_state == NK_PROPERTY_DRAG) {
  29081             ctx->input.mouse.grab = nk_false;
  29082             ctx->input.mouse.grabbed = nk_false;
  29083             ctx->input.mouse.ungrab = nk_true;
  29084         }
  29085         win->property.select_start = 0;
  29086         win->property.select_end = 0;
  29087         win->property.active = 0;
  29088     }
  29089 }
  29090 NK_API void
  29091 nk_property_int(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *name,
  29092     int min, int *val, int max, int step, float inc_per_pixel)
  29093 {
  29094     struct nk_property_variant variant;
  29095     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  29096     NK_ASSERT(name);
  29097     NK_ASSERT(val);
  29098 
  29099     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !name || !val) return;
  29100     variant = nk_property_variant_int(*val, min, max, step);
  29101     nk_property(ctx, name, &variant, inc_per_pixel, NK_FILTER_INT);
  29102     *val = variant.value.i;
  29103 }
  29104 NK_API void
  29105 nk_property_float(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *name,
  29106     float min, float *val, float max, float step, float inc_per_pixel)
  29107 {
  29108     struct nk_property_variant variant;
  29109     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  29110     NK_ASSERT(name);
  29111     NK_ASSERT(val);
  29112 
  29113     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !name || !val) return;
  29114     variant = nk_property_variant_float(*val, min, max, step);
  29115     nk_property(ctx, name, &variant, inc_per_pixel, NK_FILTER_FLOAT);
  29116     *val = variant.value.f;
  29117 }
  29118 NK_API void
  29119 nk_property_double(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *name,
  29120     double min, double *val, double max, double step, float inc_per_pixel)
  29121 {
  29122     struct nk_property_variant variant;
  29123     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  29124     NK_ASSERT(name);
  29125     NK_ASSERT(val);
  29126 
  29127     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !name || !val) return;
  29128     variant = nk_property_variant_double(*val, min, max, step);
  29129     nk_property(ctx, name, &variant, inc_per_pixel, NK_FILTER_FLOAT);
  29130     *val = variant.value.d;
  29131 }
  29132 NK_API int
  29133 nk_propertyi(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *name, int min, int val,
  29134     int max, int step, float inc_per_pixel)
  29135 {
  29136     struct nk_property_variant variant;
  29137     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  29138     NK_ASSERT(name);
  29139 
  29140     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !name) return val;
  29141     variant = nk_property_variant_int(val, min, max, step);
  29142     nk_property(ctx, name, &variant, inc_per_pixel, NK_FILTER_INT);
  29143     val = variant.value.i;
  29144     return val;
  29145 }
  29146 NK_API float
  29147 nk_propertyf(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *name, float min,
  29148     float val, float max, float step, float inc_per_pixel)
  29149 {
  29150     struct nk_property_variant variant;
  29151     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  29152     NK_ASSERT(name);
  29153 
  29154     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !name) return val;
  29155     variant = nk_property_variant_float(val, min, max, step);
  29156     nk_property(ctx, name, &variant, inc_per_pixel, NK_FILTER_FLOAT);
  29157     val = variant.value.f;
  29158     return val;
  29159 }
  29160 NK_API double
  29161 nk_propertyd(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *name, double min,
  29162     double val, double max, double step, float inc_per_pixel)
  29163 {
  29164     struct nk_property_variant variant;
  29165     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  29166     NK_ASSERT(name);
  29167 
  29168     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !name) return val;
  29169     variant = nk_property_variant_double(val, min, max, step);
  29170     nk_property(ctx, name, &variant, inc_per_pixel, NK_FILTER_FLOAT);
  29171     val = variant.value.d;
  29172     return val;
  29173 }

  29179 /* ==============================================================
  29180  *
  29181  *                          CHART
  29182  *
  29183  * ===============================================================*/
  29184 NK_API nk_bool
  29185 nk_chart_begin_colored(struct nk_context *ctx, enum nk_chart_type type,
  29186     struct nk_color color, struct nk_color highlight,
  29187     int count, float min_value, float max_value)
  29188 {
  29189     struct nk_window *win;
  29190     struct nk_chart *chart;
  29191     const struct nk_style *config;
  29192     const struct nk_style_chart *style;
  29193 
  29194     const struct nk_style_item *background;
  29195     struct nk_rect bounds = {0, 0, 0, 0};
  29196 
  29197     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  29198     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  29199     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  29200 
  29201     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout) return 0;
  29202     if (!nk_widget(&bounds, ctx)) {
  29203         chart = &ctx->current->layout->chart;
  29204         nk_zero(chart, sizeof(*chart));
  29205         return 0;
  29206     }
  29207 
  29208     win = ctx->current;
  29209     config = &ctx->style;
  29210     chart = &win->layout->chart;
  29211     style = &config->chart;
  29212 
  29213     /* setup basic generic chart  */
  29214     nk_zero(chart, sizeof(*chart));
  29215     chart->x = bounds.x + style->padding.x;
  29216     chart->y = bounds.y + style->padding.y;
  29217     chart->w = bounds.w - 2 * style->padding.x;
  29218     chart->h = bounds.h - 2 * style->padding.y;
  29219     chart->w = NK_MAX(chart->w, 2 * style->padding.x);
  29220     chart->h = NK_MAX(chart->h, 2 * style->padding.y);
  29221 
  29222     /* add first slot into chart */
  29223     {struct nk_chart_slot *slot = &chart->slots[chart->slot++];
  29224     slot->type = type;
  29225     slot->count = count;
  29226     slot->color = nk_rgb_factor(color, style->color_factor);
  29227     slot->highlight = highlight;
  29228     slot->min = NK_MIN(min_value, max_value);
  29229     slot->max = NK_MAX(min_value, max_value);
  29230     slot->range = slot->max - slot->min;
  29231     slot->show_markers = style->show_markers;}
  29232 
  29233     /* draw chart background */
  29234     background = &style->background;
  29235 
  29236     switch(background->type) {
  29237         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE:
  29238             nk_draw_image(&win->buffer, bounds, &background->data.image, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  29239             break;
  29240         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_NINE_SLICE:
  29241             nk_draw_nine_slice(&win->buffer, bounds, &background->data.slice, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->color_factor));
  29242             break;
  29243         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR:
  29244             nk_fill_rect(&win->buffer, bounds, style->rounding, nk_rgb_factor(style->border_color, style->color_factor));
  29245             nk_fill_rect(&win->buffer, nk_shrink_rect(bounds, style->border),
  29246                 style->rounding, nk_rgb_factor(style->background.data.color, style->color_factor));
  29247             break;
  29248     }
  29249     return 1;
  29250 }
  29251 NK_API nk_bool
  29252 nk_chart_begin(struct nk_context *ctx, const enum nk_chart_type type,
  29253     int count, float min_value, float max_value)
  29254 {
  29255     return nk_chart_begin_colored(ctx, type, ctx->style.chart.color,
  29256                 ctx->style.chart.selected_color, count, min_value, max_value);
  29257 }
  29258 NK_API void
  29259 nk_chart_add_slot_colored(struct nk_context *ctx, const enum nk_chart_type type,
  29260     struct nk_color color, struct nk_color highlight,
  29261     int count, float min_value, float max_value)
  29262 {
  29263     const struct nk_style_chart* style;
  29264 
  29265     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  29266     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  29267     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  29268     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout->chart.slot < NK_CHART_MAX_SLOT);
  29269     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout) return;
  29270     if (ctx->current->layout->chart.slot >= NK_CHART_MAX_SLOT) return;
  29271 
  29272     style = &ctx->style.chart;
  29273 
  29274     /* add another slot into the graph */
  29275     {struct nk_chart *chart = &ctx->current->layout->chart;
  29276     struct nk_chart_slot *slot = &chart->slots[chart->slot++];
  29277     slot->type = type;
  29278     slot->count = count;
  29279     slot->color = nk_rgb_factor(color, style->color_factor);
  29280     slot->highlight = highlight;
  29281     slot->min = NK_MIN(min_value, max_value);
  29282     slot->max = NK_MAX(min_value, max_value);
  29283     slot->range = slot->max - slot->min;
  29284     slot->show_markers = style->show_markers;}
  29285 }
  29286 NK_API void
  29287 nk_chart_add_slot(struct nk_context *ctx, const enum nk_chart_type type,
  29288     int count, float min_value, float max_value)
  29289 {
  29290     nk_chart_add_slot_colored(ctx, type, ctx->style.chart.color,
  29291         ctx->style.chart.selected_color, count, min_value, max_value);
  29292 }
  29293 NK_INTERN nk_flags
  29294 nk_chart_push_line(struct nk_context *ctx, struct nk_window *win,
  29295     struct nk_chart *g, float value, int slot)
  29296 {
  29297     struct nk_panel *layout = win->layout;
  29298     const struct nk_input *i = ctx->current->widgets_disabled ? 0 : &ctx->input;
  29299     struct nk_command_buffer *out = &win->buffer;
  29300 
  29301     nk_flags ret = 0;
  29302     struct nk_vec2 cur;
  29303     struct nk_rect bounds;
  29304     struct nk_color color;
  29305     float step;
  29306     float range;
  29307     float ratio;
  29308 
  29309     NK_ASSERT(slot >= 0 && slot < NK_CHART_MAX_SLOT);
  29310     step = g->w / (float)g->slots[slot].count;
  29311     range = g->slots[slot].max - g->slots[slot].min;
  29312     ratio = (value - g->slots[slot].min) / range;
  29313 
  29314     if (g->slots[slot].index == 0) {
  29315         /* first data point does not have a connection */
  29316         g->slots[slot].last.x = g->x;
  29317         g->slots[slot].last.y = (g->y + g->h) - ratio * (float)g->h;
  29318 
  29319         bounds.x = g->slots[slot].last.x - 2;
  29320         bounds.y = g->slots[slot].last.y - 2;
  29321         bounds.w = bounds.h = 4;
  29322 
  29323         color = g->slots[slot].color;
  29324         if (!(layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_ROM) && i &&
  29325             NK_INBOX(i->mouse.pos.x,i->mouse.pos.y, g->slots[slot].last.x-3, g->slots[slot].last.y-3, 6, 6)){
  29326             ret = nk_input_is_mouse_hovering_rect(i, bounds) ? NK_CHART_HOVERING : 0;
  29327             ret |= (i->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].down &&
  29328                 i->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].clicked) ? NK_CHART_CLICKED: 0;
  29329             color = g->slots[slot].highlight;
  29330         }
  29331         if (g->slots[slot].show_markers) {
  29332             nk_fill_rect(out, bounds, 0, color);
  29333         }
  29334         g->slots[slot].index += 1;
  29335         return ret;
  29336     }
  29337 
  29338     /* draw a line between the last data point and the new one */
  29339     color = g->slots[slot].color;
  29340     cur.x = g->x + (float)(step * (float)g->slots[slot].index);
  29341     cur.y = (g->y + g->h) - (ratio * (float)g->h);
  29342     nk_stroke_line(out, g->slots[slot].last.x, g->slots[slot].last.y, cur.x, cur.y, 1.0f, color);
  29343 
  29344     bounds.x = cur.x - 3;
  29345     bounds.y = cur.y - 3;
  29346     bounds.w = bounds.h = 6;
  29347 
  29348     /* user selection of current data point */
  29349     if (!(layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_ROM)) {
  29350         if (nk_input_is_mouse_hovering_rect(i, bounds)) {
  29351             ret = NK_CHART_HOVERING;
  29352             ret |= (!i->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].down &&
  29353                 i->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].clicked) ? NK_CHART_CLICKED: 0;
  29354             color = g->slots[slot].highlight;
  29355         }
  29356     }
  29357     if (g->slots[slot].show_markers) {
  29358         nk_fill_rect(out, nk_rect(cur.x - 2, cur.y - 2, 4, 4), 0, color);
  29359     }
  29360 
  29361     /* save current data point position */
  29362     g->slots[slot].last.x = cur.x;
  29363     g->slots[slot].last.y = cur.y;
  29364     g->slots[slot].index  += 1;
  29365     return ret;
  29366 }
  29367 NK_INTERN nk_flags
  29368 nk_chart_push_column(const struct nk_context *ctx, struct nk_window *win,
  29369     struct nk_chart *chart, float value, int slot)
  29370 {
  29371     struct nk_command_buffer *out = &win->buffer;
  29372     const struct nk_input *in = ctx->current->widgets_disabled ? 0 : &ctx->input;
  29373     struct nk_panel *layout = win->layout;
  29374 
  29375     float ratio;
  29376     nk_flags ret = 0;
  29377     struct nk_color color;
  29378     struct nk_rect item = {0,0,0,0};
  29379 
  29380     NK_ASSERT(slot >= 0 && slot < NK_CHART_MAX_SLOT);
  29381     if (chart->slots[slot].index  >= chart->slots[slot].count)
  29382         return nk_false;
  29383     if (chart->slots[slot].count) {
  29384         float padding = (float)(chart->slots[slot].count-1);
  29385         item.w = (chart->w - padding) / (float)(chart->slots[slot].count);
  29386     }
  29387 
  29388     /* calculate bounds of current bar chart entry */
  29389     color = chart->slots[slot].color;;
  29390     item.h = chart->h * NK_ABS((value/chart->slots[slot].range));
  29391     if (value >= 0) {
  29392         ratio = (value + NK_ABS(chart->slots[slot].min)) / NK_ABS(chart->slots[slot].range);
  29393         item.y = (chart->y + chart->h) - chart->h * ratio;
  29394     } else {
  29395         ratio = (value - chart->slots[slot].max) / chart->slots[slot].range;
  29396         item.y = chart->y + (chart->h * NK_ABS(ratio)) - item.h;
  29397     }
  29398     item.x = chart->x + ((float)chart->slots[slot].index * item.w);
  29399     item.x = item.x + ((float)chart->slots[slot].index);
  29400 
  29401     /* user chart bar selection */
  29402     if (!(layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_ROM) && in &&
  29403         NK_INBOX(in->mouse.pos.x,in->mouse.pos.y,item.x,item.y,item.w,item.h)) {
  29404         ret = NK_CHART_HOVERING;
  29405         ret |= (!in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].down &&
  29406                 in->mouse.buttons[NK_BUTTON_LEFT].clicked) ? NK_CHART_CLICKED: 0;
  29407         color = chart->slots[slot].highlight;
  29408     }
  29409     nk_fill_rect(out, item, 0, color);
  29410     chart->slots[slot].index += 1;
  29411     return ret;
  29412 }
  29413 NK_API nk_flags
  29414 nk_chart_push_slot(struct nk_context *ctx, float value, int slot)
  29415 {
  29416     nk_flags flags;
  29417     struct nk_window *win;
  29418 
  29419     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  29420     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  29421     NK_ASSERT(slot >= 0 && slot < NK_CHART_MAX_SLOT);
  29422     NK_ASSERT(slot < ctx->current->layout->chart.slot);
  29423     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || slot >= NK_CHART_MAX_SLOT) return nk_false;
  29424     if (slot >= ctx->current->layout->chart.slot) return nk_false;
  29425 
  29426     win = ctx->current;
  29427     if (win->layout->chart.slot < slot) return nk_false;
  29428     switch (win->layout->chart.slots[slot].type) {
  29429     case NK_CHART_LINES:
  29430         flags = nk_chart_push_line(ctx, win, &win->layout->chart, value, slot); break;
  29431     case NK_CHART_COLUMN:
  29432         flags = nk_chart_push_column(ctx, win, &win->layout->chart, value, slot); break;
  29433     default:
  29434     case NK_CHART_MAX:
  29435         flags = 0;
  29436     }
  29437     return flags;
  29438 }
  29439 NK_API nk_flags
  29440 nk_chart_push(struct nk_context *ctx, float value)
  29441 {
  29442     return nk_chart_push_slot(ctx, value, 0);
  29443 }
  29444 NK_API void
  29445 nk_chart_end(struct nk_context *ctx)
  29446 {
  29447     struct nk_window *win;
  29448     struct nk_chart *chart;
  29449 
  29450     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  29451     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  29452     if (!ctx || !ctx->current)
  29453         return;
  29454 
  29455     win = ctx->current;
  29456     chart = &win->layout->chart;
  29457     NK_MEMSET(chart, 0, sizeof(*chart));
  29458     return;
  29459 }
  29460 NK_API void
  29461 nk_plot(struct nk_context *ctx, enum nk_chart_type type, const float *values,
  29462     int count, int offset)
  29463 {
  29464     int i = 0;
  29465     float min_value;
  29466     float max_value;
  29467 
  29468     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  29469     NK_ASSERT(values);
  29470     if (!ctx || !values || !count) return;
  29471 
  29472     min_value = values[offset];
  29473     max_value = values[offset];
  29474     for (i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
  29475         min_value = NK_MIN(values[i + offset], min_value);
  29476         max_value = NK_MAX(values[i + offset], max_value);
  29477     }
  29478 
  29479     if (nk_chart_begin(ctx, type, count, min_value, max_value)) {
  29480         for (i = 0; i < count; ++i)
  29481             nk_chart_push(ctx, values[i + offset]);
  29482         nk_chart_end(ctx);
  29483     }
  29484 }
  29485 NK_API void
  29486 nk_plot_function(struct nk_context *ctx, enum nk_chart_type type, void *userdata,
  29487     float(*value_getter)(void* user, int index), int count, int offset)
  29488 {
  29489     int i = 0;
  29490     float min_value;
  29491     float max_value;
  29492 
  29493     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  29494     NK_ASSERT(value_getter);
  29495     if (!ctx || !value_getter || !count) return;
  29496 
  29497     max_value = min_value = value_getter(userdata, offset);
  29498     for (i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
  29499         float value = value_getter(userdata, i + offset);
  29500         min_value = NK_MIN(value, min_value);
  29501         max_value = NK_MAX(value, max_value);
  29502     }
  29503 
  29504     if (nk_chart_begin(ctx, type, count, min_value, max_value)) {
  29505         for (i = 0; i < count; ++i)
  29506             nk_chart_push(ctx, value_getter(userdata, i + offset));
  29507         nk_chart_end(ctx);
  29508     }
  29509 }
