  29515 /* ==============================================================
  29516  *
  29517  *                          COLOR PICKER
  29518  *
  29519  * ===============================================================*/
  29520 NK_LIB nk_bool
  29521 nk_color_picker_behavior(nk_flags *state,
  29522     const struct nk_rect *bounds, const struct nk_rect *matrix,
  29523     const struct nk_rect *hue_bar, const struct nk_rect *alpha_bar,
  29524     struct nk_colorf *color, const struct nk_input *in)
  29525 {
  29526     float hsva[4];
  29527     nk_bool value_changed = 0;
  29528     nk_bool hsv_changed = 0;
  29529 
  29530     NK_ASSERT(state);
  29531     NK_ASSERT(matrix);
  29532     NK_ASSERT(hue_bar);
  29533     NK_ASSERT(color);
  29534 
  29535     /* color matrix */
  29536     nk_colorf_hsva_fv(hsva, *color);
  29537     if (nk_button_behavior(state, *matrix, in, NK_BUTTON_REPEATER)) {
  29538         hsva[1] = NK_SATURATE((in->mouse.pos.x - matrix->x) / (matrix->w-1));
  29539         hsva[2] = 1.0f - NK_SATURATE((in->mouse.pos.y - matrix->y) / (matrix->h-1));
  29540         value_changed = hsv_changed = 1;
  29541     }
  29542     /* hue bar */
  29543     if (nk_button_behavior(state, *hue_bar, in, NK_BUTTON_REPEATER)) {
  29544         hsva[0] = NK_SATURATE((in->mouse.pos.y - hue_bar->y) / (hue_bar->h-1));
  29545         value_changed = hsv_changed = 1;
  29546     }
  29547     /* alpha bar */
  29548     if (alpha_bar) {
  29549         if (nk_button_behavior(state, *alpha_bar, in, NK_BUTTON_REPEATER)) {
  29550             hsva[3] = 1.0f - NK_SATURATE((in->mouse.pos.y - alpha_bar->y) / (alpha_bar->h-1));
  29551             value_changed = 1;
  29552         }
  29553     }
  29554     nk_widget_state_reset(state);
  29555     if (hsv_changed) {
  29556         *color = nk_hsva_colorfv(hsva);
  29557         *state = NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVE;
  29558     }
  29559     if (value_changed) {
  29560         color->a = hsva[3];
  29561         *state = NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVE;
  29562     }
  29563     /* set color picker widget state */
  29564     if (nk_input_is_mouse_hovering_rect(in, *bounds))
  29565         *state = NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVERED;
  29566     if (*state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER && !nk_input_is_mouse_prev_hovering_rect(in, *bounds))
  29567         *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_ENTERED;
  29568     else if (nk_input_is_mouse_prev_hovering_rect(in, *bounds))
  29569         *state |= NK_WIDGET_STATE_LEFT;
  29570     return value_changed;
  29571 }
  29572 NK_LIB void
  29573 nk_draw_color_picker(struct nk_command_buffer *o, const struct nk_rect *matrix,
  29574     const struct nk_rect *hue_bar, const struct nk_rect *alpha_bar,
  29575     struct nk_colorf col)
  29576 {
  29577     NK_STORAGE const struct nk_color black = {0,0,0,255};
  29578     NK_STORAGE const struct nk_color white = {255, 255, 255, 255};
  29579     NK_STORAGE const struct nk_color black_trans = {0,0,0,0};
  29580 
  29581     const float crosshair_size = 7.0f;
  29582     struct nk_color temp;
  29583     float hsva[4];
  29584     float line_y;
  29585     int i;
  29586 
  29587     NK_ASSERT(o);
  29588     NK_ASSERT(matrix);
  29589     NK_ASSERT(hue_bar);
  29590 
  29591     /* draw hue bar */
  29592     nk_colorf_hsva_fv(hsva, col);
  29593     for (i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
  29594         NK_GLOBAL const struct nk_color hue_colors[] = {
  29595             {255, 0, 0, 255}, {255,255,0,255}, {0,255,0,255}, {0, 255,255,255},
  29596             {0,0,255,255}, {255, 0, 255, 255}, {255, 0, 0, 255}
  29597         };
  29598         nk_fill_rect_multi_color(o,
  29599             nk_rect(hue_bar->x, hue_bar->y + (float)i * (hue_bar->h/6.0f) + 0.5f,
  29600                 hue_bar->w, (hue_bar->h/6.0f) + 0.5f), hue_colors[i], hue_colors[i],
  29601                 hue_colors[i+1], hue_colors[i+1]);
  29602     }
  29603     line_y = (float)(int)(hue_bar->y + hsva[0] * matrix->h + 0.5f);
  29604     nk_stroke_line(o, hue_bar->x-1, line_y, hue_bar->x + hue_bar->w + 2,
  29605         line_y, 1, nk_rgb(255,255,255));
  29606 
  29607     /* draw alpha bar */
  29608     if (alpha_bar) {
  29609         float alpha = NK_SATURATE(col.a);
  29610         line_y = (float)(int)(alpha_bar->y +  (1.0f - alpha) * matrix->h + 0.5f);
  29611 
  29612         nk_fill_rect_multi_color(o, *alpha_bar, white, white, black, black);
  29613         nk_stroke_line(o, alpha_bar->x-1, line_y, alpha_bar->x + alpha_bar->w + 2,
  29614             line_y, 1, nk_rgb(255,255,255));
  29615     }
  29616 
  29617     /* draw color matrix */
  29618     temp = nk_hsv_f(hsva[0], 1.0f, 1.0f);
  29619     nk_fill_rect_multi_color(o, *matrix, white, temp, temp, white);
  29620     nk_fill_rect_multi_color(o, *matrix, black_trans, black_trans, black, black);
  29621 
  29622     /* draw cross-hair */
  29623     {struct nk_vec2 p; float S = hsva[1]; float V = hsva[2];
  29624     p.x = (float)(int)(matrix->x + S * matrix->w);
  29625     p.y = (float)(int)(matrix->y + (1.0f - V) * matrix->h);
  29626     nk_stroke_line(o, p.x - crosshair_size, p.y, p.x-2, p.y, 1.0f, white);
  29627     nk_stroke_line(o, p.x + crosshair_size + 1, p.y, p.x+3, p.y, 1.0f, white);
  29628     nk_stroke_line(o, p.x, p.y + crosshair_size + 1, p.x, p.y+3, 1.0f, white);
  29629     nk_stroke_line(o, p.x, p.y - crosshair_size, p.x, p.y-2, 1.0f, white);}
  29630 }
  29631 NK_LIB nk_bool
  29632 nk_do_color_picker(nk_flags *state,
  29633     struct nk_command_buffer *out, struct nk_colorf *col,
  29634     enum nk_color_format fmt, struct nk_rect bounds,
  29635     struct nk_vec2 padding, const struct nk_input *in,
  29636     const struct nk_user_font *font)
  29637 {
  29638     int ret = 0;
  29639     struct nk_rect matrix;
  29640     struct nk_rect hue_bar;
  29641     struct nk_rect alpha_bar;
  29642     float bar_w;
  29643 
  29644     NK_ASSERT(out);
  29645     NK_ASSERT(col);
  29646     NK_ASSERT(state);
  29647     NK_ASSERT(font);
  29648     if (!out || !col || !state || !font)
  29649         return ret;
  29650 
  29651     bar_w = font->height;
  29652     bounds.x += padding.x;
  29653     bounds.y += padding.x;
  29654     bounds.w -= 2 * padding.x;
  29655     bounds.h -= 2 * padding.y;
  29656 
  29657     matrix.x = bounds.x;
  29658     matrix.y = bounds.y;
  29659     matrix.h = bounds.h;
  29660     matrix.w = bounds.w - (3 * padding.x + 2 * bar_w);
  29661 
  29662     hue_bar.w = bar_w;
  29663     hue_bar.y = bounds.y;
  29664     hue_bar.h = matrix.h;
  29665     hue_bar.x = matrix.x + matrix.w + padding.x;
  29666 
  29667     alpha_bar.x = hue_bar.x + hue_bar.w + padding.x;
  29668     alpha_bar.y = bounds.y;
  29669     alpha_bar.w = bar_w;
  29670     alpha_bar.h = matrix.h;
  29671 
  29672     ret = nk_color_picker_behavior(state, &bounds, &matrix, &hue_bar,
  29673         (fmt == NK_RGBA) ? &alpha_bar:0, col, in);
  29674     nk_draw_color_picker(out, &matrix, &hue_bar, (fmt == NK_RGBA) ? &alpha_bar:0, *col);
  29675     return ret;
  29676 }
  29677 NK_API nk_bool
  29678 nk_color_pick(struct nk_context * ctx, struct nk_colorf *color,
  29679     enum nk_color_format fmt)
  29680 {
  29681     struct nk_window *win;
  29682     struct nk_panel *layout;
  29683     const struct nk_style *config;
  29684     const struct nk_input *in;
  29685 
  29686     enum nk_widget_layout_states state;
  29687     struct nk_rect bounds;
  29688 
  29689     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  29690     NK_ASSERT(color);
  29691     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  29692     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  29693     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout || !color)
  29694         return 0;
  29695 
  29696     win = ctx->current;
  29697     config = &ctx->style;
  29698     layout = win->layout;
  29699     state = nk_widget(&bounds, ctx);
  29700     if (!state) return 0;
  29701     in = (state == NK_WIDGET_ROM || state == NK_WIDGET_DISABLED || layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_ROM) ? 0 : &ctx->input;
  29702     return nk_do_color_picker(&ctx->last_widget_state, &win->buffer, color, fmt, bounds,
  29703                 nk_vec2(0,0), in, config->font);
  29704 }
  29705 NK_API struct nk_colorf
  29706 nk_color_picker(struct nk_context *ctx, struct nk_colorf color,
  29707     enum nk_color_format fmt)
  29708 {
  29709     nk_color_pick(ctx, &color, fmt);
  29710     return color;
  29711 }

  29717 /* ==============================================================
  29718  *
  29719  *                          COMBO
  29720  *
  29721  * ===============================================================*/
  29722 NK_INTERN nk_bool
  29723 nk_combo_begin(struct nk_context *ctx, struct nk_window *win,
  29724     struct nk_vec2 size, nk_bool is_clicked, struct nk_rect header)
  29725 {
  29726     struct nk_window *popup;
  29727     int is_open = 0;
  29728     int is_active = 0;
  29729     struct nk_rect body;
  29730     nk_hash hash;
  29731 
  29732     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  29733     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  29734     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  29735     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout)
  29736         return 0;
  29737 
  29738     popup = win->popup.win;
  29739     body.x = header.x;
  29740     body.w = size.x;
  29741     body.y = header.y + header.h-ctx->style.window.combo_border;
  29742     body.h = size.y;
  29743 
  29744     hash = win->popup.combo_count++;
  29745     is_open = (popup) ? nk_true:nk_false;
  29746     is_active = (popup && (win->popup.name == hash) && win->popup.type == NK_PANEL_COMBO);
  29747     if ((is_clicked && is_open && !is_active) || (is_open && !is_active) ||
  29748         (!is_open && !is_active && !is_clicked)) return 0;
  29749     if (!nk_nonblock_begin(ctx, 0, body,
  29750         (is_clicked && is_open)?nk_rect(0,0,0,0):header, NK_PANEL_COMBO)) return 0;
  29751 
  29752     win->popup.type = NK_PANEL_COMBO;
  29753     win->popup.name = hash;
  29754     return 1;
  29755 }
  29756 NK_API nk_bool
  29757 nk_combo_begin_text(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *selected, int len,
  29758     struct nk_vec2 size)
  29759 {
  29760     const struct nk_input *in;
  29761     struct nk_window *win;
  29762     struct nk_style *style;
  29763 
  29764     enum nk_widget_layout_states s;
  29765     int is_clicked = nk_false;
  29766     struct nk_rect header;
  29767     const struct nk_style_item *background;
  29768     struct nk_text text;
  29769 
  29770     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  29771     NK_ASSERT(selected);
  29772     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  29773     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  29774     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout || !selected)
  29775         return 0;
  29776 
  29777     win = ctx->current;
  29778     style = &ctx->style;
  29779     s = nk_widget(&header, ctx);
  29780     if (s == NK_WIDGET_INVALID)
  29781         return 0;
  29782 
  29783     in = (win->layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_ROM || s == NK_WIDGET_DISABLED || s == NK_WIDGET_ROM)? 0: &ctx->input;
  29784     if (nk_button_behavior(&ctx->last_widget_state, header, in, NK_BUTTON_DEFAULT))
  29785         is_clicked = nk_true;
  29786 
  29787     /* draw combo box header background and border */
  29788     if (ctx->last_widget_state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED) {
  29789         background = &style->combo.active;
  29790         text.text = style->combo.label_active;
  29791     } else if (ctx->last_widget_state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER) {
  29792         background = &style->combo.hover;
  29793         text.text = style->combo.label_hover;
  29794     } else {
  29795         background = &style->combo.normal;
  29796         text.text = style->combo.label_normal;
  29797     }
  29798 
  29799     text.text = nk_rgb_factor(text.text, style->combo.color_factor);
  29800 
  29801     switch(background->type) {
  29802         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE:
  29803             text.background = nk_rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
  29804             nk_draw_image(&win->buffer, header, &background->data.image, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->combo.color_factor));
  29805             break;
  29806         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_NINE_SLICE:
  29807             text.background = nk_rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
  29808             nk_draw_nine_slice(&win->buffer, header, &background->data.slice, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->combo.color_factor));
  29809             break;
  29810         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR:
  29811             text.background = background->data.color;
  29812             nk_fill_rect(&win->buffer, header, style->combo.rounding, nk_rgb_factor(background->data.color, style->combo.color_factor));
  29813             nk_stroke_rect(&win->buffer, header, style->combo.rounding, style->combo.border, nk_rgb_factor(style->combo.border_color, style->combo.color_factor));
  29814             break;
  29815     }
  29816     {
  29817         /* print currently selected text item */
  29818         struct nk_rect label;
  29819         struct nk_rect button;
  29820         struct nk_rect content;
  29821         int draw_button_symbol;
  29822 
  29823         enum nk_symbol_type sym;
  29824         if (ctx->last_widget_state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER)
  29825             sym = style->combo.sym_hover;
  29826         else if (is_clicked)
  29827             sym = style->combo.sym_active;
  29828         else
  29829             sym = style->combo.sym_normal;
  29830 
  29831         /* represents whether or not the combo's button symbol should be drawn */
  29832         draw_button_symbol = sym != NK_SYMBOL_NONE;
  29833 
  29834         /* calculate button */
  29835         button.w = header.h - 2 * style->combo.button_padding.y;
  29836         button.x = (header.x + header.w - header.h) - style->combo.button_padding.x;
  29837         button.y = header.y + style->combo.button_padding.y;
  29838         button.h = button.w;
  29839 
  29840         content.x = button.x + style->combo.button.padding.x;
  29841         content.y = button.y + style->combo.button.padding.y;
  29842         content.w = button.w - 2 * style->combo.button.padding.x;
  29843         content.h = button.h - 2 * style->combo.button.padding.y;
  29844 
  29845         /* draw selected label */
  29846         text.padding = nk_vec2(0,0);
  29847         label.x = header.x + style->combo.content_padding.x;
  29848         label.y = header.y + style->combo.content_padding.y;
  29849         label.h = header.h - 2 * style->combo.content_padding.y;
  29850         if (draw_button_symbol)
  29851             label.w = button.x - (style->combo.content_padding.x + style->combo.spacing.x) - label.x;
  29852         else
  29853             label.w = header.w - 2 * style->combo.content_padding.x;
  29854         nk_widget_text(&win->buffer, label, selected, len, &text,
  29855             NK_TEXT_LEFT, ctx->style.font);
  29856 
  29857         /* draw open/close button */
  29858         if (draw_button_symbol)
  29859             nk_draw_button_symbol(&win->buffer, &button, &content, ctx->last_widget_state,
  29860                 &ctx->style.combo.button, sym, style->font);
  29861     }
  29862     return nk_combo_begin(ctx, win, size, is_clicked, header);
  29863 }
  29864 NK_API nk_bool
  29865 nk_combo_begin_label(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *selected, struct nk_vec2 size)
  29866 {

  29868 }

  30196     else background = &style->combo.normal;
  30197 
  30198     switch (background->type) {
  30199         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE:
  30200             nk_draw_image(&win->buffer, header, &background->data.image, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->combo.color_factor));
  30201             break;
  30202         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_NINE_SLICE:
  30203             nk_draw_nine_slice(&win->buffer, header, &background->data.slice, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->combo.color_factor));
  30204             break;
  30205         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR:
  30206             nk_fill_rect(&win->buffer, header, style->combo.rounding, nk_rgb_factor(background->data.color, style->combo.color_factor));
  30207             nk_stroke_rect(&win->buffer, header, style->combo.rounding, style->combo.border, nk_rgb_factor(style->combo.border_color, style->combo.color_factor));
  30208             break;
  30209     }
  30210     {
  30211         struct nk_rect bounds = {0,0,0,0};
  30212         struct nk_rect content;
  30213         struct nk_rect button;
  30214         int draw_button_symbol;
  30215 
  30216         enum nk_symbol_type sym;
  30217         if (ctx->last_widget_state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER)
  30218             sym = style->combo.sym_hover;
  30219         else if (is_clicked)
  30220             sym = style->combo.sym_active;
  30221         else sym = style->combo.sym_normal;
  30222 
  30223         /* represents whether or not the combo's button symbol should be drawn */
  30224         draw_button_symbol = sym != NK_SYMBOL_NONE;
  30225 
  30226         /* calculate button */
  30227         button.w = header.h - 2 * style->combo.button_padding.y;
  30228         button.x = (header.x + header.w - header.h) - style->combo.button_padding.y;
  30229         button.y = header.y + style->combo.button_padding.y;
  30230         button.h = button.w;
  30231 
  30232         content.x = button.x + style->combo.button.padding.x;
  30233         content.y = button.y + style->combo.button.padding.y;
  30234         content.w = button.w - 2 * style->combo.button.padding.x;
  30235         content.h = button.h - 2 * style->combo.button.padding.y;
  30236 
  30237         /* draw image */
  30238         bounds.h = header.h - 2 * style->combo.content_padding.y;
  30239         bounds.y = header.y + style->combo.content_padding.y;
  30240         bounds.x = header.x + style->combo.content_padding.x;
  30241         if (draw_button_symbol)
  30242             bounds.w = (button.x - style->combo.content_padding.y) - bounds.x;
  30243         else
  30244             bounds.w = header.w - 2 * style->combo.content_padding.x;
  30245         nk_draw_image(&win->buffer, bounds, &img, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->combo.color_factor));
  30246 
  30247         /* draw open/close button */
  30248         if (draw_button_symbol)
  30249             nk_draw_button_symbol(&win->buffer, &bounds, &content, ctx->last_widget_state,
  30250                 &ctx->style.combo.button, sym, style->font);
  30251     }
  30252     return nk_combo_begin(ctx, win, size, is_clicked, header);
  30253 }
  30254 NK_API nk_bool
  30255 nk_combo_begin_image_text(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *selected, int len,
  30256     struct nk_image img, struct nk_vec2 size)
  30257 {
  30258     struct nk_window *win;
  30259     struct nk_style *style;
  30260     struct nk_input *in;
  30261 
  30262     struct nk_rect header;
  30263     int is_clicked = nk_false;
  30264     enum nk_widget_layout_states s;
  30265     const struct nk_style_item *background;
  30266     struct nk_text text;
  30267 
  30268     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  30269     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  30270     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  30271     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout)
  30272         return 0;
  30273 
  30274     win = ctx->current;
  30275     style = &ctx->style;
  30276     s = nk_widget(&header, ctx);
  30277     if (!s) return 0;
  30278 
  30279     in = (win->layout->flags & NK_WINDOW_ROM || s == NK_WIDGET_DISABLED || s == NK_WIDGET_ROM)? 0: &ctx->input;
  30280     if (nk_button_behavior(&ctx->last_widget_state, header, in, NK_BUTTON_DEFAULT))
  30281         is_clicked = nk_true;
  30282 
  30283     /* draw combo box header background and border */
  30284     if (ctx->last_widget_state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_ACTIVED) {
  30285         background = &style->combo.active;
  30286         text.text = style->combo.label_active;
  30287     } else if (ctx->last_widget_state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER) {
  30288         background = &style->combo.hover;
  30289         text.text = style->combo.label_hover;
  30290     } else {
  30291         background = &style->combo.normal;
  30292         text.text = style->combo.label_normal;
  30293     }
  30294 
  30295     text.text = nk_rgb_factor(text.text, style->combo.color_factor);
  30296 
  30297     switch(background->type) {
  30298         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_IMAGE:
  30299             text.background = nk_rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
  30300             nk_draw_image(&win->buffer, header, &background->data.image, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->combo.color_factor));
  30301             break;
  30302         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_NINE_SLICE:
  30303             text.background = nk_rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
  30304             nk_draw_nine_slice(&win->buffer, header, &background->data.slice, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->combo.color_factor));
  30305             break;
  30306         case NK_STYLE_ITEM_COLOR:
  30307             text.background = background->data.color;
  30308             nk_fill_rect(&win->buffer, header, style->combo.rounding, nk_rgb_factor(background->data.color, style->combo.color_factor));
  30309             nk_stroke_rect(&win->buffer, header, style->combo.rounding, style->combo.border, nk_rgb_factor(style->combo.border_color, style->combo.color_factor));
  30310             break;
  30311     }
  30312     {
  30313         struct nk_rect content;
  30314         struct nk_rect button;
  30315         struct nk_rect label;
  30316         struct nk_rect image;
  30317         int draw_button_symbol;
  30318 
  30319         enum nk_symbol_type sym;
  30320         if (ctx->last_widget_state & NK_WIDGET_STATE_HOVER)
  30321             sym = style->combo.sym_hover;
  30322         else if (is_clicked)
  30323             sym = style->combo.sym_active;
  30324         else sym = style->combo.sym_normal;
  30325 
  30326         /* represents whether or not the combo's button symbol should be drawn */
  30327         draw_button_symbol = sym != NK_SYMBOL_NONE;
  30328 
  30329         /* calculate button */
  30330         button.w = header.h - 2 * style->combo.button_padding.y;
  30331         button.x = (header.x + header.w - header.h) - style->combo.button_padding.x;
  30332         button.y = header.y + style->combo.button_padding.y;
  30333         button.h = button.w;
  30334 
  30335         content.x = button.x + style->combo.button.padding.x;
  30336         content.y = button.y + style->combo.button.padding.y;
  30337         content.w = button.w - 2 * style->combo.button.padding.x;
  30338         content.h = button.h - 2 * style->combo.button.padding.y;
  30339         if (draw_button_symbol)
  30340             nk_draw_button_symbol(&win->buffer, &button, &content, ctx->last_widget_state,
  30341                 &ctx->style.combo.button, sym, style->font);
  30342 
  30343         /* draw image */
  30344         image.x = header.x + style->combo.content_padding.x;
  30345         image.y = header.y + style->combo.content_padding.y;
  30346         image.h = header.h - 2 * style->combo.content_padding.y;
  30347         image.w = image.h;
  30348         nk_draw_image(&win->buffer, image, &img, nk_rgb_factor(nk_white, style->combo.color_factor));
  30349 
  30350         /* draw label */
  30351         text.padding = nk_vec2(0,0);
  30352         label.x = image.x + image.w + style->combo.spacing.x + style->combo.content_padding.x;
  30353         label.y = header.y + style->combo.content_padding.y;
  30354         label.h = header.h - 2 * style->combo.content_padding.y;
  30355         if (draw_button_symbol)
  30356             label.w = (button.x - style->combo.content_padding.x) - label.x;
  30357         else
  30358             label.w = (header.x + header.w - style->combo.content_padding.x) - label.x;
  30359         nk_widget_text(&win->buffer, label, selected, len, &text, NK_TEXT_LEFT, style->font);
  30360     }
  30361     return nk_combo_begin(ctx, win, size, is_clicked, header);
  30362 }

  30364 nk_combo_begin_symbol_label(struct nk_context *ctx,

  30417 NK_API int
  30418 nk_combo(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *const *items, int count,
  30419     int selected, int item_height, struct nk_vec2 size)
  30420 {
  30421     int i = 0;
  30422     int max_height;
  30423     struct nk_vec2 item_spacing;
  30424     struct nk_vec2 window_padding;
  30425 
  30426     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  30427     NK_ASSERT(items);
  30428     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  30429     if (!ctx || !items ||!count)
  30430         return selected;
  30431 
  30432     item_spacing = ctx->style.window.spacing;
  30433     window_padding = nk_panel_get_padding(&ctx->style, ctx->current->layout->type);
  30434     max_height = count * item_height + count * (int)item_spacing.y;
  30435     max_height += (int)item_spacing.y * 2 + (int)window_padding.y * 2;
  30436     size.y = NK_MIN(size.y, (float)max_height);
  30437     if (nk_combo_begin_label(ctx, items[selected], size)) {
  30438         nk_layout_row_dynamic(ctx, (float)item_height, 1);
  30439         for (i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
  30440             if (nk_combo_item_label(ctx, items[i], NK_TEXT_LEFT))
  30441                 selected = i;
  30442         }
  30443         nk_combo_end(ctx);
  30444     }
  30445     return selected;
  30446 }
  30447 NK_API int
  30448 nk_combo_separator(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *items_separated_by_separator,
  30449     int separator, int selected, int count, int item_height, struct nk_vec2 size)
  30450 {
  30451     int i;
  30452     int max_height;
  30453     struct nk_vec2 item_spacing;
  30454     struct nk_vec2 window_padding;
  30455     const char *current_item;
  30456     const char *iter;
  30457     int length = 0;
  30458 
  30459     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  30460     NK_ASSERT(items_separated_by_separator);
  30461     if (!ctx || !items_separated_by_separator)
  30462         return selected;
  30463 
  30464     /* calculate popup window */
  30465     item_spacing = ctx->style.window.spacing;
  30466     window_padding = nk_panel_get_padding(&ctx->style, ctx->current->layout->type);
  30467     max_height = count * item_height + count * (int)item_spacing.y;
  30468     max_height += (int)item_spacing.y * 2 + (int)window_padding.y * 2;
  30469     size.y = NK_MIN(size.y, (float)max_height);
  30470 
  30471     /* find selected item */
  30472     current_item = items_separated_by_separator;
  30473     for (i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
  30474         iter = current_item;
  30475         while (*iter && *iter != separator) iter++;
  30476         length = (int)(iter - current_item);
  30477         if (i == selected) break;
  30478         current_item = iter + 1;
  30479     }
  30480 
  30481     if (nk_combo_begin_text(ctx, current_item, length, size)) {
  30482         current_item = items_separated_by_separator;
  30483         nk_layout_row_dynamic(ctx, (float)item_height, 1);
  30484         for (i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
  30485             iter = current_item;
  30486             while (*iter && *iter != separator) iter++;
  30487             length = (int)(iter - current_item);
  30488             if (nk_combo_item_text(ctx, current_item, length, NK_TEXT_LEFT))
  30489                 selected = i;
  30490             current_item = current_item + length + 1;
  30491         }
  30492         nk_combo_end(ctx);
  30493     }
  30494     return selected;
  30495 }
  30496 NK_API int
  30497 nk_combo_string(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *items_separated_by_zeros,
  30498     int selected, int count, int item_height, struct nk_vec2 size)
  30499 {
  30500     return nk_combo_separator(ctx, items_separated_by_zeros, '\0', selected, count, item_height, size);
  30501 }
  30502 NK_API int
  30503 nk_combo_callback(struct nk_context *ctx, void(*item_getter)(void*, int, const char**),
  30504     void *userdata, int selected, int count, int item_height, struct nk_vec2 size)
  30505 {
  30506     int i;
  30507     int max_height;
  30508     struct nk_vec2 item_spacing;
  30509     struct nk_vec2 window_padding;
  30510     const char *item;
  30511 
  30512     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  30513     NK_ASSERT(item_getter);
  30514     if (!ctx || !item_getter)
  30515         return selected;
  30516 
  30517     /* calculate popup window */
  30518     item_spacing = ctx->style.window.spacing;
  30519     window_padding = nk_panel_get_padding(&ctx->style, ctx->current->layout->type);
  30520     max_height = count * item_height + count * (int)item_spacing.y;
  30521     max_height += (int)item_spacing.y * 2 + (int)window_padding.y * 2;
  30522     size.y = NK_MIN(size.y, (float)max_height);
  30523 
  30524     item_getter(userdata, selected, &item);
  30525     if (nk_combo_begin_label(ctx, item, size)) {
  30526         nk_layout_row_dynamic(ctx, (float)item_height, 1);
  30527         for (i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
  30528             item_getter(userdata, i, &item);
  30529             if (nk_combo_item_label(ctx, item, NK_TEXT_LEFT))
  30530                 selected = i;
  30531         }
  30532         nk_combo_end(ctx);
  30533     } return selected;
  30534 }
  30535 NK_API void
  30536 nk_combobox(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *const *items, int count,
  30537     int *selected, int item_height, struct nk_vec2 size)
  30538 {
  30539     *selected = nk_combo(ctx, items, count, *selected, item_height, size);
  30540 }

  30542 nk_combobox_string(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *items_separated_by_zeros,
  30543     int *selected, int count, int item_height, struct nk_vec2 size)
  30544 {
  30545     *selected = nk_combo_string(ctx, items_separated_by_zeros, *selected, count, item_height, size);
  30546 }
  30547 NK_API void
  30548 nk_combobox_separator(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *items_separated_by_separator,
  30549     int separator, int *selected, int count, int item_height, struct nk_vec2 size)
  30550 {
  30551     *selected = nk_combo_separator(ctx, items_separated_by_separator, separator,
  30552                                     *selected, count, item_height, size);
  30553 }
  30554 NK_API void
  30555 nk_combobox_callback(struct nk_context *ctx,
  30556     void(*item_getter)(void* data, int id, const char **out_text),
  30557     void *userdata, int *selected, int count, int item_height, struct nk_vec2 size)
  30558 {
  30559     *selected = nk_combo_callback(ctx, item_getter, userdata,  *selected, count, item_height, size);
  30560 }

  30565 /* ===============================================================
  30566  *
  30567  *                              TOOLTIP
  30568  *
  30569  * ===============================================================*/
  30570 NK_API nk_bool
  30571 nk_tooltip_begin(struct nk_context *ctx, float width)
  30572 {
  30573     int x,y,w,h;
  30574     struct nk_window *win;
  30575     const struct nk_input *in;
  30576     struct nk_rect bounds;
  30577     int ret;
  30578 
  30579     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  30580     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  30581     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  30582     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout)
  30583         return 0;
  30584 
  30585     /* make sure that no nonblocking popup is currently active */
  30586     win = ctx->current;
  30587     in = &ctx->input;
  30588     if (win->popup.win && ((int)win->popup.type & (int)NK_PANEL_SET_NONBLOCK))
  30589         return 0;
  30590 
  30591     w = nk_iceilf(width);
  30592     h = nk_iceilf(nk_null_rect.h);
  30593     x = nk_ifloorf(in->mouse.pos.x + 1) - (int)win->layout->clip.x;
  30594     y = nk_ifloorf(in->mouse.pos.y + 1) - (int)win->layout->clip.y;
  30595 
  30596     bounds.x = (float)x;
  30597     bounds.y = (float)y;
  30598     bounds.w = (float)w;
  30599     bounds.h = (float)h;
  30600 
  30601     ret = nk_popup_begin(ctx, NK_POPUP_DYNAMIC,
  30602         "__##Tooltip##__", NK_WINDOW_NO_SCROLLBAR|NK_WINDOW_BORDER, bounds);
  30603     if (ret) win->layout->flags &= ~(nk_flags)NK_WINDOW_ROM;
  30604     win->popup.type = NK_PANEL_TOOLTIP;
  30605     ctx->current->layout->type = NK_PANEL_TOOLTIP;
  30606     return ret;
  30607 }
  30608 
  30609 NK_API void
  30610 nk_tooltip_end(struct nk_context *ctx)
  30611 {
  30612     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  30613     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  30614     if (!ctx || !ctx->current) return;
  30615     ctx->current->seq--;
  30616     nk_popup_close(ctx);
  30617     nk_popup_end(ctx);
  30618 }
  30619 NK_API void
  30620 nk_tooltip(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *text)
  30621 {
  30622     const struct nk_style *style;
  30623     struct nk_vec2 padding;
  30624 
  30625     int text_len;
  30626     float text_width;
  30627     float text_height;
  30628 
  30629     NK_ASSERT(ctx);
  30630     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current);
  30631     NK_ASSERT(ctx->current->layout);
  30632     NK_ASSERT(text);
  30633     if (!ctx || !ctx->current || !ctx->current->layout || !text)
  30634         return;
  30635 
  30636     /* fetch configuration data */
  30637     style = &ctx->style;
  30638     padding = style->window.padding;
  30639 
  30640     /* calculate size of the text and tooltip */
  30641     text_len = nk_strlen(text);
  30642     text_width = style->font->width(style->font->userdata,
  30643                     style->font->height, text, text_len);
  30644     text_width += (4 * padding.x);
  30645     text_height = (style->font->height + 2 * padding.y);
  30646 
  30647     /* execute tooltip and fill with text */
  30648     if (nk_tooltip_begin(ctx, (float)text_width)) {
  30649         nk_layout_row_dynamic(ctx, (float)text_height, 1);
  30650         nk_text(ctx, text, text_len, NK_TEXT_LEFT);
  30651         nk_tooltip_end(ctx);
  30652     }
  30653 }
  30654 #ifdef NK_INCLUDE_STANDARD_VARARGS
  30655 NK_API void
  30656 nk_tooltipf(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *fmt, ...)
  30657 {
  30658     va_list args;
  30659     va_start(args, fmt);
  30660     nk_tooltipfv(ctx, fmt, args);
  30661     va_end(args);
  30662 }
  30663 NK_API void
  30664 nk_tooltipfv(struct nk_context *ctx, const char *fmt, va_list args)
  30665 {
  30666     char buf[256];
  30667     nk_strfmt(buf, NK_LEN(buf), fmt, args);
  30668     nk_tooltip(ctx, buf);
  30669 }
  30670 #endif

  30892 /// - 2016/11/10 (1.28.1) - Fixed some warnings and C++ error.
  30893 /// - 2016/11/10 (1.28.0) - Added additional `nk_button` versions which allows to directly
  30894 ///                        pass in a style struct to change buttons visual.
  30895 /// - 2016/11/10 (1.27.0) - Added additional `nk_tree` versions to support external state
  30896 ///                        storage. Just like last the `nk_group` commit the main
  30897 ///                        advantage is that you optionally can minimize nuklears runtime
  30898 ///                        memory consumption or handle hash collisions.
  30899 /// - 2016/11/09 (1.26.0) - Added additional `nk_group` version to support external scrollbar
  30900 ///                        offset storage. Main advantage is that you can externalize
  30901 ///                        the memory management for the offset. It could also be helpful
  30902 ///                        if you have a hash collision in `nk_group_begin` but really
  30903 ///                        want the name. In addition I added `nk_list_view` which allows
  30904 ///                        to draw big lists inside a group without actually having to
  30905 ///                        commit the whole list to nuklear (issue #269).
  30906 /// - 2016/10/30 (1.25.1) - Fixed clipping rectangle bug inside `nk_draw_list`.

  30908 ///                        the hands of the user. From now on users don't have to care
  30909 ///                        about panels unless they care about some information. If you
  30910 ///                        still need the panel just call `nk_window_get_panel`.

  30912 ///                        rectangle for less overdraw and widget background transparency.
  30913 /// - 2016/10/18 (1.23.0) - Added `nk_edit_focus` for manually edit widget focus control.

  30915 /// - 2016/09/29 (1.22.6) - Fixed edit widget UTF-8 text cursor drawing bug.
  30916 /// - 2016/09/28 (1.22.5) - Fixed edit widget UTF-8 text appending/inserting/removing.
  30917 /// - 2016/09/28 (1.22.4) - Fixed drawing bug inside edit widgets which offset all text
  30918 ///                        text in every edit widget if one of them is scrolled.
  30919 /// - 2016/09/28 (1.22.3) - Fixed small bug in edit widgets if not active. The wrong
  30920 ///                        text length is passed. It should have been in bytes but
  30921 ///                        was passed as glyphs.
  30922 /// - 2016/09/20 (1.22.2) - Fixed color button size calculation.
  30923 /// - 2016/09/20 (1.22.1) - Fixed some `nk_vsnprintf` behavior bugs and removed `<stdio.h>`
  30924 ///                        again from `NK_INCLUDE_STANDARD_VARARGS`.
  30925 /// - 2016/09/18 (1.22.0) - C89 does not support vsnprintf only C99 and newer as well
  30926 ///                        as C++11 and newer. In addition to use vsnprintf you have
  30927 ///                        to include <stdio.h>. So just defining `NK_INCLUDE_STD_VAR_ARGS`
  30928 ///                        is not enough. That behavior is now fixed. By default if
  30929 ///                        both varargs as well as stdio is selected I try to use
  30930 ///                        vsnprintf if not possible I will revert to vsprintf. If
  30931 ///                        varargs but not stdio was defined I will use my own function.

  31016 ///                        floating pointer number to string conversion for additional

  31019 ///                        string to floating point number conversion for additional

  31022 /// - 2016/08/08 (1.07.1) - Fixed possible floating point error inside `nk_widget` leading
  31023 ///                        to wrong widget width calculation which results in widgets falsely
  31024 ///                        becoming tagged as not inside window and cannot be accessed.
  31025 /// - 2016/08/08 (1.07.0) - Nuklear now differentiates between hiding a window (NK_WINDOW_HIDDEN) and
  31026 ///                        closing a window (NK_WINDOW_CLOSED). A window can be hidden/shown
  31027 ///                        by using `nk_window_show` and closed by either clicking the close
  31028 ///                        icon in a window or by calling `nk_window_close`. Only closed
  31029 ///                        windows get removed at the end of the frame while hidden windows
  31030 ///                        remain.
  31031 /// - 2016/08/08 (1.06.0) - Added `nk_edit_string_zero_terminated` as a second option to
  31032 ///                        `nk_edit_string` which takes, edits and outputs a '\0' terminated string.
  31033 /// - 2016/08/08 (1.05.4) - Fixed scrollbar auto hiding behavior.
  31034 /// - 2016/08/08 (1.05.3) - Fixed wrong panel padding selection in `nk_layout_widget_space`.
  31035 /// - 2016/08/07 (1.05.2) - Fixed old bug in dynamic immediate mode layout API, calculating
  31036 ///                        wrong item spacing and panel width.
  31037 /// - 2016/08/07 (1.05.1) - Hopefully finally fixed combobox popup drawing bug.
  31038 /// - 2016/08/07 (1.05.0) - Split varargs away from `NK_INCLUDE_STANDARD_IO` into own
  31039 ///                        define `NK_INCLUDE_STANDARD_VARARGS` to allow more fine

  31041 /// - 2016/08/06 (1.04.5) - Changed memset calls to `NK_MEMSET`.

  31043 /// - 2016/08/04 (1.04.3) - Fixed window scaling, movement bug which appears if you
